details.body: A, An, (As an article) not ex.; ‘a man’ naraH. 2 (One) eka. 3 (Indefinite) kiM with cit, cana or api. 4 With part., ex. by dat. or inf.; ‘set out a-hunting’ mfgayAyE or mfgayAM kartuM pratasTe; ‘fell a-weeping’ kraMdituM pravfttaH. 5 (Every) prati in comp., or by repetition of word; ‘100 Rs. a day’ pratidinaM or dine dine SatarUpakaM. 6 (Species) viSezaH, BedaH, in comp.; ‘dog is an animal’ SvA prARiviSezaH.

A or (before vowels) AN: I This article has no equiv. in Sanskrit and is expressed by the singular number alone: there is a large silk-cotton tree on the banks of the Godavari asti godAvarItIre viSAlaH SAlmalItaruH H. i.; there was a king named Cintamani aBUdrAjA cintAmaRi- rnAma Va.II But kaScit (kAcit, kiYcit) should be added when special attention is directed to the object: a (certain) Yaksha kaScid yakzaH, Me. I 1.; A (certain) saint named Marichi kaScinmarIcirnABa BaharziH, D. iii.III When it means a species of, viSezaH, BedaH, etc. should be added: Asoka is a tree aSoko vfkzaviSezaH.IV When used distribu- -tively, (a) expr. by avy. comp. with prati, or, by the repetition of the word in proper agreement with the verb: give (me) 500 sovereign a day pratyahaM suvarRapaYcaSatAni dehi, H. iii; (b) the simple gen. may be used in connection with num. adverbs: dinner twice a day dvirahno Bojanam, V. In O. E. some- -times=on, in, for: q. v.: the world runs awheel *cakrErjagadDAvati.

A. As an indefinite article before nouns singular, for the most part not expressed in Sanskrit; as, ‘a lion,’ siMhaH; (One) ekaH -kA -kaM. — (Some, a certain) kaScit; as, ‘a certain man,’ kaScit puruzaH. — (Each, every) expressed by prati or anu, before the acc. neut.; as, ‘a day,’ ‘each day,’ pratidinaM or anudinaM. When ‘a’ comes before a participle, after a verb of motion, it is expressed by the dat. c.; as, ‘he went a hunting,’ mfgayAyE gataH; or by arTaM preceded by the crude form of a noun; as, mfgayArTaM gataH; or by the infinitive; as, mfgayAM karttuM gataH.
ABAFT: paScAdBAge (with gen.): abaft the mast *guRavfkzasya paScAdBAge.
ABAFT , adv. (Towards the stern of the ship) nAvaH paScimaBAgaM prati.

Abandon, v. t. tyaj 1 P, hA 3 P, vi-ut-sfj 6 P, ujJ 6 P, apAs 4 P, rah 1 P, 10, muc 6 P. [Abandon]ed, a. tyakta, hIna, mukta &c. 2 pApAtman, Brazwacarita; ‘he was a(bandoned) to his fate’ dEvADInaH kftaH, yadBAvi tadBavatu ityuktvA sa parityaktaH. [Abandon]ment, s. tyAgaH, utsargaH; ‘a(bandonment) of worldly connections’ saMnyAsaH, virakti f.
ABANDON: (1) tyajati, pari-, saM-, (tyaj, c. l.); (2) jahAti, vi-, apa-, (hA, c. 3.);(3) ujBkati, sam-, pra-, (ujBk, c. 6.);(4) ut-sfjati, vi-, (sfj, c. 6.).

To ABANDON , v. a. tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), parityaj, santyaj; hA (c. 3. jahAti, hAtuM), apahA, vihA, prahA, apAhA; utsfj (c. 6. -sfjati, -srazwuM), atisfj, vyapasfj; ujJ (c. 6. ujJati, ujJituM), projJ.
ABANDONED: I Lit. tyaktaH (ktA, ktaM): v. To abandon.II Fig.: extremely wicked: q. v.(1) BrazwaH (zwA, zwaM);(2) KaRqitavfttaH (ttA, ttaM) (=of a character).

ABANDONED , p. p. tyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, parityaktaH -ktA -ktaM, uttpaktaH -ktA -ktaM, hInaH -nA -naM, utsfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, projJitaH -tA -taM, samujJitaH -tA -taM, rahitaH -tA -taM, virahitaH -tA -taM, visarjjitaH -tA -taM, vinAkftaH -tA -taM. — (Re- probate) pApAtmA -tmA -tma (n), pApamatiH -tiH -ti.
ABANDONMENT: (1) tyAgaH;(2) parityAgaH; (3) utsargaH; Ph: a. of wordly connexions: sannyAsaH.
ABANDONMENT , s. tyAgaH, parityAgaH, uttyAgaH, virahaH, projJanaM. — (Of worldly connexions) sannyAsaH.
Abase, v. t. aBiBU 1 P, svasTAnAt nipat c., apakfz 1 P, laGUkf 8 U. [Abase]ment, s. apakarzaH, aBiBavaH, mAnaBaMgaH, avajYAnaM.
ABASE: (1) aBi-Bavati (BU, c. 1.);(2) namayati (c. of nam): v. To humble, to lower.
To ABASE v. a. svasTAnAd apakfz (c. 1. -karzati, c. 6. -kfzati, -krazwuM), svasTAnAd BraMS in caus. (BraMSayati, BraMSayituM) or nipat in caus. (-pAtayati, -pAtayituM).

ABASED , p. p. KaRqitABimAnaH -nA -naM, tyaktABimAnaH &c., nazwABimAnaH &c., hatagarvaH -rvA -rvaM, hatAhaNkAraH -rA -raM, hftadamBaH -mBA -mBaM.

Abash, v. t. lajj c., hrI c. (hrepayati), trap c. (trapayati). [Abash]ed, a. lajjita, trapita, vilakza, vrIqita, hrIparigata; ‘with an a(bashed) countenance’ trapADomuKa (KI f.).
ABASH: (1) hepayati (c. of hrI);(2) lajjayati (c. of lajj).
To ABASH , v. a. laj in caus. (lAjayati, lAjayituM), hrI in caus. (hrepayati, hrepayituM), trap in caus. (trapayati, trapayituM).
ABASHED , p. p. lajjitaH -tA -taM, trapitaH -tA -taM, vrIqitaH -tA -taM, hrIparigataH -tA -taM.
Abate, v. t. hras c., laGayati (D.), Sam c. (Samayati). 2 (price) nyUnIkf 8 U; avasad c. v. i. kzi pass., hras 1 P; pra-upa-Sam 4 P. [Abate]ment, s. nyUnIkaraRaM; hrAsaH, kzayaH.
ABATE (v. t.): I To lessen, diminish: q. v. laGayati (nomi.).II Leg. t. t., To put down: q. v.
ABATE (v. i.): (1) kzIyate (Pass. of kzi);(2) pari-hIyate. (Pass. of hA);(3) apa-cIyate (Pass. of ci): v. To decrease.

To ABATE , v. a. (To diminish) hras in caus. (hrAsayati, hrAsayituM), kan (nom. kanayati, kanayituM), laG (nom. laGayati, laGayituM), Sam in caus. (Samayati, SamayituM). — (To let down the price in selling) mUlyaM nyUnIkf. — (To depress) avasad in caus. (-sAdayati, -yituM).
To ABATE , v. n. (To grow less) kzi in pass. (kzIyate), hras (c. 1. hrasati, hrasituM). — (To subside) Sam (c. 4. SAmyati, SamituM), upaSam, praSam.
ABATED , p. p. (Subsided) upaSAntaH -ntA -ntaM, praSAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
ABATEMENT: I Decrease, diminution: q. v.: hrAsaH.II Diminution of price: Ph. I will make an a. of five per cent *paYcakaM SataM laGayAmi.III Leg. t. t.: v. Failure.
ABATEMENT , s. (The act) nyUnIkaraRaM. — (State) nyUnatA, kzayaH, hrAsaH, SAntiH f., see DIMINUTION, MITIGATION.
Abbacy, s. maWADISa-padaM-tvaM.

Abbey, s. vihAraH, maWaH.
ABBEY: (1) vihAraH;(2) maWaH.
ABBEY , s. vihAraH, DarmmacAriRAM maWaH.
ABBEY , s. yogigfhaM, yogyAlayaH. ABBOT, s. maWADipatiH m.

ABBOT: (1) vihArapatiH;(2) maWADyakzaH;(3) maWADISaH.
ABBOT , s. vihArasya praDAnapuruzaH, maWADyakzaH, guruH.
Abbreviate, v. t. saM-pratisaM-hf 1 P, saMkzip 6 P, samas 4 P, hras c. [Abbreviat]ion, s. saMkzepaH-paRaM.

ABBREVIATURE , s. saNkzepaH, -paRaM, samasanaM, saNgrahaH.

ABERRATION , s. viBramaH, BrAntiH, BraMSaH, cyutiH f., paTaBrazwatA, unmArgagamanaM.

ABETTOR: (1) protsAhakaH;(2) pravartakaH.

Abeyance, s. vilaMbaH, vyAkzepaH.
ABEYANCE , s. apekzA, vilambaH.

ABHORRENCE: (1) jugupsA;(2) paramadvezaH; N. B. Const. with loc.

ABHORRENCE , s. atidvezaH, atyantadvezaH, paramadvezaH, vikftaM.

(titikzate); ‘a(bide) by’ sTA (loc.), anuvft; kasyAnyasya vA vacasi mayA sTAtavyaM (Ka. 156); ‘I shall a(bide) by your decision’ tava nirRayamanuvartizye, nirRayAnuroDena vartizye, nirRaye sTAsyAmi; ‘a(bide)s by his promise’ pratijYAM-aBisaMDAM-pAlayati. [Abid]ing, a. sTAyin; anuvartin.

ABIDE (v. t.): (1) To wait for: q. v.: prati- Ikzate (Ikz, c. 1.).II To endure; q. v. sahate (sah c. 1.).
To ABIDE , v. n. (To dwell) vas (c. 1. vasati, vastuM). — (To remain) sTA (c. 1. tizWati -te, sTAtuM), vft (c. 1. varttate, varttituM).

To ABIDE , v. a. (To wait for, expect) pratIkz (c. 1. -Ikzate, -IkzituM). uddfS (c. 1. -paSyati, -drazwuM), pratipAl (c. 10. -pAlayati, -pAlayituM). — (To bear, support) sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM), kzam (c. 1. kzamate, kzantuM), tij in des. (titikzate, titikzituM). — (To abide by one's promise) pratijYAtaM pAl.

ABIDING , a. sTAyI -yinI -yi (n), varttI -rttinI -rtti (n), vfttimAn -matI -mat (t).

ABILITY , s. SaktiH f., SaktatA, balaM, sAmarTyaM. — (Skill) kuSalatA, pravIRatA. ‘To the utmost of one's ability,’ yaTASakti ind., yAvacCakyaM, sarvvayatnEH, yaTAsAmarTyaM.
ABILITY , s. (Mental) budDiviBavaH, budDivEBavaM, budDipAwavaM.
Abject, a. aDama, apa-ni-kfzwa, kfpaRa, nIca, tiraskArya; See Mean. [Abject]ness, s. aDamatA, kArpaRyaM.

ABJECTLY , adv. kfpaRaM, kArpaRyena, nikfzwaM, nIcatayA, aDamaprakAreRaM.
ABJECTNESS or ABJECTION, s. kArpaRyaM, aDamatvaM, apakfzwatA, nikfzwatA.

Able, a. samarTa, kzama, Sakta; karmakzama, alaMkarmIRa. 2 prabala, balavat, Saktimat. 3 pawu, nipuRa; ‘to be a(ble)’ Sak 5 P, pf c., or pAr 10 U, utsah 1 A, praBU 1 P, with inf.; alaM with inf. or dat. of noun; ‘a(ble) to protect’ rakzituM-rakzaRAya-alaM, praBavati &c. Sakti f., balaM, sAmarTyaM. 2 pAwavaM, vEcakzaRyaM; karmakzamatA. 3 DISakti f., matyutkarzaH, mati f., budDi f.; ‘to the best (utmost) of oneʼs a(bility)’ yaTASakti, yAvacCakyaM, sarvaprayatnEH. To be ABLE , v. n. Sak (c. 5. Saknoti, c. 4. Sakyati -te, SaktuM), kzam (c. 1. kzamate, kzantuM), utsahf (c. 1. -sahate -soQuM) with inf.; praBU (c. 1. -Bavati -BavituM) with dat.; as, ‘they are able to destroy the world,’ praBavanti kzayAya jagataH.

(Of the body) aNgasnAnaM; ‘of the feet,’ pAdaprakzAlanaM; ‘of the head,’ SiraHsnAnaM; ‘of the mouth,’ muKamArjanaM, muKaDAvanaM, muKaSudDiH f., AcamanaM; ‘morning a.,’ prAtaHsnAnaM; ‘by rubbing earth on the body,’ mfttikAsnAnaM; ‘by rubbing cowdung,’ gomayasnAnaM; ‘by rubbing ashes,’ BasmasnAnaM; ‘servant who assists at a.,’ snApakaH; ‘rules of a.,’ SOcaviDiH m.; ‘one who performs a.,’ snAyI m. To ABOLISH , v. a. (To annul) lopaM kf, nirarTakaM -kAM -kaM kf. — (To destroy) naS in caus. (nASayati, nASayituM), vinaS; sad in caus. (sAdayati, sAdayituM), utsad, protsad; udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti, -CettuM).
To ABOLISH , v. a. KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM), KaRqanaM kf, nivft in caus.
ABOLISHED , p. p. luptaH -ptA -ptaM.
ABOLITION: (1) lopaH;(2) avalopaH;(3) vilopaH (?).
ABOLITION , s. (Act of annulling) lopaH. — (Destruction) vinASaH, udDaraRaM, ucCedaH.
ABOLITION , s. KaRqanaM, BaNgaH, avaropaRaM, nivarttanaM, nivfttiH f.
ABOMINABLE: (1) gahiMtaH (tA, taM);(2) GfRitaH (tA, taM);(3) GfRAkaraH (rI, raM).
ABOMINABLE , a. garhaRIyaH -yA -yaM, dvezyaH -zyA -zyaM, GfRArhaH -rhA -rhaM.
ABOMINABLY , adv. garhmaprakAreRa, garhitaM.
Abominate, v. t. dviz 2 U, garh 1, 10 A; See Abhor. [Abominat]ion, s. garhA, vidvezaH. 2 aSudDadravyaM, kutsAspada. Abominable, a. dvezya, garhaRIya, garhita. 2 jugupsAkara (rI f.).
ABOMINATE (v. t.): (1) dvezwi, (dviz; c. 2.); (2) garhate (garh, c. 1.): v. To detest, execrate.
To ABOMINATE , v. a. garh (c. 1. garhate, garhituM), bAD in des. (bIBatsate, bIBatsituM).
ABOMINATED , p. p. garhitaH -tA -taM.
ABOMINATION: I Hatred: q. v. dvezaH.II That which excites hatred:(1) jugupsitam; (2) garhitam;(3) GfRitam.
ABOMINATION , s. (Detestation) bIBatsaH, garhA, garhaRaM. — (An abomi- nated thing, the object of detestation) garhitaM, aSudDadravyaM.
ABOMINATION , s. (Object of) atidvezapAtraM, bIBatsavizayaH.
Aboriginal, a. Adya, Adima, pUrvakAlIna.
Aborigines, s. AdimavAsinaH (pl.).
ABORIGINES: AdimavAsinaH (m. pl.) (?).
ABORIGINES , s. pl. praTamasTitalokAH m. pl., prAcInalokAH m. pl.
Abortion, s. garBasrAvaH-pAtaH; ‘to cause a(bortion)’ BrURahatyAM kf 8 U; ‘causing a(bortion)’ BrURahatyA. Abortive, a. garBasrAvin, apUrRakAla. 2 akAlakfta, nizPala, moGa, vyarTa (as an attempt).

ABORTION: (1) garBasrAvaH;(2) garBapAtaH;(3) garBapatanam;(4) garBacyutiH. To cause a.:(1) garBaM pAtayati (c. of pat);(2) BrURahatyAM karoti (kf, c. 8.) One who causes a.:(1) BrURahan (f. GnI);(2) BrURahatyAkArin (f. RI): Causing a.:(1) garBa- pAtanam;(2) BrURahatyA.
ABORTION , s. garBasrAvaH, akAlaprasavaH.

ABORTIVE: I Producing abortion:(1) garBa- pAtin (f. nI);(2) garBasrAvin (f. RI);(3) BrURaGna (f. GnI).II Born prematurely:(1) akAlaprasUtaH (tA, taM);(2) akAlajAtaH (tA, taM).III Fruitless, unsuccessful: q. v.: nizPala; (lA, laM).

ABORTIVE , a. (Producing abortion) garBasrAvI -vinI -vi (n). — (Brought forth prematurely) garBasrastaH -stA -staM, apUrRakAlaH -lA -laM. — (That does not succeed) nizPalaH -lA -laM, moGaH -GA -GaM, vyarTaH -rTA -rTaM.
ABORTIVELY: (1) muDA;(2) vfTA: v. In vain.

Abound, v. i. (with, in) sakF-pF pass., or by bahu, BUyizWa, in comp.; BUyizWavfkzaM vanaM; bahukOtukaH sa deSaH ‘a(bound)s in curiosities’. [Abound]ing, a. AQya, saMkIrRa, Akula, prAya, in comp. Abundant, a. bahula, praBUta, pracura, vipula, BUri. [Abundant]ly, adv. bahuSaH, anekavAraM, vipulaM. Abundance, bAhulyaM, prAcuryaM.

ABOUND (v. i.): No equiv: expr. by the corresp. adj s.: among those trees a. ing in good fruits BUyizWasamBAvyaPalezvamIzu pAdapezu, R. xiii. 46; the country of Kimpurusha a. s in curiosities bahukutUhalaH kimpuruzavizayaH, K. : v. Abundant, full of.
To ABOUND , v. n. (Followed by with or in) saNkF in pass. (-kIryyate) with inst. c.; pF in pass. (pUryyate), ApF with inst. c. — (To be in great plenty) bahulIBU (c. 1. -Bavati, -BavituM).
ABOUNDING IN , AQyaH -QyA -QyaM, saNkIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, citaH -tA -taM, nicayI -yinI -yi (n), saMvalitaH -tA -taM.

About, prep. pari; pari-i ‘go a(bout)’ &c. 2 deSIya (with numerals); ‘a(bout) five years old’ paMcavarzadeSIyaH. 3 (Regarding) ADikftya, prati, uddiSya; saMbadDa-anuvidDa-gata-vizaye in comp.; ‘I ask a(bout) my friend’ mitragataM pfcCAmi; parAjayAnuvidDA AlApAH &c. 4 kfte, arTe, arTaM, hetoH. 5 paritaH, aBitaH, (acc.); samIpaM, samIpe, pArSvataH, nikawe, (loc.). 6 (Nearly) with numerals upa, Asanna, adUra, in comp.; upacaturAH ‘a(bout) four’. adv. (Showing prospective fut.) ex. by fut. part., unmuKa (KI f.), udyata, Asanna, or desid.; anuyAsyan munitanayAM (S. 1) ‘a(bout) to follow’ &c.; jiGAMsyamAno naraH ‘a(bout) to be killed’; AsannamaraRaH ‘a(bout) to die’; AsannarAjyanASaH ‘a(bout) to lose the realm’. 2 prAya-kalpa, in comp.; ‘it is a(bout) noon’ maDyAhna-prAyaH-kalpaH-samayaH; ‘what are you a(bout)’ kiM kartumudyatosi, kiMkAryavyagrosi, kimAraMBastvaM. 3 paritaH, aBitaH. 4 itastataH, sTAnAtsTAnaM.

ABOUT (Prep.): I Around: q. v.: paritaH (with acc.). Sometimes sim. by the loc.: a. one's neck kaRWe or kaRWadeSe (not kaRWaM paritaH). Ph.: a. these places itastataH.II In atten- -dance on: saha (with ins.): v. With.III Respecting, concerning: prati (with acc.) (rare in this sense): you have spoken one thing good a. Śiva tvayEkamISaM prati sADu BAzitam, Ku. v. 81. N. B. Note the following exx.: is there any mistake a. it kimatra kAcidBrAntiH, Vi. iii.; whether mere knowledge a. God leads to emancipation kimISvaravizayaM YjAnamAtraM nirvARakAraRam, Ds.; conversing now a. his father, now a. his mother, now a. Sukanasa antarA pitf- saktamantarA mAtfsambadDaDmantarA SukanAsamayaM kurvannAlApama; K. ; I also want to ask something a. your friend vayamapi BavatyoH saKIgataM kimapi pfcCAmaH, Sa. i.; we had some conversation a. the news of the country saNkayA ca deSavArtAnuvidDA kAcanAvayoraBUt; D. v.; a. the Lord of the Heavens divoDinATama- Dikftya; a. the friend of the god of Wind pavanasya saKAyaM nirdiSya; a. the Lord of the (south) quarter dikpatimuddiSya; a. many Nalas aneka- nalAvalambAM; N. xiii. 2. 9. 15. 26.IV Near (in time): v. About (adv.) (III) Ph. remain- ed for a. a moment muhUrtamivAsAYcakre, K. ; a. the same time tasminneva kzaRAntare, D. i.

ABOUT (adv.): I Around: q. v.: paritaH.II Here and there itastataH. To go, walk, wander a. parikrAmati (kram, c. 1.).III Nearly.(1) by an altern. com.: we will reach (Patna) in a. a week (lit. in five or six days) paYcazErahoBi- rvayameva tatra gantAraH, Mu. v.;(2) by bah. comp. with upa, Asanna, adUra etc: a. ten upadaSA: (m. pl.); a. four upacaturAH; a. twenty AsannaviMSAH; a. thirty adUratriMSAH;(3) by prAyaH (yA, yaM) or kalpaH (lpA, lpaM) affixed: a. as high as the knee jAnudaDnakalpaH (lpA, lpaM);(4) of age, by deSIyaH (yA, yaM), affixed: a. 18 years of age azwAdaSavarzadeSIyaH (yA, yaM), D. vi.
ABOUT, BE: udyataH (tA, taM): v. Point of, on the; ready. Ph.: What is the king a. now aTa sa rAjA kimAramBaH samprati, U. ii.

ABOUT , prep. (Encircling) pari prefixed. — (Near to, in time) prati. — (In number) deSIya affixed; as, ‘about twelve years old,’ dvAdaSavarzadeSIyaH; nyUnADikaM. — (Concerning, relating to) prati, pratIkzya, uddiSya. — (On account of) hetoH, hetO, arTaM, arTe, kfte, nimitte, kAraRAt, with the crude form, or sometimes the gen. c. of the preceding noun. — (Engaged in any thing) vyApftaH, nizWitaH, nirataH, with loc. c. — (Close to one's person) pArSvatas ind., nikawe, samIpaM.

ABOUT , adv. (Circularly) paritas ind., aBitas ind. — (Nearly) prAyaSas or prAyas ind. — (Here and there) itastatas ind., sarvvatas ind. — (To be about to do any thing) expressed by udyataH, ‘prepared,’ with the infin.; as, ‘about to kill,’ hantum udyataH; or by the act. part. of the 2d fut.; as, gamizyan, ‘about to go,’ eDizyamARaH, ‘about to increase’; or, by the desid. adj.; as, jigamizuH, ‘about to go,’ mumUrzuH ‘about to die.’
ABOUT . (On the point of) unmuKa &c., see under POINT.

Above, adv. aDi or aBi pr.; upari, uparizwAt, UrDvaM; ‘just a(bove)’ uparyupari (acc.) a. prAgukta, pUrvanirdizwa. prep. upari (gen.); ati pr.; aDika, uttara, viSizwa, (abl.); ‘a(bove) calculation’ atisaMKya; ‘he stands a(bove) all’ sa sarvezAM mUrDni tizWati; ‘a(bove) mentioned’ pUrvokta, prAgukta; ‘to be a(bove)’ UrDvaM sTA 1 P, aBiBU 1 P; See Excel.
ABOVE (adv.): I Overhead:(1) upari;(2) UrdDvam;(3) uparizwAt. From a.:(1) uparizwAt; (2) UrdDvataH, Ku. xiv. 37.II Before:(1) pUrvam;(2) prAk.
ABOVE (adj.): pUrvaH (rvA, rvaM), in the a. apho- rism pUrveRa sUtreRa, S.

ABOVE (Prep.): I In a higher place: upari (with gen.) Just a.: uparyupari (with acc.), Just a. the village uparyupari grAmam.II In greater number:(1) by tat. comp. with aDikaH (kA, kaM): in a. half a moment ardDADikamuhUrtena, Ram. ;(2) by bah. comp. with aDika, a. forty aDikacatvAriMSaH (m. pl.);(3) by comp. with paraH, a. hundred (=hundreds) paraHSataH (tA, taM); Ki. xiii. 26.III Beyond; v. Beyond (prep.) (III).
ABOVE, BE: (1) ativartate (vft, c. 1.) Vi. iv.; (2) aDi or ati (with acc.) (rare): Kṛṣṇa is a. the gods ati devAn kfzRaH.

ABOVE , prep. or adv. (Higher in place) aDi or aBi prefixed; upari, uparizwAt, UrdDvaM. — (More in quantity) aDikaM, uttaraM. — (Higher in rank) uttaraH -rA -raM, viSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, SrezWaH -zWA -zWaM. — (Superior to, beyond) ati; as, ‘above man's power,’ ati- mAnupaM. — (Above all, especially) vizeSatas ind., prADAnyatas ind.
To be ABOVE , v. n. (To excel) aBiBU (c. 1. -Bavati -BavituM), praBU, [Page002-b+ 51] atiBU; viSiz in pass. (-Sizyate). — (To be higher) UrdDvaM sTA (c. 1. tizWati, sTAtuM).
ABOVE-GROUND , a. (Not in the grave, still existing) varttamAnaH -nA -naM, jIvan -vantI -vat (t).
ABOVE-MENTIONED , a. pUrvvoktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvoditaH -tA -taM, prAguktaH -ktA -ktaM.
Abrade, v. t. GarzaRena kzi 1 P. Abrasion, s. GarzaRena kzayaH.
Abreast, adv. pArSvApArSvi.
ABREAST: pArSvApArSiva (indec.)
ABREAST , adv. pArSvApArSvi.
ABREAST , adv. samapArSvatas, pArSvapaMktitas.
Abridge, v. t. saMkzip 6 P, samas 4 P, saMgrah 9 P. [Abridge]ment, s. saMkzepaH, sAraH, saMgrahaH &c.
ABRIDGE: (1) saN kzipati (kzip, c. 6.);(2) samA-harati (hf, c. 1.);(3) sam-asyati (as, c. 4.); v. To lessen, shorten.

To ABRIDGE , v. a. saMhf (c. 1. -harati -te -harttuM) upasaMhf; saNkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM). — (To shorten) hras in caus. (hrAsayati, hrAsayituM). — (To deprive of, cut off) ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), viyuj in caus. (-yojayati -yojayituM).
ABRIDGEMENT: (1) saMkzepaH;(2) pratyAhAraH;(3) samAhAraH;(4) samAsaH.
ABRIDGMENT , s. pratyAhAraH, saNkzepaH, -paRaM, samasanaM, saNgrahaH, saBAhAraH, samAhftiH f.

Abroad, adv. videSe, deSAMtaraM. 2 bahiH (abl.). 3 (Widely) sarvatra, dUraM; ‘casting a(broad) his rays’ dUraprasAritakaraH (sUryaH); ‘live a(broad)’ pravas 1 P; ‘go a(broad)’ prasf 1 P, bahulIBU 1 P, prakASatAM gam 1 P, prakASIBU 1 P, nirgam 1 P; ‘the dreadful vow became known a(broad)’ sA dAruRA pratijYA loke prasidDABUt, loke prakASatAM gatA.

ABROAD (adv.): I In a foreign country: (1) videSe;(2) deSAntare.II To a foreign country:(1) videSaM;(2) deSAntaram.III Not at home bahis.IV Widely: q. v.: spread- ing his rays far a. dUraprasAritakaraH, K.
ABROAD, LIVE: (1) pravasati (vas, c. 1.); (2) videSe vasati etc. One who is, or, is living a. prozitaH (tA, taM).

ABROAD , adv. (In another country) videSe loc. c. — (At large, un- confined) nirviGnaM. — (Out of the house) vahis. — (In all direc- tions) sarvvatra, itastatas ind. — (Sojourn abroad in a foreign country) pravasanaM. — (A sojourner abroad) pravAsI (n), prozitaH.
To ABROGATE , v. a. lopaM kf.
ABROGATED , p. p. luptaH -ptA -ptaM.
ABROGATION , s. lopaH, lopakaraRaM.
Abrupt, a. vizama, (prapAtaH). 2 Akasmika (kI f.), asaMbaMDa, akAMqa. [Abrupt]ly, adv. ekapade, sahasA, akasmAt.
ABRUPT (adj.): I Steep, rugged: q. v.: vizamaH (mA, maM).II Hasty, sudden: q. v.: (1) AkasmikaH (kI, kaM);(2) akARqaH (RqA, RqaM). III Of style: no equiv.: *BagnaH (BagnA, BagnaM).
ABRUPT , a. (Broken, craggy) BagnaH -gnA -gnaM, BinnaH -nnA -nnaM, rukzaH -kzA -kzaM. — (Sudden) AkasmikaH -kI -kaM. — (Unconnected) asambanDaH -nDA -nDaM.
ABRUPTLY: sahasA: v. Suddenly, hastily.
ABRUPTLY , adv. (Hastily) sahasA, akasmAt, Jawiti.
Abscess, s. vidraDiH; sPowaH, vraRaH-RaM.
ABSCESS: perh. vidraDiH.
ABSCESS , s. vidraDiH m., pUyasampUrRaH sPowaH
Abscond, v. i. pracCanna a. BU 1 P, AtmAnaM guh 1 U or pracCad 10, aMtarDA pass. 2 palAy 1 A, vyapasfp 1 P, apakram 1 U, 4 P.
ABSCOND: (1) AtmAnaM nigUhati (guh, c. 1.): v. To hide;(2) palAyate: v. To escape.

To ABSCOND , v. n. (To hide one's self) AtmAnaM guh (c. 1. gUhati -te, goQuM), niguh; guptaH -ptA -ptaM or pracCannaH -nnA -nnaM BU. — (To disappear) antarDA in pass. (-DIyate). — (To escape privately) palAy (c. 1. palAyate -yituM), nizpat (c. 1. -patati -patituM), vyapasfp (c. 1. -sarpati -sarpituM).

ABSENCE: I A not being present:(1) anupasTitiH;(2) By the corresp. adj s v. ABSENT: Ph. how shall I live in his a. ahametasya virahe kaTaM jIvizyAmi, Vet.II A being abroad: (1) pravAsaH;(2) pravasanam.III Non-existence: aBAvaH: first of all, the property goes to the brothers, in their a. to the mother, in mother's a. to the father, and in their a to the husband praTamaM sodarARAM, tadaBAve mAtuH, mAturaBAve pituH, ezAM punaraBAve tadDanaM BartuH, Da.IV Fig.: pl. a. of mind: (1) anyamanaskatA;(2) amanoyogaH.
ABSENCE , s. aBAvaH, parokzaM, anupasTitiH f., anupasTAnaM, avizayaH, asanniDiH m. — (Absence from) virahaH, viyogaH. — (Of mind) amanoyogaH, anyamAnasatvaM, samADiH m. — (In one's absence) parokze.
ABSENCE , s. avarttamAnatA, avidyamAnatA, viprakarzaH, parokzatA. — (Of mind) anavaDAnaM -natA, aprastutalakzatA.

Absent, a. avartamAna, avidyamAna, anupasTita, sTAnAMtaragata. 2 prozita. 3 (In mind) hfdayena asannihita, SUnya-hfdaya-mAnasa; ‘to be a(bsent)’ sTAnAMtare vft 1 A, na upasTA 1 U. [Absent]ee, s. anupasTitaH, pravAsin m. prozitaH. Absence, s. anupasTiti f., asanniDi m. parokzaM, parokzatA. 2 (Non-existence) aBAvaH. 3 virahaH, viyogaH; ‘in oneʼs a(bsence)’ parokze; ‘a(bsence) of mind’ SUnyamanaskatA, SUnyahfdayatvaM, anavaDAnaM, vigatacetanatvaM.
ABSENT: (adj.) I Not present:(1) anupasTitaH (tA, taM);(2) avidyamAnaH (nA, naM);(3) avartamAnaH (nA, naM).II Heedless: q. v.: anyamanaskaH (skA, skaM).
ABSENT, BE: i. e. To be abroad: pra-vasati (vas, c. 1.).

ABSENT , a. (Not present) avarttamAnaH -nA -naM, avidyamAnaH -nA -naM, parokzaH -kzA -kzaM, sTAnAntaraNgataH -tA -taM, anupasTitaH -tA -taM, anupasTAyI -yinI -yi (n), asamakzaH -kzA -kzaM, apratyakzaH -kzA -kzaM. — (Abroad) prozitaH -tA -taM. — (Absorbed in meditation) samAhitaH -tA -taM. — (Thinking of something else) anyamAnasaH -sI -saM or -manAH -nAH -naH (s), SUnyahfdayaH -yA -yaM.
To be ABSENT , v. n. anyatra, or sTAnAntare, or asAkzAt vft (c. 1. varttate, varttituM) or as (c. 2. asti).
ABSENT , a. (In mind) anavahitaH -tA -taM, anyahfdayaH -yA -yaM, BrAntahfdayaH &c., atanmanaskaH -skA -skaM, aprastutalakzaH, anyAsaktacittaH -ttA -ttaM.
ABSENT-MINDED: SUnyahfdayaH (yA, yaM), Sa. IV
ABSENTEE: I One temporarily absent: anupasTitaH (tA, taM): v. Absent.II One being abroad:(1) prozitaH (tA, taM);(2) pravAsin (f. nI).
ABSENTEE , s. prozitaH, pravAsI m. (n), adeSasTaH.

Absolute, a. saMpUrRa, paryApta. 2 nitya, parama. 3 (Not relative) kevala, mAtraka, ananyasaMbadDa. 4 parama, uttama, SrezWa. 5 aniyata, niryaMtraRa, svADInaH ‘a(bsolute) king’ samrAj m., aDirAjaH. [Absolute]ly, adv. sarvaTA, sarvaSaH, kevalaM, ekAMtataH.

ABSOLUTE (adj.): I Perfect: q. v.:(1) nityaH (tyA, tyaM) (=eternal, sometimes used with the same force): it is admitted by all assertors of final emancipation that it is a. nityaSca mokzaH sarvErmIkzavAdiBirupagamyate, S. I. 4.;(2) paramaH (mA, maM) (=excellent, q. v.).II Unconditional, uncontrolled: q. v.: Ph.: for fate has a. power sarvaTA pramavati hi magavAn viDiH, K. iii. Not relative: kevalaH (lA, laM) (?) the recent philosophy of a. the *ADunika- kEvalyadarSanam or -viYjAnam.

ABSOLUTE , a. (Complete) sampUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, samAptaH -ptA -ptaM, samagraH -grA -graM, paryyAptaH -ptA -ptaM. — (Not relative, simple) mAtrakaH -kA -kaM, kevalaH -lA -laM. — (Sovereign, paramount) paramaH -mA -maM, uttamaH -mA -maM. — (An absolute king) aDirAjaH, samrAw (j).
ABSOLUTE , a. (Despotic) svADInaH -nA -naM, svAyattaH -ttA -ttaM, aparADInaH &c. — (Unconditional) pratibanDahInaH -nA -naM, nizpratibanDaH &c.
ABSOLUTELY: i. e. Entirely: (1) sarvaTA;(2) ekAntatas.
ABSOLUTELY , adv. (Entirely) sarvvaSas, kevalaM.
ABSOLUTION: I Acquittal: q. v.II Religious a.:(1) nistAraH;(2) nizkftiH; (3) udDAraH.
ABSOLUTION , s. pApamocanaM, pApakzamA, nizkftiH f., kzamA, muktiH f.
Absolve, v. t. (pApAt &c.) muc 6 P or c., udDf 1 P, 10; pApaM-aparADaM-kzam 1 A. Absolution, s. pApamukti f., kzamA. 2 mukti f., mokzaH, niHSreyasaM, apavargaH, nirvARaM, Sreyas n., kEvalyaM.
ABSOLVE: I To acquit, exonerate: q. v.: mocayati (c. of muc).II In religious sense: (1) niz-tArayati (c. of tF,);(2) ud-Darati (Df, c. i.).

To ABSOLVE , v. a. (To acquit of a crime) pApAt muc (c. 6. muYcati -te, moktuM), vimuc, or in caus. (mocayati -yituM), pApaM kzam (c. 1. kzamate, kzantuM), aparADaM kzam; ‘he is absolved from crime,’ duzkftAt pUyate.
ABSOLVED , p. p. pApamuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
Absonant, a. visaMvAdin, viroDin.

details.body: Absorb, v. t. ut-, Suz c., nigF 6 P, Acam 1 P, ni-A-pA 1 P. 2 gras 1 A, AtmADIna a. kf 8 U; vyApf c., AsaMj c. [Absorb]ed, a. ni-, magna, Asakta, nirata, lIna, vyApfta, para, parAyaRa, in comp. 2 nipIta. Absorption, s. nipAnaM, SozaRaM; ‘a(bsorption) into the supreme soul’ mokzaH, nirvARaM; brahmaRi layaH, ISvarasAyujyaM.

ABSORB (v. t.): I To imbibe, suck up: (1) cUzati (cUz, c. i.);(2) Sozayati (c. of Suz) (=dry up).II Fig.: To engross: (1) majjati, ni-, (masj, c. 6.), old men are a. ed. in thoughts and none clings to the supreme spirit vfdDastAvaccintAmagnaH parame brahmaRi ko'pi na lagnaH; (2) viSati, aBiniviSate (viS, c. 6.) (with acc.) [not so forcible as (1)] became a. ed in thought cintAM viveSa, K.
To ABSORB , v. a. nipA (c. 1. -pivati, -pAtuM), utpA; Suz in caus. (Sozayati -yituM), ucCuz, upaSuz; gras (c. 1. grasate, grasituM), upagras.

ABSORBED , p. p. (Absorbed in any occupation) nirataH -tA -taM, nivizwaH -zwA -zwaM, parAyaRaH -RA -RaM, AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (In medita- tion) samAhitaH -tA -taM, ekAgraH -grA -graM; (Drunk in) nipItaH -tA -taM, grastaH -stA -staM.
ABSORPTION: (1) cozaRam;(2) cUzA;(3) nipAnam;(4) SozaRam.
ABSORPTION , nipAnaM, SozaRaM, grasanaM.
ABSORPTION , s. (Into the Deity) muktiH f., mokzaH, nirvARaM.

Abstain, v. i. nivft 1 A (abl.), pari-vi-vfj 10 (acc.); ‘has a(bstain)ed from eating flesh’ nivfttamAMso janakaH (U. 4). 2 viram 1 P (abl.); ‘a(bstain) from food’ upavas 1 P. Abstinence, s. nivftti f. 2 upavAsaH, alpAhAraH, AhAraniyamaH. 3 saMyamanaM, jiteMdriyatvaM. Abstinent, a. upavAsin. 2 jiteMdriya, saMyatAtman; vaSin.

ABSTAIN (v. i.): (1) vi-ramati (ram, c. 1.), a. from this dirty work virama karmaRo'smAnmalImasAt, D. iv.;(2) ni-vartayati (c. of vft) (with acc.), a. yourself from this unlucky affair nivarta- yAsmAdasadIpsitAnmanaH, Ku. v. 73.;(3) ni-vartate (vft, c. i.): nivfttamAMsastu tatraBavAn janakaH, U. IV.
ABSTAIN from food: upa-vasati (vas, c. 1.): v. To fast.
To ABSTAIN , v. n. nivft (c. 1. -varttate -varttituM) with abl.; as, ‘he abstains from eating flesh,’ nivarttate mAMsaBakzaRAt; vfj in caus. (varjayati -yituM), parivfj, vivfj with acc.
Abstemious, a. mitAhAra, alpAhArin, alpASana, mitaBuj. [Abstemious]ness, s. mitAhAraH, mitaBojanaM, alpAhAraH.
ABSTEMIOUS: (1) mitAhAraH (rA, raM);(2) mitASanaH (nA, naM);(3) mitaBuj (mfn); (4) laDvAhAraH (rA, raM);(5) laDvASin (f. nI); (6) yatAhAraH (rA,).

ABSTEMIOUS , a. alpAhArI -riRI -ri (n), aBojI -jinI -ji (n), mitASanaH -nA -naM, mitaBuk m. f. n. (j), parimitAhAraH -rA -raM, niyatA- hAraH -rA -raM, yatAhAraH -rA -raM, laDvASI -SinI -Si (n), laDvAhAraH -rA -raM.
ABSTEMIOUSLY: (1) mitAhAreRa;(2) mitASanena; (3) laDvAhAreRa.
ABSTEMIOUSNESS: (1) mitAhAraH;(2) mita- Bojanama;(3) mitASanam.
ABSTEMIOUSNESS , s. AhAraparityAgaH, alpAhAritvaM.
Abstersion, s. SudDIkaraRaM.

ABSTINENCE: I In gen. sense, refraining from:(1) nivfttiH;(2) viratiH;(3) kzAntiH. II From food:(1) upavAsaH;(2) anaSanam; v. Fasting.III From the gratification of animal propensities:(1) saMyamanama; (2) yamaH
ABSTINENCE , s. (Abstaining from food) upavAsaH, aBojanaM. — (Re- straint of the passions) jitendriyatvaM, saMyamanaM, saMyAmaH. — (Forbear- ance from any thing) nivfttiH f., kzAntiH, f.
ABSTINENCE , s. alpAhAraH, alpaBojanaM, AhAraniyamaH, saMyamaH.
ABSTINENT: I From food:(1) yatAhAraH (rA, raM): v. Abstemious.II In a winder sense: saMyamin (f. nI): v. Continent.
ABSTINENT , a. (Temperate) jitendriyaH -yA -yaM, nivfttarAgaH -gA -gaM, saMyamI -minI -mi (n), saMyatAtmA -tmA -tma (n). — (Fasting) upavAsI -sinI -si (n).

Abstract, v. t. saMkzip 6 P, saMhf 1 P. 2 AdA 3 A, apa-ava-kfz 1 P, apahf 1 P. s. sAraH, saMgrahaH, saMkzepaH. a. viBinna; kevala; amUrta. 2 AnvIkzika (kI f.), nigUQa. [Abstract]edly, [Abstract]ly, adv. viviktaM. 2 kevalaM, mAtraM. [Abstract]ion, s. samADiH, praRiDAnaM, DyAnEkAgratA. 2 apaharaRaM, AdAnaM. 3 viBedaH, pfTakkaraRaM.
ABSTRACT (v. t.): I To separate: q. v.: vi-yojayati (c. of yuj).II To filch away, steal: q. v.: apa-harati (hf, c. 1.).III To abridge: q. v.
ABSTRACT (adj.): I Separate: q. v.II As opposed to concrete: perh. sUkzamaH (kzmA, kzmaM): v. Abstruse, refined.

To ABSTRACT , v. a. apahf (c. 1. -harati -te -harttuM), vyapahf; apakfz (c. 1. -karzati, c. 6. -kfzati -krazwuM), apAkfz, avakfz, vyapakfz; AdA (c. 3. -datte -dAtuM), upAdA, aByAdA. — (To reduce to an epitome) saNkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), saMhf.

ABSTRACT , a. viBinnaH -nnA -nnaM, viyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, viviktaH -ktA -ktaM, pfTakkftaH -tA -taM, kevalaH -lA -laM — (From material objects) vizayaviviktaH -ktA -ktaM, vizayApakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM — (Metaphysical) AnvIkzikaH -kI -kaM. — (Abstracted in mind) samAhitaH -tA -taM, ananyamanAH -nAH -naH (s).
ABSTRACT , s. (An epitome) saNgrahaH, pratyAhAraH, saNkzepaH, sAraH, vastu n. vastumAtraM. — (An abstract noun) BAvavAcakaH.
ABSTRACTEDLY , ABSTRACTLY, adv. viviktaM, viviktaprakAreRa. — (Simply) kevalaM, mAtraM.
ABSTRACTION: Phil. t. t. *praRiDAnam; padArTAnAma- paraDarmAnanAdftyEkaDarmaM prati praRiDAnam. In gen. sense, v. Stealing, separation, etc.
ABSTRACTION , s. (Taking away) pratyAhAraH, upAdAnaM. — (Sepa- ration) vivekaH, viBedaH, pArTakyaM, pfTakkaraRaM. — (From material ob- jects) vizayaviviktatvaM. — (Of the mind) samADiH m., ekAgratA.
Abstruse, a. gUQa, pracCanna. 2 nigUQa, durjYeya, gUQArTa, asuboDa, durboDa, gahana.
ABSTRUSE: nigUQaH (QA, QaM): v. Recondite, obscure.

ABSTRUSE , a. (Hidden) gUQaH -QA -QaM, guptaH -ptA -ptaM, pracCannaH -nnA -nnaM. — (Remote from apprehension, obscure) nigUQaH -QA -QaM, nigUQArTaH -rTA -rTaM, durjYeyaH -yA -yaM, boDAgamyaH -myA -myaM, kaWinaH -nA -naM.
ABSTRUSENESS: nigUQatA: v. Obscurity.

Absurd, a. anarTaka, ayukta, nyAyavirudDa, anupapanna. [Absurd]ness, [Absurd]ity, s. AnarTakyaM, anupapatti f., asaMgati f.; sometimes ex. by SaSavizARaM, gaganapuzpaM &c. [Absurd]ly, adv. avicAreRa, anupapannaM; ‘do not talk so a(bsurdly)’ kftametAdfSena asaMgatena-anarTakena-pralApena.
ABSURD , a. anarTakaH -kA -kaM, nyAyavirudDaH -dDA -dDaM, vicAravirudDaH -dDA -dDaM, anyAyI -yinI -yi (n).
ABSURDITY: I Want of sense or judgement: (1) AnarTakyam;(2) ayATArTyam;(3) asaNgatiHII An absurd thing: Ph. what a. kaH pramAdaH.
ABSURDITY , s. (That which is absurd) mfzArTakaM, anarTakaM, SaSavizARaM, SaSaSfNgaM, gaganakusumaM, gaganapuzpaM.
ABSURDLY , adv. anyAyatas ind., AnarTakyena, avicAreRa.
ABSURDNESS , s. AnarTakyaM, anyAyatvaM, ayATArTyaM.
ABUNDANCE: (1) prAcuryam;(2) BUyastvam;(3) bAhulyam;(4) praBUtatvam.
ABUNDANCE , s. bAhulyaM, bahutvaM, pracuratvaM.
ABUNDANT: (1) pracuraH (rA, raM);(2) praBUtaH (tA, taM);(3) bahulaH (lA, laM);(4) BUyizWaH (zWA, zWaM);(5) prAjyaH (jyA, jyaM);(6) BUri (mfn); (7) adaBraH (BrA, BraM).
ABUNDANT , a. bahuH -huH or -hvI -hu, bahulaH -lA -laM, pracuraH -rA -raM, BUriH -riH -ri, vipulaH -lA -laM, samaDikaH -kA -kaM.
ABUNDANTLY , adv. bahuSas ind., BUriSas ind., BUyas ind., anekaSas ind.

Abuse, v. t. vfTA-mfzA-anyAyataH pra-vini-yuj 7 A, 10 or vyay 1 P. 2 aDi-A-kuts 10, Barts 10 A, A-aDi-kzip 6 P, aBiSaMs 1 P, apavad 1 U, aBiSap 1 U, apaBAz 1 A. s. AkroSaH, apavAdaH, upAlaMBaH, apaBAzaRaM, niMdA, aDikzepaH, vAkpAruzyaM, paruzokti f. 2 kuprayogaH, apavyayaH, anyAyopayogaH. Abusive, a. niMdaka, AkzeparUkza, niMdAgarBa; ‘a(busive) word’ niMdAtmakavacaH, AkzepavacanaM.

ABUSE (v. t.): I To revile: q. v.: A- kzipati, aDi-, (kzip, c. 6.);(2) A-kroSati (krUS, c. 1.);(3) apa BAzate (BAz, c. 1).II To make ill use of: Ph. a king who a. his rights goes to hell rAjAnyAyamAcarannarakaM gacCati; he a. s his time sa kAlaM vfTA nayati, kzipati, harati, etc.III To violate: q. v. prakurute.
ABUSE (subs): I Ill-use:(1) kuvyavahAraH; (2) durvyavahAraH;(3) kuprayogaH (of word);(4) vfTAharaRaM (of time):II Contumely:(1) aDikzepaH;(2) tiraskAraH;(3) AkroSaH;(4) AkzAraH.

To ABUSE , v. a. (Make ill use of) vfTA or mfzA or anyAyataH prayuj (c. 7. -yuMkte -yoktuM), or in caus. (-yojayati -yituM), kadarTIkf, vyarTIkf, [Page003-b+ 51] vfTAkf. — (Revile) kuts (c. 10. kutsayati -yituM), aBikuts, Akzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), parikzip, AkruS (c. 1. kroSati -krozwuM), samAkruS, tiraskf (c. 8. -karoti, -kurute -karttuM), apavad (c. 1. -vadate -vadituM), avagur (c. 6. gurate, -gurituM), with dat. or loc.; Sap (c. 1. Sapati, c. 4. Sapyati SaptuM), aBiSap, pariSap; Akzar, in caus. (-kzArayati -yituM), muKarIkf, atibrU (c. 2. -bravIti -vaktuM) — (To abuse in return) pratyAkruS.

ABUSE , s. pAruzyaM, aBivAdaH, tiraskAraH, pariBAzaRaM, AkroSaH, vikroSanaM, apakroSaH, nindA, mOKaryyaM, upAlamBaH, jugupsA, -psanaM, vAkpAruzyaM, vAgdozaH, svaloktiH f., nirBartsanaM, durAlApaH, durvvacaH n. (s), paruzavacanaM, paruzoktiH f., (Ill use) kuprayogaH, kuvyavahAraH, durvyavahAraH, kadarTIkaraRaM.
ABUSED , p. p. (Badly employed) ku prayuktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Reviled) AkziptaH -ptA -ptaM, AkruzwaH -zwA -zwaM.
ABUSIVE: Ph. a. language AkzepavacaH; a. writer *parUzaleKakaH.
ABUSIVE , a. nindakaH -kA -kaM, paruzaH -zA -zaM, muKaraH -rA -raM, AkroSakaH -kI -kaM, durvvAdaH -dA -daM, kutsAvAdI -dinI -di (n), vAgduzwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Abut, v. i. avalaMb 1 A, ADA 3 U (Pass.).
To ABUT , v. n. sImAsaMyogaM kf, sImAsanDiM kf, spfS, lag.
Abyss, s. gaBIragartaH, agADabilaM, atalasparSaM KAtaM.
ABYSS: (1) gaBIragartaH;(2) gaBIraranDram;(3) agADabilam.
ABYSS , s. agADadarI f., agADaranDraM, atalasparSaKAtaM, gamBIraranDraM, narakaH.
ACACIA: vfkzaviSezaH; SamI (a. suma); SirIzaH (another species).
ACACIA , s. (Kind of tree) SamI.
ACADEMICAL , a. vidyAlayasambanDI -nDinI &c., maWasambanDI &c.
ACADEMICIAN: *vidvatsaBADizWAtf (f. trI).
Academy, s. vidyAlayaH-yaM. 2 vidvatparizad f.
ACADEMY I A school: q. v. vidyAlayaH. II A society of learned men:(1) vidvatsaBA (?);(2) paRqitasaBA (?). The royal a. *laRqana- nagarasya citrakarasaBAH.
ACADEMY , s. pAWaSAlA, vidyAlayaH, vidyAByAsasTAnaM.
Accede, v. i. anuman 4 A, aMgI-svI-kf 8 U, anujYA 9 U. 2 saM-i 2 P, saMmil 6 P, saM-aBi-gam 1 P.
ACCEDE: anujAnAti (YjA, c. 9): v. To agree, assent.

To ACCEDE , v. n. (To be added to) mil (c. 1. milati, melituM), sami (c. 2. -eti -etuM), saNgam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM). — (To assent) anujYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -nIte -jYAtuM), anuman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM), sammatiM kf.
Accelerate, v. t. tvar c. (tvarayati), ASu saMpad c. or pravft c.
ACCELERATE: tvarayati (c. of tvar): v. To hasten, quicken.
To ACCELERATE , v. a. tvar in caus. (tvarayati -yituM), santvar, pravft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM).
ACCELERATED , p. p. varDitavegaH -gA -gaM, varDitagatiH -tiH -ti, tvaritaH &c.
ACCELERATION: tvarA (?) (Ku. ii. 63): v. Haste.
ACCELERATION , s. vegavarDanaM, vegavfdDiH f., gativarDanaM, gativfdDiH f.
Accent, s. svaraH. 2 AGAtaH, uccAraRacihnaM; ‘human a(ccent)s’ mAnuzI gir f. v. t. sasvaramuccar c. [Accent]ed, a. svarita, udAtta.

ACCENT (subs.): I In speaking: svaraH. The acute a. udAttaH; the grave a. anudAttaH; the circumflex a. svaritaH.II A peculiar tone in speaking svaraH; with distinct articulation and a. atispazwavarRasvarasaMskArayA K.III. An accentual mark: svaracihram (?).IV Language, expre- -ssions: q. v.
ACCENT (v. t.): sasvaram uccArayati (c. of car) (?).
ACCENT , s. (The sound of a syllable) svaraH. — (The manner of speaking) uccAraRaM. — (The mark of a syllable) uccAraRacihnaM, svaracihnaM. — (Acute accent) udAttaH.
To ACCENT , v. a. (To pronounce with a proper accent) sUtrAnusArataH or sUtrAnurUpam uccar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM) or svaroccAraRaM kf.
ACCENTED , p. p. svaritaH -tA -taM, udAttaH -ttA -ttaM.
ACCENTUATE (v. t.): Ph. a. these syllables *ezAmakzarARAM svarAn cihnaya (cihn, c. 10).
To ACCENTUATE , v. a. svarasya upari uccAraRacihUM dA (c. 3. dadAti, dAtuM).
To ACCENTUATE , v. a. svarayuktaM -ktAM kf, sasvaroccAraRaM kf, sasvarapaWanaM kf.
ACCENTUATED , p. p. svaritaH -tA -taM, svarayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, sasvaraH &c.
ACCENTUATION: I In speaking: svaraH.II In writing: svaracihvIkaraRam (?).
ACCENTUATION , s. sasvaroccAraH -raRaM, plutoccAraRaM, svarapAlanaM.

Accept, v. t. pratigrah 9 P, AdA 3 A, pratipad 4 A, prati-iz 6 P, svIkf 8 U. [Accept]able, a. grahaRIya, Adeya. 2 rucira, manorama, priya. [Accept]ance, s. pratipatti f., pratigrahaH, AdAnaM, svIkAraH. [Accept]ation, s. arTaH; ASayaH; ‘usual a(cceptation) of a word’ Sabdasya nirUQArTaH.

ACCEPT (v. t.): (1) gfhvAti, prati-, pari-, (grahva, c. 9): a. ing the benedictions: ASizaH pratigfhvantO, R. i. 44; here we should a. the word aTa in the sense of succession atrATaSabdaH AnantaryArTaH parigfhyate, S. I. i;(2) svIkaroti, N. xiv. 49; (3) aNgIkaroti, let the real Nala a. the garland aNgIkarotu paramArTanalaH sa mAlAM, N. xiii. 53;(4) pratipadyate (pad, c. 4), Si. xv. 22;(5) prati- icCati (iz, c. 6); a. ing presents pratIcCannupAya- nAni, K.
To ACCEPT , v. a. grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, gfhlIte, grahItuM), pratigrah saNgrah, upasaNgrah; AdA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte, -dAtuM), pratIz (c. 6. -icCati -ezwuM), svIkf (c. 8. -karoti -karttuM).
ACCEPTABLE: I Lit.:(1) parigrahaRIyaH (yA, yaM); (2) upAdeyaH (yA, yaM).II Agreeable, pleasant: q. v.:(1) ruciraH (rA, raM);(2) manoYjaH (YjA, YjaM).
ACCEPTABLE, BE: rocate (ruc, c. 1.) (with dat.): v. To please.
ACCEPTABLE , a. gfhyaH -hyA -hyaM, grahaRIyaH -yA -yaM, AdeyaH -yA -yaM, upAdeyaH -yA -yaM, samAdeyaH -yA -yaM. — (Agreeable) ramaRIyaH -yA -yaM, manoramaH -mA -maM, priyaH -yA -yaM.
ACCEPTABLENESS , s. grAhyatvaM, ramaRIyatvaM, priyatA.
ACCEPTABLY: ruciram: v. Agreeably, satis- -factorily.
ACCEPTANCE: (1) parigrahaH;(2) pratigrahaH;(3) svIkaraRam;(4) pratipattiH.
ACCEPTANCE , s. pratigrahaH, parigrahaH, AdAnaM, svIkaraRaM. — (Acceptance of money) DanAdAnaM.

ACCEPTATION: arTaH: v. Meaning. Ph. accor- ding to usual a. the word ‘inheritance’ conveys property over which ownership is created on the demise of the former owner pUrvasvAmyuparame yatra dravye svatvaM tatra nirUQo dAyaSabdaH: Da.
ACCEPTATION , s. (Meaning) arTaH, aBiprAyaH, ASayaH.
ACCEPTED , p. p. gfhItaH -tA -taM, AdattaH -ttA -ttaM.
ACCEPTER: (1) grAhakaH;(2) parigrAhakaH;(3) parigrahItA.
ACCERBITY: kawutA (lit. and fig.): v. Sourness.

Access, s. praveSaH, upasarpaRaM, aBi-upa-gamaH; ‘wishing to gain a(ccess) to the king’ rAjAnaM drazwukAmaH. [Access]ible, a. sulaBa, suKopasarpya, aBi-, gamya, sugama, upasarpaRIya; avasaropasarpaRIyA rAjAnaH (S. 6), sulaBadarSana; ‘nothing is in-a(ccessible) to desires’ manoraTAnAmagatirna vidyate (K. v. 64). [Access]ion, s. yogaH, upagamanaM, milanaM. 2 (to power) rAjapadAvApti f., rAjyaprApti f., siMhAsanArohaRaM. 3 AgamaH, vfdDi f., upacayaH. [Access]ary, [Access]ory, s. sahakArin m., pravartakaH, pApasahAyaH. a. aDika; sahita, saMyukta.

ACCESS: I Admission, interview: q. v. Ph. the asceties want to gain a. to the king tapasvino devaM drazwumicCanti, Sa. v.II The means of a. (1) AgamadvAram;(2) upasarpaRamArgaH, etc.III Sexual intercourse: q. v. aBigamanam.IV Addition: v. Accession: v. A fit of disease: AgamaH: v. Accession.
ACCESS , s. (The way by which any thing may be approached) AgamaH, aBigamaH, upagamaH. — (Increase, addition) vfdDiH f., upacayaH.
ACCESSARY or -ORY, a. (Co-operator) sahakArI -riRI -ri (n). — (To a crime) pApasahAyaH.

ACCESSIBLE: I Of places:(1) gamyaH (myA, myaM);(2) sugamaH (mA, maM).II Of persons: (1) upasarpaRIyaH (yA, yaM). Surely kings are a. only at convenient times nanvavasaropasarpaRIyA rAjAnaH, Sa. vi.;(2) sulaBadarSanaH (nA, naM) (easily seen). Ph.: not a. to bribe or sexual gratification na Dana- strIdAnAdinA BedyaH: K. b.
ACCESSIBLE , a. aBigamyaH -myA -myaM, gamyaH -myA -myaM, sugamaH -mA -maM, -laByaH -ByA -ByaM, sulaBaH -BA -BaM, suKopasarpyaH -rpyA -rpyaM.

ACCESSION: I The act of joining:(1) yogaH; (2) saNgamaH.II A coming to power. Ph. on his a. to the throne rAjyamavApya etc. or siMhAsana- mAruhya.III Increase: q. v. vfdDiH, Ph.: a. of wealth DanAgamaH.IV Of disease:(1) AgamaH; (2) AvirBAvaH;(3) avatAraH.

ACCESSION , s. (Increase by something added) AgamaH, vfdDiH f., upacayaH. — (Accession of wealth) DanAgamaH. — (The act of join- ing one's self to) upagamaH, aBigamanaM, milanaM, upasTitiH f. — (Ac- cession to a throne) rAjyaprAptiH f.
ACCESSORY (subs): (1) sahAyaH;(2) sahakArI; (3) pravartakaH: v. Instigator.
ACCESSORY , a. (Additional) aDikaH -kA -kaM. — (Associated with) sahitaH -tA -taM, or sammilitaH -tA -taM, or saMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
ACCIDENCE: upakramaRikA (?): v. Rudiment.
ACCIDENCE , s. (Rudiments of grammar) vyAkaraRAramBaH, vyAkaraRasya AdiprakaraRagranTaH.

ACCURATELY , adv. yaTArTaM, samyak, ftaM, satyaM, aYjasA, sUkzmatvana.

ACCUSATION: (1) aBiyogaH;(2) apavAdaH; made a false a. against her husband BarturmiTyApavAda- maBihitavatI, Ver;(3) aBiSApaH (=false a.).
ACCUSATION , s. aBiyogaH, dozakalpanaM, apavAdaH. — (False) aBiSaMsanaM, aBiSApaH.
ACCUSATION , s. dozAropaH -paRaM, aparADAropaH -paRaM. — (False) miTyABi- yogaH, miTyABiSaMsanaM.

Accuse, v. t. aBiyuj 7 A, 10, apavad 1 A, aBiSaMs 1 P, aDikzip 6 P, duz c. nArhasi kAmAparADErdevaM dUzayituM (Ka. 235); GAtakaH ayaM iti tamaBiyuyujire ‘they a(ccus)ed him of murder’. [Accus]ation, s. aBiyogaH, apavAdaH, aDikzepaH, aBiSaMsanaM, dUzaRaM. [Accus]er, s. aBiyoktf m., aBiyogin m.
ACCUSE (v. t.): (1) aBi-yunakti (yuj, c. 7), that I go like an a. d man aBiyukta iva prayAmi, Mr. ix.;(2) apa-vadati (vad, c. 1.); v. To calumniate.

To ACCUSE , v. a. aBiyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yoktuM), aBiyogaM kf, aDikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzaptuM), apavad (c. 1. -vadati -vadituM), dozakalpanaM kf, pariSap (c. 1. -Sapati -SaptuM), aBiSap. — (To be accused), aBiyuj in pass. (-yujyate).
ACCUSED , aBiyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, aBiSaptaH -ptA -ptaM, aBiSastaH -stA -staM.
ACCUSER: (1) aBiyoktf (f. trI);(2) aBiyogin (f. nI) (rare.)
ACCUSER , s. aBiyogI m. (n), aBiyoktA m. (ktf), apavAdakaH, parivAdakaH.
Accustom, v. t. aByas 4 P, aByAsaM or vyavahAraM kf 8 U; ‘to be a(ccustom)ed’ aByasta-paricita a. BU 1 P.

ACCUSTOM: (1) paricayaM karoti, a. ed himself in shooting moveable objects paricayaM calalakzyanipAtane ..karoti, R. ix. 49;(2) aByasyati (as, c. 4) v. To practise. Ph.: he who is a. ed to good food *yaH sarvadA BojanaviSezErAhAraM karoti; a. ed to cheating vaYcanAparaH (rA, raM).
To ACCUSTOM , v. a. aByas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), aByAsaM or vyavahAraM kf, Sikz in caus. (Sikzayati -yituM). — (To be accustomed) aByastaH -stA -staM BU.
ACCUSTOMARY , a. AcArikaH -kI -kaM, AcaritaH -tA -taM, vyAvahArikaH -kI -kaM, vyavahArAnurUpaH -pA -paM, svABAvikaH -kI -kaM.
ACCUSTOMED , p. p. aByastaH -stA -staM, SikzitaH -tA -taM.
Ace, s. ekabiMduH. 2 aRuH, lavaH, ‘within an a(ce) of’ Asanna a.
ACE: Of cards: *wekvA. Ph.: within an a. of piercing: *alpena vedDuM na SaSAka.
ACE , s. (On cards or dice) mudrAviSezaH. — (Within an ace, all but) prAyas, yatkiYcin nyUnaM, IzadUnaM. — ‘All but dead,’ mftakalpaH.
Acerb, a. tuvara, kawu, amla. [Acerb]ate, v. t. amlIkf 8 U. [Acerb]ity, s. kawutA, amlatA; ‘a(cerbity) of temper’ svaBAvaparuzatA, rukzatA.
ACERBITY , s. kawutA, amlatA, SuktatA. — (Sharpness of temper) svaBAvakawutA, aruntudatvaM.
Acetify, v. t. amlIkf 8 U.
Ache, s. vedanA, pIqA, vyaTA; ‘head-a(che)’ SirovedanA; ‘I have a strong head-a(che)’ balavatI SirovedanA mAM bADate; ‘tooth-a(che)’ daMtavedanA. v. i. pIq pass., vyaT 1 A; See Pain.
ACHE (subs): (1) pIqA;(2) vedanA;(3) vyaTA v. Head- a. etc.
ACHE (v. i.): (1) vyaTate (vyaT, c. 1);(2) pIqayate (c. of pIq). Ph. my head a. s Sirovedana mAM bADate. Mu. iii.
ACHE , s. vedanaM -nA, pIqA, vyaTA. — (Headache) SirovedanA. — (Tooth- ache) dantavedanA.
To ACHE , v. n. pIq in pass. (pIqyate), vyaT (c. 1. vyaTate, vyaTituM).
Achieve, v. t. samAp c., saMpad c., nirvft c.; See Accomplish. 2 prAp 5 P, laB 1 A; See Get. [Achieve]ment, s. nizpatti f., sADanaM. 2 parAkramaH, vikramaH, avadAtaM karmacezwitaM, vikrAMtacaritaM.
ACHIEVE (v. t.): (1) sADayati (c. of sAD) (2) nizpAdayati (c. of pad): v. To accomplish.

To ACHIEVE , v. a. (To perform, finish) samAp in caus. (-Apayati -yituM), sampad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM), siD in caus. (sADayati -yituM). — (To obtain) prAp (c. 5. -Apnoti -AptuM), samAp, samprAp.
ACHIEVEMENT: I Exploit: q. v.(1) avadAnam measured by your a. avadAnasammitAM, Sa. vii. (2) karman (n); v. Deed.II In heraldry v. Escutcheon.
ACHIEVEMENT , s. (A noble exploit) praSaMsanIyakarmma n. (n), cezwitaM, caritraM. — (In heraldry) padacihnaM.
ACHROMATIC: *avarRaH (rRA, rRaM): a. telescope *avarRaM dUravIkzaRaM yena tejoviSlezeRa raktapItAdyAdimavaRe na dfSyate.

ACID: I adj. amla: (mlA, mlaM).II Subs.: amlaH.
ACID , a. amlaH -mlA -mlaM, SuktaH -ktA -ktaM, SOktaH -kI -ktaM, SOktikaH -kI -kaM.

ACIDITY , s. amlatA -tvaM, amlaBAvaH, SuktatA. — (Of stomach) amlapittaH.
To ACIDULATE , v. a. amlIkf; amlay (nom. amlayati -yituM).
ACIDULATED , p. p. amlAktaH -ktA -ktaM, amlIkftaH -tA -taM.
ACIDUOUS: IzadamlaH (mlA, mlaM) (?)
ACITABLE , a. kzoBaRIyaH -yA -yaM, manTanIyaH -yA -yaM, cAlanIyaH -yA -yaM.

Acknowledge, v. t. aByupagam 1 P, aByupa-i 2 P, pratipad 4 A, aMgIkf 8 U, svIkf; grah 9 P. [Acknowledge]ment, s. svIkAraH, aByupagamaH, aMgI-svI-kAraH, pratipatti f. 2 (receipt) abyupagamaleKaH-patraM, nistAraleKaH.

ACKNOWLEDGE (v. t.): (1) aByupa-eti (i. c. 2) she a. defeat from me mattaH parAjayo'ByupetaH, D. ii.;(2) aByupa-gacCati (gam, c. 1): I a. I am just so aByupagataM tAvadasmABirevaMviDA eva vayam, Sa. v.;(3) svIkaroti, D. s.;(4) aMgIkaroti, if one would not a. the authority of inference yadi kaScitprAmARyamanumAnasya nANgIkuryAt, D. s.;(5) prati- padyate (pad, c. 4.), M. viii. 183.
To ACKNOWLEDGE , v. a. aBijYA (c. 1. -jAnAti -nIte -jYAtuM), pratyaBijYA, samaBijYA, pratijYA; svIkf, aNgIkf, anuBAp (c. 1. -BAzate -BAzituM).
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: (1) svIkAraH;(2) aByupa- gamaH;(3) aByupAyaH;(4) aNgIkAraH.
ACKNOWLEDGMENT , s. svIkAraH, aNgIkAraH, pratyaBijYAnaM. — (Of a fault) svapApasvIkAraH.
Acme, s. parA kAzWA-kowi f.
ACME: parA kowiH: the a. of joy parAM kowi- mAnandasya, K.
ACONITE: A poison: vatsanABaH.
ACONITE , s. (A poison) vatsanABaH, prARahArakaM.
ACORN , s. prasidDavfkzasya PalaM.
Acoustic, a. Srutivizayaka, SravaRasaMbaMDin. Acoustics, s. DvanividyA-SAstraM.
ACOUSTIC: (1) SrOtaH (tI, taM);(2) Comp. with Srotra-.
ACOUSTIC , a. SravaRasambanDI -nDinI &c., SrutivizayakaH -kA -kaM.
ACOUSTICS: *SabdavidyA.
ACOUSTICS , s. pl. DvanividyA, SravaRavizayakA vidyA.

Acquaint, v. t. buD c., jYA c. (jYApayati), nivid c. (with dat.), gfhItArTa or parigfhItArTa a. kf 8 U; ‘the queen was made a(cquaint)ed with your immodesty’ Bavato'vinayamaMtareRa parigfhItArTA kftA devI (M. 4). 2 paricayaM kf, aByas 4 P. [Acquaint]ance, s. parijYAnaM; paricayaH, jYAnaM. 2 mitraM, paricitaH; ‘old a(cquintance)’ ciraMtanaM mitraM, ciraparicitaH. 3 saMsargaH, saMstavaH. [Acquaint]ed, a. paricita, aByasta; aBijYa, aByaMtara; anaByaMtare AvAM madanagatasya vfttAMtasya (S. 3).

ACQUAINT (v. t.): I To make familiar: parIcayaM karoti (kf, c. 8) A-carati (car, c. 1), making himself a. ed with all sciences sarvavidyA- paricayamAcarataH, K.II. To inform: q. v. boDayati, ava-, (c. of buD), you should keep me a. ed with whatever happens there everyday pratyahaYca yadyattatra vfttAntaM jAtaM tadasmi tvayAvaboDyaH, D. iii.
To ACQUAINT , v. a. jYA in caus. (jYApayati -yituM), vijYA; buD in caus. (boDayati -yituM), prabuD, pratibuD, avabuD, nivid in caus. (-vedayati -yituM).

ACQUAINTANCE: I Familiar knowledge:(1) paricayaH, out of respect for his a. with all practical arts sakalakalAkalApaparicayabahumAnena, K. ;(2) saMstavaH (rare): v. Knowledge, intimacy.II A person known;(1) paricitaH (tA, taM), like old a. s ciraparicitAviva, D. iii.;(2) saMstutaH (tA, taM) Ki. iii. 2.
ACQUAINTANCE , s. paricayaH. — (Knowledge) jYAnaM, parijYAnaM. — (An ac- quaintance, friend) mitraM, saMsargI m. (n), viBAvaH. — (Familiarity) saMsargaH, saMstavaH.
ACQUAINTED , paricitaH -tA -taM, saMstutaH -tA -taM. — (Known) jYAtaH -tA -taM.

ACQUAINTED WITH: aBiYjaH (YjA, YjaM) (with gen.), I am not a. with such affairs evaM viDAnAM vfttAntAnA- manamiYjAsmi; K. : Ph. we are not a. with love affairs anaByantarA Kalu vayaM madanagatasya vfttAntasya, Sa. iii.
Acquiesce, v. i. anuman 4 A, anujYA 9 U, saMmatiM dfS c. [Acquiesc]ence, s. saM-anu-mati f.
To ACQUIESCE , v. n. tuz (c. 1. tuzyati tozwuM), santup with inst. or loc. — (In an opinion) sammatiM kf. — (To assent) anuman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM), anujYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM).
ACQUIESCENCE: sammatiH: v. Assent.
ACQUIESCENCE , s. tuzwiH f., paritozaH, santozaH, sammatiH f., anumatiH f., SAntiH f. — (Submission) kzAntiH f.
ACQUIRABLE , a. prApyaH -pyA -pyaM, laByaH -ByA -ByaM.
Acquire, v. t. arj 1 P, laB 1 A, samAsad c., avAp 5 P, pratipad 4 A, aS 5 A, aDigam 1 P; See Get. [Acquire]ment, Acquisition, s. arjanaM, prApti f., lABaH, aDigamaH. 2 guRaH, jYAnaM.
ACQUIRE (v. t.): (1) arjati, upa-, (arj, c. 1) or commonly, upArjanaM karoti (with gen.); (2) aDi-gacCati (gam, c. 1), to a. fame yaSoDi- gantum, Ki. iii. 40. v. To gain, obtain.

To ACQUIRE , v. a. arj (c. 1. arjati arjituM), upArj, laB (c. 1. laBate labDuM), upalaB, prAp (c. 5. -Aproti -AptuM), avAp; pratipad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), aS (c. 5. aSnute, aSituM), upAS samaS; AviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), samAviS.
ACQUIRED , p. p. prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, labDaH -bDA -bDaM, ApannaH -nnA -nnaM, arjjitaH -tA -taM, upArjjitaH -tA -taM.
ACQUIREMENT: I The act of acquiring(1) arjanam, upArjanam, by the a. of knowledge vidyopArjanena, P. i. p.;(2) aDigamaH;(3) lABaH; (4) avAptiH.II Of knowledge: v. Attain- -ment.
ACQUISITION: I Acquirement: q. v.II The thing acquired lABaH v. Gain.

ACQUISITION or ACQUIREMENT, s. lABaH, labDiH f., arjjanaM, prAptiH f., avAptiH f., samprAptiH f., pratipattiH f., grahaRaM. — (The thing gained) AgamaH. — (Acquirement of knowledge) vidyAprAptiH f., vidyArjjanaM, vidyAgamaH. — (Acquisition of property) DanArjjanaM. — (Various acquirement) vipratipattiH f.

Acquit, v. t. (pApAt-dozAt) muc c., vi-muc c., nistF c., SuD c.; ‘he was a(cquit)ted’ sa nirdozaH kftaH, pApavimukto'manyata; ‘a(cquit) oneself’ karma nirvah c., Acar 1 P; ‘they a(cquit)ted themselves well’ te svakarma sADu niravAhayan-Acaran. [Acquitt]al, s. mukti-SudDi f., mocanaM. [Acquit]ance, s. nistAraH, ‘a(cquitance) of debt’ fRaniryAtanaM-pariSoDanaM.
ACQUIT (v. i.): (1) muYcati (muc, c. 6.);(2) mocayati (c. of. muc);(3) nistArayati (c. of tF) (?)
To ACQUIT , v. a. pApAt muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM), vimuc, or in caus. (mocayati -yituM), SuDa in caus. (SoDayati -yituM), nistf in caus. (-tArayati -yituM).
ACQUIT ONESELF: A-carati (car, c. 1.): v. To conduct.
ACQUITTAL: (1) muktiH;(2) mocanam;(3) mokzaH.
ACQUITTAL , s. SudDiH f., SoDanaM, muktiH f., mokzaH.
ACQUITTANCE: I Of debt:(1) pariSoDaH;(2) niryAtanam.II A receipt: q. v.
ACQUITTANCE , s. nistAraH, AnfRyaM, nizkftiH f.
ACQUITTED , p. p. SudDaH -dDA -dDaM, muktaH -ktA -ktaM.
ACRE: BUmAnaviSezaH.
Acrid, Acrimonious, a. kawu, ugra, tIkzRa-aruMtuda. Acrimony, s. kawutA, tIkzRatA. Acritude, s. kawutvaM. 2 vAkpAruzyaM.
ACRID (adj.): kawuH (wvI, wu): v. Pungent, sharp, acrimonious.
ACRID , ACRIMONIOUS, a. kawuH -wuH or -wvI -wu, ugraH -grA -graM, aruntudaH -dA -daM, praKaraH -rA -raM.
ACRIMONIOUS: (1) kawuH (wvI, wu);(2) ugraH (grA, graM);(3) praKaraH (rA, raM).
ACRIMONIOUSNESS, ACRIMONY: (1) kawutvam;(2) prAKaryam;(3) ugratvam.
ACRIMONY , s. kawutA, ugratvaM, prAKaryyaM. — (Of temper) svaBAvakawutA.
Acrobat, s. kalAyanaH, sUtrAyaRaH.
Across, prep. pAraM, tIrAMtaraM, in comp.; ‘a(cross) the ocean’ sAgarapAraM. 2 vyatyasta a.; ‘with legs a(cross)’ vyatyastapAda a.; ‘to come a(cross)’ laB 1 A, aDigam 1 P; See Get.
ACROSS (adv.): (1) vyatyastaH (stA, staM);(2) koRAkoRi (?)
ACROSS (prep.): Ph. I will go a. the river. nadI- pAraM gamizyAmi; a bridge has been laid a. the Son *Sonasyopari seturbabanDe.
ACROSS , adv. (To the other side) pAraM; tIrAntaraM; as, ‘across the sea, samudrapAraM. — (Transversely) vyatyastaM. — (With hands across) vyatyastapARinA.
ACROSTIC: Nearest word citrakAvyam, Kav. i. 8.; *AdyAkzarabanDaH.
ACROSTIC , s. SlokaviSezaH.
ACROSTIC , s. AdyAkzarabanDaH, praTamAkzarabanDaH, pUrvvAkzarabanDaH.

Act, v. i. vft 1 A, Aryo'smin vinayena vartatAM (U. 6), vyavahf 1 P, Acar 1 P, (with loc. of person); ayamAcaratyavinayaM tapasvikanyAsu (S. 1) ‘a(ct)s rudely towards’ &c. 2 cezw 1 A, viDA 3 U, kf 8 U. 3 sTAne'DikAraM kf. 4 Pal 1 P, guRaM Avah 1 P; kAryaM kf; ‘fire a(ct)s like water’ agnirjalAyate; sa kfzRAyate &c.; ‘a(ct) up to’ anuvft 1 A; anuruD 4 A, sTA 1 P, SAsane tizWa BartuH (V. 5). v. t. naw 10, nirUp 10, aBinI 1 P; prayuj 10; oft. by denom.; ‘a(ct)ing the part of Lakshmī’ lakzmIBUmikAyAM vartamAnA (V. 3); nfpAyate ‘a(ct)s the king’; ‘a(ct) the part of a dear friend towards your rivals’ kuru priyasaKIvfttiM sapatnIjane (S. 4). s. karman n., kfti f., kriyA, caritaM, cezwitaM. 2 aMkaH. 3 vyavasTA, viDiH. [Act]ion, s. kriyA, vyApAraH, cezwitaM &c.; pravftti f.; kAraRaM. 2 aBiyogaH, vyavahArakAryaM, kAryaM, arTaH. 3 saMgrAmaH, yudDaM; See Fight. 4 aMgavikzepaH, hastAdyaBinayaH, ‘in a(ction), thought and speech’ karmaRA manasA vAcA, manovAkkAyakarmaBiH. [Act]ionable, a. aBiyojya, vyavahArya. Active, a. udyogin, karmodyukta, analasa, sodyoga, sotsAha, vyavasAyin. 2 kziprakArin, ataMdra, kziprakarman. 3 vyAyAmaSIla, vyAyAmin. 4 utTAnayogya, utTAnayogyaM vapuH (S. 2); ‘a(ctive) voice’ kartfvAcyam. [Activ]ity, s. udyogitA, vyavasAyaH, kziprakAritA. 2 utsAhaH. 3 utTAnayogyatA. [Active]ly, adv. sodyogaM, sotsAhaM. [Act]or, s. kartf m.; kArin m.; kArakaH, in comp. 2 nawaH, nartakaH, kuSIlavaH, aBinetf m., SElUzaH. Actress, s. nawI, nartakI. Actual, a. vAstavika (kI f.), taTya, satya, vAstava (vI f.), yaTArTa, paramArTa. [Actual]ly, adv. sAkzAt, pratyakzaM. 2 paTArTataH, paramArTataH, vastutaH, arTataH, vastuvfttena; ‘what a(ctually) took place’ yadyad vfttaM; oft. ex. by eva only.

ACT (v. t.): I To do, perform: q. v.II On the stage:(1) aBinayati (nI, c. 1), Sa. 1.;(2) pra-yojayati (yuj, c. 10), we should a. Malabikagnimitra in this spring festival mAlavikAgnimitramasmin vasantotsave prayoktavyam, Mal.; (3) nAwayati (naw, c. 10.), Ma. i.: Ph. Urbashi a. ing the part of Lakshmi. lakzmIBUmi- kAyAM vartamAnorvaSI, V. iii. N. B. The sense of a. ing is often expressed by nomi. v. s.: a. the nymph apsarAyate.

ACT (v. i.): I To be in action: karoti (kf, c. 8): this is not possible that one a. s and another enjoys na hye tat samBavizyatyanyaH karotyanyaH BuNkta iti, D. s.II To conduct oneself:(1) Acarati (car, c. 1): the king has a. ed very ungentlemanly towards Sakuntala tena rAjYA Saku- ntalAyAmanAryamAcaritam, Sa. iv. v. To behave; (2) by nominal verbs: to a. as. a step-mother sapatnAyate; to a. as a tutor gurUyate; to a. like yourself tvadyate.III On the stage: aBinayati (nI, c. 1) v. Act (v. t.) (II).
ACT (subs): I A deed: q. v.:(1) karman (n);(2) kriyA;(3) kftam.II A division of a play: aNka (mn.)III A law: *viDiH Ph.: the last act of life: (jIvanasya) caramadaSA.

To ACT , v. n. cezw (c. 1. cezwate, cezwituM), vicezw, saYcezw, kf (c. 8. karoti, kurute, karttuM), viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM). — (To conduct one's self) vyavahf (c. 1. -harati -te -harttuM), Acar (c. 1. -carati -carituM) — (As a stage-player) naw (c. 1. nawati, nawituM).

To ACT , v. a. (To feign by action) naw (c. 10. nAwayati -yituM); as, ‘Acting the sentiment of love,’ SfNgAraBAvaM nAwayantI; rUp (c. 10. rUpayati -yituM), aBinayaM kf. The sense of acting a part may be expressed by nominal verbs; as, ‘he acts the king,’ rAjAyate. — (To assume disguise) CadmaveSaM kf.
ACT , s. (A deed) karmma n. (n), kAryyaM, cezwitaM, kriyA, kftaM, kftyaM, vicezwitaM. — (Of a play) aNkaH, aNkaM. — (A decree) vyavasTA.

ACTION: I Agency: Often not expr: water boils by the a. of heat *vAri tapati tApena. Ph. the a. of the senses indriyARAM vfttiH, Ku. iii. 72; the a. of love madanasya vyApAraH, Sa. i.II Deed, conduct: q. v.(1) cezwitam;(2) vicezwitam. III Gesticulation: q. v. cezwA, M. vii. 63. IV Law suit, cause: q. v. kAryam, Mr. xi. V. An engagement, battle: q. v.: yudDam. VI In plays etc.: *kAryam: there is much a. in the play *kAryaBulaM nAwakam.:

ACTION , s. karmma n. (n), kriyA, kftyA, cezwA, vicezwitaM, pravfttiH f., viDAnaM. — (Agency, operation) kAraRaM. — (The action of the wind) vAtAhatiH f. — (Gesticulation) iNgitaM, aNgahAraH, aNgavikzepaH. — (An action in law) aBiyogaH, arTaH — (Fight, battle) yudDaM, saNgrAmaH, samaraH, saMyugaH.
ACTIONABLE: (1) vyavahAryaH (ryA, ryaM),;(2) vyavaha- rtavyaH (vyA, vyaM): a. subject vyavahArapadaM, M.
ACTIONABLE , a. (In law) aBiyojyaH -jyA -jyaM, vyavahAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, vyavaharttavyaH -vyA -vyaM.

ACTIVE (adj.): I Agile, nimble:(1) utTAna- SIlaH [Page010] (lA, laM);(2) utsAhin (f. nI) (=zealous); (3, 4) kziprakArin, ASukArin (f. RI) (=one who does quick);(5) tIkzRa- karman (mfn) (sharp worker);(6) atandritaH (tA, taM) (=not slow).II Busy, industri- -ous; q. v.;(1) karmizWaH (zWA, zWaM)(2) vyavasAyin (f. nI)III In gram.; Ph. a. verb skarmakakriyA; a. voice kartfvAcyam. —IV As opposed to passive: Ph. a. organs karmendriyARi (n. pl.); entered into a. life saMsArakArye vyApftaH (tA, taM) (?)

ACTIVE , a. (Engaged in action) udyogI -ginI -gi (n), prayatnavAn -vatI -vat (t), udyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, karmmodyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, analasaH -sA -saM, sayatnaH -tnA -tnaM, vyavasAyI -yinI -yi (n), karmmI -rmmiRI -rmmi (n), sotsAhaH -hA -haM, sodyogaH -gA -gaM, karmmanizWaH -zWA -zWaM. — (Nimble) tIkzRakarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), ASukArI -riRI -ri (n), laGu -GuH -Gu, tvaritaH -tA -taM, satvaraH -rA -raM, atandraH -ndrA -ndraM. — (Having motion) gatvaraH -rA -raM. — (Active voice) parasmEpadaM, karttfvAcyaH. — (A verb in the active voice) karttari vAcyaM, makarmmakakiyA. — (Fond of manly exercise) vyAyAmaSIlaH -lA -la, vyAyAmI

ACTIVITY (subs.): I Agility,:(1) kziprakAritA; (2) utsAhaH v. Zeal.II Industry and energy:(1) udyogaH;(2) vyavasAyaH;(3) avyavasAyaH;(4) karmABiniveSaH;(5) utTAnaSIlatA. Ph. with great a. mahatA yatnena.
ACTIVITY , s. karmmodyogaH, sayatnatA, vyavasAyaH, pravfttiH f., pravarttanaM. — (Manly exercise) vyAyAmaH. — (Active life) pravfttiH f. — (With activity) prayatnatas ind.
ACTOR: I A doer: q. v.: kartf (m).II A stage player:(1) nawaH;(2) nartakaH;(3) kuSIlavaH;(4) cAraRaH;(5) SElUzaH;(6) aBinetf (m);(7) raNgAjIvaH;(8) SElAlin (m) (rare).
ACTOR , s. (Stage-player) nawaH, narttakaH, kuSIlavaH, cAraRaH, raNgajIvakaH, raNgAjIvaH, aBinetA m. (tf), SElAlI m. (n), kfSASvI m. (n). — (He that acts or does) kArI m. (n), kArakaH, kAraH.
ACTRESS: (1) nawI;(2) nartakI;(3) aBinetrI.
ACTRESS , s. narttakI, nawI, cAraRadArAH pl.
ACTUAL: (1) yaTArTaH (rTA, rTaM);(2) Comp. with paramArTaM: v. Real, true.
ACTUAL , a. (True, real) taTyaH -TyA -TyaM, vAstavaH -vI -vaM, vAstavikaH -kI -kaM, satyaH -tyA -tyaM, vidyamAnaH -nA -naM.
ACTUALITY: (1) yaTArTatA;(2) tattvam: v. Realty.
ACTUALLY: (1) paramArTataH;(2) yaTArTataH: v. Really, truely.
ACTUALLY , adv. vastutas ind., arTatas ind., kAryyatas ind., kAryyavat.
ACTUARY: leKakaH (?) v. Clerk, Registrar.
ACTUARY , s. leKakaH, vyavasTAracakaH.
Actuate, v. t. prer 10, protsah c., pravft c., praRud 6 P; See Prompt.
ACTUATE: pra-Rudati (nud, c. 6): v. To move, impel, influence.
To ACTUATE , v. a. pravft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), prer (c. 10. prerayati -yituM).
ACTUATED , p. p. pravarttitaH -tA -taM, preritaH &c. See INFLUENCED.
Acumen, s. matisUkzmatA, vidagDatA.
ACUMEN: (1) sUkzmadarSitA;(2) kuSAgrabudDiH: v. Sagacity.
ACUMEN , s. (Quickness of intellect) budDisUkzmatA, matiprakarzaH, vidagDatA, kuSAgrIyamatitvaM.
ACUMINATED , tIkzRAgraH -grA -graM, aMSumAn -matI -mat (t).

Acute, a. ni-, Sita, tIkzRa; ‘a(cute) pain’ dAruRa-tIvra-vedanA. 2 sUkzmamati, vidagDa. [Acute]ly, adv. tIvraM, tIkzRaM. [Acute]ness, s. tIkzRatA, tejas n. 2 vidagDatA; ‘a(cuteness) of intellect’ kuSAgrabudDi f.

ACUTE (adj.): I In intellect:(1) sUkzmadarSina (f. nI);(2) kuSAgrabudDi (mfn.), R. v. 4.: v. Subtle, shrewd, keen.II Of the senses tikzRaH (kzRA, kzRaM): v. Sharp, penetrating. III Sharp, pointed: q. v.: Ph. a. angle: v. Angle: a. accent udAttaH; a. pain tIvravedanA.
ACUTE , a. (In intellect) sUkzmabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, vidagDaH -gDA -gDaM, kuSAgrIyamatiH -tiH -ti. — (Not blunt) tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM, tIvraH -vrA -vraM — (Acute pain) tIvravedanA.
ACUTE-ANGLE , s. antarlambakoRaH, nyUnakoRaH, laGukoRaH; ‘acute-angled,’ antarlambaH -mbA -mbaM.
ACUTELY , adv. tIvraM, tIkzRaM, sUkzmatayA.
ACUTENESS , s. (Of intellect) budDisUkzmatA, vidagDatA, vEdagDyaM. — (Sharp- ness) tEkzRyaM, tejaH n. (s), tIvratA.
ACUTNESS: I Of intellect: v. Acumen. II Of the senses:(1) tEkzRyam;(2) tejaH.
Adage, s. sUtraM, vacanaM, vAkyaM, ABARakaH.
ADAGE: vacanam (when the sense is clear): v. Proverb, saying.
ADAGE , s. sUtraM, vacanaM, prAcInapuruzavacanaM.
ADAGIO , adv. SanEH SanEH, mandaM mandaM.
ADAGIO , s. svaramAndyaM.
ADAGIO , s. (Slow time in music) vilambitaM.
Adamant, s. vajraH-jraM. 2 hIrakaH, maRiH, hIraM. [Adamant]ine, a. vajramaya (yI f.), vajra in comp.
ADAMANT: I An imaginary stone: vajraH (Lit. and Fig.).II Lode-stone q. v. ayaskAntaH.
ADAMANT , s. vajraH or -jraM, aBedyaprastaraH. — (Diamond) hIrakaH, hIraM, avikaM, varArakaM.
ADAMANTINE , a. vajramayaH -yI -yaM, vajraH -jrA -jraM.
ADAMANTINE , a. vajrasadfSaH -SI -SaM, vajraprAyaH &c., vajraH -jrA -jraM.

Adapt, v. t. yuj 10, saMDA 3 U; ‘a(dapt) your conduct to circumstances’ yaTAkAlaM vyavahara, kAlAnuvartI Bava; ‘has a(dapt)ed a portion of it to the stage’ tasyEkadeSaH aBineyArTaH kftaH (U. 4). [Adapt]ation, s. saMyojanaM, saMviDAnaM. [Adapt]ed, a. yukta, yogya, paryApta.
To ADAPT , v. a. yuj in caus. (yojayati -yituM), sanDA (c. 3. -Datte -DAtuM). — (To be adapted) yuj in pass. (yujyate).
ADAPTABLE , a. yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, yoktavyaH -vyA -vyaM, saMyojanIyaH -yA -yaM.
ADAPTED , p. p. yuktaH -ktA -ktaM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, upayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, paryyAptaH -ptA -ptaM, samBAvyaH -vyA -vyaM.

Add, v. t. saMkal 10 (kalayati), parigaR 10, parisaMKyA 2 P, saM-samA-yuj 10; ‘he a(dd)ed his army to the generalʼs’ senApateH senayA svabalaM saMyojayAmAsa; samAci 5 U, saMmil c. 2 anyacca brU 2 U, or kaT 10 or aBiDA 3 U; ‘a(dd) to’ vfD c., puz 4 P, tan 8 U; malinamapi himAMSorlakzma lakzmIM tanoti (S. 1) ‘a(dd)s to her lustre’; ‘there is this also to a(dd) to my (grounds of) anger’ etadapi me dvitIyaM saMtApakAraRaM (Mr. 5); ‘this is another evil to a(dd) to the first’ gaMqasyopari piwikA saMvfttA (S. 2), ayamaparo gaMqasyopari visPowaH (Mu. 5). [Add]ition, s. saMmelanaM, saMyojanaM, saMyogaH. 2 parigaRanaM, parisaMKyA, saMkalanaM. 3 (Something added) ADikyaM; ‘he is a valuable a(ddition) to our side’ asmatpakze'yamanarGyaH sahAyaH saMjAtaH. [Add]itional, a. apara, aDika, aDika-tara.
ADD: I To sum up:(1) yojayati, saM-, (yuja, c. 10).;(2) saM-kalayati (kal, c. 10).II To gain, unite: q. v.: yojayati.III To speak in addition aparaM ca bravIti (brU, c. 2), aBidaDAti (DA, c. 3), etc.

To ADD , v. a. (One thing to another) anyad anyena saMyuj (c. 10. -yojayati -yituM) or samAyuj; DA (c. 3. daDAti DAtuM), samAkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), uparyyupari DA, samAci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM). — (To add together, cast up) parisaNKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -KyAtuM), parigaR (c. 10. -gaRayati -yituM).
ADDER: sarpaviSezaH.
ADDER , s. sarpaviSezaH.

Addict, v. t. (oneself) A-ni-sev 1 A; Baj 1 U; AsaMj pass., Asakta-nirata a. BU 1 P, (loc.). [Addict]ed, a. Asakta, prasakta, nirata, nivizwa, parAyaRa, in comp. [Addict]edness, [Addict]ion, s. Asakti-prasakti f., nizevaRaM, vyasanaM, nirati f., parAyaRatA.
ADDICT: (1) AtmAnaM A-sajjayati (with loc.); (2) Asajjate (with loc.): v. To devote, give up.

To ADDICT , v. a. (One's self to any thing) AsaYj in pass. (-sajyate or -sajjate -saMktuM) with loc.; Baj (c. 1. Bajati -te, BaktuM), Asev (c. 1. -sevate, -sevituM), niviS in caus. (-veSayati -yituM), nirataH -tA -taM or AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM BU.
ADDICTED: (1) AsaktaH, prasaktaH, or saktaH (ktA, ktaM); (2) nirataH (tA, taM).
ADDICTED , p. p. saktaH -ktA -ktaM, AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, prasaktaH -ktA -ktaM, nivizwaH -zwA -zwaM, prajuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pravaRaH -RA -RaM.
ADDICTION , saktiH f., AsaktiH f., raktiH f., upasevanaM, niveSaH.

ADDITION: I The process of adding(1) saNkalanam;(2) saNkalitam; a. of fractions Binna- saNkalitam, Li.II The act of adding(1) yogaH;(2) saMyogaH;(3) samAyogaH;(4) saNkanam III Anything added yogaH: v. Increase.
ADDITION , s. saMyojanaM, samAyogaH, samAkzepaH. — (The state of being additional) ADikyaM. — (In arithmetic) saNkalitaM, parisaMKyA, parigaRanaM. — (The thing added) anubanDaH.
ADDITION , s. (In arithmetic) yogaH, saNkalanaM.
ADDITIONAL: Ph. on receiving the a. powers *atiriktakzmatAM prApya; there are additional reasons for his departure *tasya prasTAnasyAparARi kAraRAni santi.
ADDITIONAL , a. aDikaH -kA -kaM, aDikataraH -rA -raM.
Addle, a. asaMpUrRa, nazwa, duzwa; ‘a(ddle) headed-, pated’ mUQa, nazwaDI, durmati.
ADDLE (adj.): (1) nazwaH (zwA, zwaM) (?);(2) duzwaH (zwA, zwaM) (?) v. Putrid.
ADDLE , a. asampUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, nazwaH -zwA -zwaM, duzwaH -zwA -zwaM.

Address, v. t. AmaMtr 10 A; saM-aBi-A-BAz 1 A, aBiDA 3 U, saMbuD c., Alap, 1 P; ‘a(ddress)ed his mind to Surya’ sUryaM manasADyAyat; ‘a(ddress) me as is wont with you’ (mAM prati) yaTAByastamaBiDIyatAm (U. 1). 2 nAma grah 9 P, nAmagrAhaM vad 1 P or Ahve 1 P. 3 prahi 5 P, prez 10. s. aBi-saM-BAzaRaM, saMboDanaM &c. 2 vacanaM, AlApaH; ‘mode of a(ddress)’ AmaMtraRapadaM; saMSayite pariRaye nEza samudAcAraH (S. 5). ‘not the proper mode of a(ddress)’; ‘of agreeable a(ddress)’ maDurAlApa, priyaMvada. 3 pawutA, dakzatA, nEpuRyaM. 4 (Of a letter) bAhyanAman n.; adattabAhyanAmAnaM leKaM (Mu. 1) ‘a letter without any a(ddress) upon it’; ‘send the letter to my a(ddress)’ datta-liKita-madbAhyanAma (mAmuddiSya) patraM prezaya. 5 (Place of residence &c.) nAmaDAmaviSezAH.

ADDRESS (subs.): I A speaking to;(1) samboDanam;(2) aBiBAzaRam;(3) vacanam.II A massage of respect: perh. aBivAdaH.III Manner of speaking to another: Ph. of pleasing a. priyambadaH (dA, daM) or mizwaBAzin (f. RI) or maDurAlApin (f. nI).IV Tact, dexterity: q. v. dakzatA: V. In pl.: of courtship: Ph. his a. es were rejected *tasyAmantraRaM pratyAdizwam.VI The superscription of a letter: bAhyanAman (n.) get this letter written by Sakatadasa without putting any a.: adattabAhyanAmAnaM leKaM SakawadAsena leKayitvA Mu. i.VII The direction nAmaDamanI (n. du.).

ADDRESS (v. t.): I To discourse to:(1) [Page011] samboDayati (buD, c. 10) or samboDanaM karoti;(2) aBi-BAzate, saB-, A-, samA-, (BAz, c. 1), he a. es me by my name nAmagrahaRapUrvakaM mAM samBAzate;(3) aBi-daDAti (DA, c. 3), a. me as you have been accustomed to do yaTAByastamaBiDIyatAM, U. i.: v. To speak to.II To superscribe (as a letter): q. v.: Ph. he a. ed a letter to me sa mahyaM patraM prAhiRot.III To court, woo: q. v.

To ADDRESS , v. a. (By words) Amantr (c. 10. -mantrayate -yituM), samAmantr, aBiBAz (c. 1. -BAzate -BAzituM), ABAz, samABAz, pratiBAz, aBivad [Page006-b+ 51] (c. 1. -vadati -te -vadituM, c. 10. -vAdayati -te -yituM), aBivac (c. 2. -vakti -vaktuM), Alap (c. 1. -lapati -lapituM), nigad (c. 1. -gadati -gadituM). — (By name) samboDanaM kf, nAma grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM). — (To address a letter, &c., to any one) patrasaMjYAM kf.
ADDRESS , s. samboDanaM, aBivAdaH, vAkyaM, vacanaM, vAkyAramBaH. — (By name) nAmagrahaH. — (Courtship) BAvakaraRaM. — (Dexterity) nEpuRyaM caturatA. — (Direction of a letter) patrasaMjYA, patrAdeSaH.
ADDRESSED , p. p. samboDitaH -tA -taM, aBihitaH -tA -taM, samBAzitaH -tA -taM

sanskrit.slp1: sAkziRo mama vidyante ityuktA yo na

sanskrit.iast: sākṣiṇo mama vidyante ityuktā yo na

details.body: Adduce, v. t. (proof, witness &c.) nirdiS 6 P, upanyas 4 P, upakzip 6 P, upAnI 1 P; ‘a(dduc)ing proofs’ pramARopanyAsaH.

ADDUCE (v. t.): (1) diSati, ut-, nira-, (diS, c. 6), if a man does not a. witness saying that he has got them sAkziRo mama vidyante ityuktA yo na nirdiSati, K. b, M. viii. 56.;(2) upanyasyati (as, c. 4) a. ing of witness sAkzyupanyAsaH, K. b.
To ADDUCE , upanyas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), upanI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM) AnI, sAkzAt kf.
ADDUCED , p. p. upanyastaH -stA -staM, upanItaH -tA -taM, AnItaH -tA -taM.
Adept, a. nipuRa, kuSala, pravIRa, aBijYa.
ADEPT (adj.): (1) nipuRaH (RA, RaM);(2) kuSalaH (lA, laM);(3) pawu (mfn.).
ADEPT , s. aBijYaH, pawuH, nipuRaH, pravIRaH.
ADEQUACY: paryAptiH v. Sufficiency. N. B. Better expr. by the adj.
ADEQUACY , s. sAmarTyaM, paryyAptiH f., kzamatA, yogyatvaM.
Adequate, a. paryApta, samarTa, kzama, tulya yogya, anurUpa. [Adequate]ly, adv. paryAptaM. Adequacy, s. kzamatA, sAmarTyaM, &c.
ADEQUATE (adj.): I Sufficient: q. v. paryAptaH (ptA, ptaM).II As applied to men:(1) upayuktaH (ktA, ktaM);(2) samarTaH (rTA, rTaM). v. Compe- -tent.
ADEQUATE , a. paryyAptaH -ptA -ptaM, kzamaH -mA -maM, samarTaH -rTA -rTaM, pratibalaH -lA -laM, tulyaH -lyA -lyaM, samAnaH -nA -naM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM.

Adhere, v. i. saMj pass., sajj 1 P, saMsakta-anuzakta a. BU, saMlag 1 P, (loc.); anubaMD 9 P. 2 avalaMb 1 A, pAl 10, rakz 1 P; ‘a(dhere)s to his promise’ pratijYAM pAlayati-rakzati. [Adher]ence, s. Asakti f., AsaMgaH, anuzaMgaH, avalaMbanaM. [Adher]ent, s. pakzIyaH, pakzyaH, sapakzaH. 2 anuzaMgin m., sahAyaH, anugAmin m. Adhesion, s. saMsakti f., AsaMgaH, Asakti f. avalaMbanaM; saMlagnatvaM. Adhesive, a. saMlagnaSIla.

ADHERE (v. i.): (1) sajjate (sajj, c. 1), who a. s to my dress ko nu nivasane me sajjate, Sa. iv.; (2) lagati, saM-, (lag, c. 1) again a. d to the Sinsapa tree SiMSapAvfkze punarlalAga, etc. v. To stick, cling to.

To ADHERE , v. n. saMj in pass. (sajyate or sajjate) anusaMj, AsaMj, prasaMj, saMsaMj with loc.; saMlagnaH -gnA -gnaM, or anulagnaH -gnA -gnaM, or saMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, or avalambI -mbinI -mbi, or dfQAvalambI -mbinI -mbi as; anubanD (c. 9. -baDnAti -bandDuM) in pass. (-baDyate), lI (c. 4. lIyate letuM), Df in caus. (DArayati -yituM). — ‘He adheres to his promise,’ pratijYAtaM pAlayati.
ADHERENCE , s. AsaNgaH, anuzaNgaH, AsaktiH f., prasaktiH f., nizevanaM. — (To a pursuit) parAyaRaH, tvarAyaRaM.
ADHERENT (subs.): anugAmin (f. nI): v. Follower. Ph. Anantasira is an a. of Prahara- varma anantasIraH prahAravarmaRaH pakzaH, D. iii.: v. Partisan.
ADHERENT , s. anuzaNgI m. (n), anugataH, anugAmI m. (n), sahAyaH, sahacaraH. — (Follower of the same party) ekapakzaH, pakzakaH sapakzaH, pArSvikaH.
ADHESION (subs): I Lit.: Sticking to:(1) saMlagnatvam;(2) saMsaktiHII Fig. Attachment: q. v.: AsaktiH.
ADHESION (adj.): Perh. SyAnaH (nA, naM) v. Sticky.
ADHESION , s. anulagnatA, saMlagnatvaM, saMsaktiH f.
ADHESIVE , a. anulagnaSIlaH -lA -laM, saMlagnaSIlaH -lA -laM, anuzaNgikaH -kI -kaM.
Adieu, adv. svasti (dat.). s. AmaMtraRaM, ApracCanaM; ‘to bid a(dieu)’ ApracC 6 A, AmaMtr 10 A; AmaMtrayasva sahacaraM (S. 3).
ADIEU (interj.): svasti with dat.
ADIEU (subs): (1) AmantraRam;(2) ApracCanam. To bid a.(1) Amantrayate (mantr, c. 10). R. vii. 30.;(1) A-pfcCate, (pracCa, c. 6). R. viii. 49.
ADIEU , s. AmantraRaM, ApracCanaM, prasTAnakAle AmantraRaM. — (To bid adieu) ApracC (c. 6. -pfcCate -prazwuM), Amantr (c. 10. -mantrayate -yituM) anumantr.
ADIPOUS , a. medasvI -svinI -svi (n), vasAyuktaH -ktA -ktaM.

AEROLITE: Perh. gaRqaSElaH; *vAyUpalaH.

AFFABILITY: (1) maDurAlApatA;(2) mizwaBAzitA; (3) sOjanyam;(4) praSrayaH.

AFFABLE , a. mfduSIlaH -lA -laM, komalasvaBAvaH -vA -vaM, suSIlaH -lA -laM, aBigamyaH -myA -myaM, mfduH -dvI -du, cAwuvAdI -dinI -di (n), priyavAdI -dinI -di (n).
AFFABLY: (1) sOjanyena;(2) praSrayeRa: v. Courte- -ously.

AFFAIR: kAryam, state a. s rAjakAryARiH v. Business.

Affect, v. t. (To act upon) aBiBU 1 P, AkulIkf 8 U, upahan 2 P, vikf, upasfj 6 P, saMskf; kleSaleSEraBinnaM (S. 2) ‘not a(ffect)ed by the slightest fatigue’; ‘a(ffect)ed by a devil’ vetAlopahata; ‘a(ffect)ed with many diseases’ anekavyADyupasfzwa; ‘our position is not in the least a(ffect)ed (it does not a(ffect) us in the least)’ na naH kiMcicCidyate (S. B. 345). 2 (Pretend) Ex. by Cadma-CalaM kf, miTyA in comp., by kftaka-kftrima a. kf; ‘a(ffect)ing a quarrel or anger’ kftakakalahaM-kopaM-kftvA. 3 Aku-lIkf, ArdrIkf, dru c.; avakASaM-padaM-grah 9 P; ‘my words a(ffec)ed his heart’ mama vacasA tasya hfdayaM dravIBUtaM, mama vacastasya hfdaye dfQaM padaM leBe. 4 man 4 A; ‘he a(ffect)s learning’ paMqitamanyosO. [Affect]ation, s. ahaMkAraH, AwopaH, miTyAgOravaM. 2 Cadman n. See Pretext. 3 vilAsaH, aBinayaH, hAvaH. [Affect]ed, a. Akula, aBiBUta, upahata, vikfta. 2 miTyA in comp.; kftaka, kftrima; ‘by an a(ffected) courage’ miTyApratApamAtmanyAropya. 3 ahaMkArin, mAnin, saMdarpa. [Affect]edly, adv. sAhaMkAraM, sAwopaM. [Affect]ing, a. karuRaM, marmaBedin. [Affect]ingly, adv. karuRa. [Affect]ion, s. preman m. n., anurAgaH, snehaH, praRayaH, prIti f., vAtsalyaM, (with loc.). 2 DarmaH, saMskAraH, vikAraH, anuBAvaH, vftti f., BAvaH, vikriyA, rAgaH. [Affect]ionate, a. snigDa, snehaSIla, praRayin, sapraRaya, sAnurAga, vatsala. [Affect]ionately, adv. sapremaM, sasnehaM, snigDaM, sAnurAgaM.

AFFECT (v. t.): I To act upon, infuenceinfluence: Ph. I am a. ed with pain in the feet mama pAdayoH pIqA saYjAtA; as if a. ed with devil piSAcopahatamiva. II Of feeling Ph. a. ed with sorrow SokAmi- BUtaH (tA, taM); a. ed with joy harzAkulaH (lA, laM); a. ed with those lamentations AhatastEH paridevitAkzarEH; his speech did not a. the audience *tasyoktiH Srotf- vargahfdayAnina jagrAha or SrotfvargahfdayezvavakASaM na leBeIII To aspire to, aim at: q. v.IV To love: q. v. V. To concern: q. v.VI To make a mere show of. Ph. a. ing quarrel kftakakalahaM kftvA, Mu. iii.; a. ing anger sakftakakopaM Sa. i.: v. To feign.

To AFFECT , v. a. (Aim at) sev (c. 1. sevate sevituM), upasev nizev; samAcar (c. 1. -carati -carituM); Baj (c. 1. Bajate, BaktuM). — (Operate upon) vikf (c. 8. -karoti -karttuM); upahan (c. 2. -hanti -hantuM); cal in caus. (cAlayati -yituM). — (To move with grief, &c.) SokopahataM -tAM -taM kf; ‘to affect with joy,’ harzAkulaM -lAM -laM kf. — (To pretend) Cadma or CalaM kf; miTyA vad; ‘to affect to befriend a person,’ miTyopacAraM kf. — (To think one's self) man (c. 10. mAnayate); ‘one who affects learning,’ paRqitammanyaH.

details.body: AFFECTATION , s. ahaNkAraH, vElakzyaM, mAnitvaM; mahApaRqito 'ham iti atisundarI aham iti budDir vyavahAro vA; ‘affectation of learning,’ paRqitammanyatvaM. — (A branch of feminine action) avahitTaM, ntTA, vilAsaH, hAvaH. — (False pretence) upaDA, CalaM, Cadma n. (n).

AFFECTED: I Assumed:(1) kftakaH (kA, kaM), restraining his a. anger kftakaM kopaM saMhftya, Mu. iii.; (2) kftrimaH (mA, maM), un-a. love akftrimaM prema, Ki. iii. 37.: v. False, feigned.II Moved (1) taralaH (lA, laM), I am a. by your manners tAvakEranuBAvEstaralAH smaH, N. v. 24;(2) galitaH (tA, taM) (=melted): v. To affect (II) III Unnatural and offensive: Perh. kftakaH (kA, kaM): v. Unnatural.

AFFECTED , part. a. (Pretended) kftrimaH -mA -maM; miTyA prefixed, as, miTyopacAraH, ‘affected kindness.’ — (Full of affectation) savElakzyaH -kzyA -kzyaM, ahaNkArI -riRI -ri (n), mAnI -ninI -ni (n), vilAsavAn -vatI -vat. — (Affected by, disturbed by) upahataH -tA -taM, AkulaH -lA -laM, grastaH -stA -staM, raYjitaH -tA -taM.
AFFECTEDLY: (1) By the adj: v. Affected; (2) sAwopaM (=boastfully)
AFFECTING (adj.): karuRaH (RA, RaM) (=pathetic, q. v.): v. To affect (II).
AFFECTING , a. hfdayaNgamaH -mA -maM, marmmaBedI -dinI -di (n).
AFFECTINGLY: karuRam spoke a. karuRamaBihitam, K. x. 58: v. Pathetically.

AFFECTION: I Love:(1) snehaH;(2) anurAgaH; (3) praRayaH (conjugal or friendly a.);(4) preman (n) v. Love;(5) vAtsalyam (parental a.); (6) hArdam (rare). N. B. Note that these words agree with the loc.: I said I feel a. for this child as for my own Orasa ivAsmin vatse vatsalateti mayA vijYApitaH, D. iii.II An attribute or property: Ph. a. s of the mind manovfttayaH; a. s of bodies SArIraDarmAH.III Disease: q. v.: Ph. remover of all rheumatic a. s sarvavAtavikAranut, Sr.

AFFECTION , s. snehaH m., priyatA f., anuraktiH f., anurAgaH, praRayaH, premA m. or -ma n. (-man), hArddaM, praSrayaH. — (Passion of any kind) rAgaH, BAvaH, rasaH. — (Of the mind) manaso BAvaH. — (Of the body) SarIrasya BAvaH. — (Parental) vAtsalyaM; ‘I have great affection for him’ tena saha mama mahAn snehaH or tasminn anurAgavAn asmi.

AFFECTION , s. (Fondness) prItiH f.; ‘object of affection,’ prIti- pAtraM; ‘paternal affection,’ sutasnehaH, putrasnehaH. — (Of the mind) manoDarmmaH, manovikAraH, manovikftiH f., manovfttiH f., vfttiH f., vikAraH, vikftiH f.; ‘the affection of love,’ kAmavikAraH; ‘of anger,’ kroDavikAraH. — (Of the body) vikAraH, BAvaH, vfttiH f., AkAraH, anuBAvaH; ‘of the eyes,’ netravikAraH. — (Of the mind or body) BAvaH. Of these there are three classes: 1. Fixed or regular passions, sTAyiBAvAH m. pl., eight in number, viz. ratiH f., hAsaH, SokaH, kroDaH, utsAhaH, BayaM, jugupsA, vismayaH. 2. Irre- gular passions, vyaBicAriBAvAH m. pl. or saYcAriBAvAH m. pl., thirty-two in number, viz. nirvedaH, glAniH f., SaNkA, asUyA, madaH, SramaH, AlasyaM, dEnyaM, cintA, mohaH, smftiH f., DftiH f., vrIqA, capalatA, harzaH, AvegaH, jaqatA, garvaH, vizAdaH, OtsukyaM, nidrA, apasmAraH, SayaH, viboDaH, amarzaH, avahitTA, ugratA, matiH f., upAlamBaH, vyADiH m., unmAdaH, maraRaM. Sometimes trAsaH and vitarkaH are added. 3. Honest and spontaneous emotions, sAttvikaBAvAH m. pl., eight in number, viz. stamBaH, svedaH, romAYcaH, vEsvaryaM, vepaTuH m., vEvarRyaM, aSru, pralayaH.

AFFECTIONATE: (1) snigDaH (gDA, gDaM);(2) praRayin (f. nI), a. heart praRayi hfdayam Me. i. 10; (3) vatsalaH (lA, laM) (applied to parents); (4) Baktimat (f. tI) (of dutiful affection towards parents and elder relatives);(5) premaparaH (rA, raM).
