AFFRAY: (1) dvandvam;(2) kalahaH;(3) qimbaH; (4) qamaraH (rare).
AFFRAY , s. saNgAmaH, samaraH, saMyugaH, yudDaM, kalahaH, qimbaH, qamaraH, qAmaraH.
Affright, v. t. saMtras c., BI c. (BApayate, BIzayate), udvij c. s. BayaM, saM-, trAsaH, sADvasaM.
AFFRIGHT (v.): (1) mIzayate (c. of BI);(2) trAsayati (c. of tras): v. To frighten.
AFFRIGHT (subs).: (1) trAsaH;(2) sADvasam: v. fear, terror.
To AFFRIGHT , v. a. tras in caus. (trAsayati -yituM), vitras; BI in caus. (BAyayati or BIzayati -te -yituM), udvij in caus. (-vejayati -yituM).
AFFRIGHT , s. trAsaH, santrAsaH, sADvasaM, BayaM.
AFFRIGHTEDLY , adv. satrAsaM, saBayaM, santrAsena.
Affront, s. avajYA, nikfti f., apamAnaH, tiraskAraH, mAnaBaMgaH. v. t. (saMmuKaM-pratyakzaM) avajYA 9 U, avaman 4 A, aDikzip 6 P, tiraskf 8 U.
AFFRONT (v. t.): avamanyate (man, c. 4): v. To insult.
AFFRONT (subs).: (1) apamAnam:;(2) avamAnanAH v. Insult.
AFFRONT , s. apamAnaM, bipriyaM, kzepaH, avajYAnaM, DarzaRaM, tiraskAraH.

To AFFRONT , v. a. (Offer open insult) sAkzAt, or sammuKaM, or pratimuKaM, or muKAmuKi, or pratyakzaM avaman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM), avajYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM), tiraskf (c. 8. -karoti -karttuM), Akzar in caus. (-kzArayati -yituM), aDikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), avakzip, parikzip.
AFFRONTED , p. p. apamAnitaH -tA -taM, avajYAtaH -tA -taM, tiraskftaH -tA -taM, aDikziptaH -ptA -ptaM.
AFFRONTER , s. sAkzAt or pratimuKam apamAnakaH, avajYAnakarttA m. (rttf).
AFFRONTIVE , a. apamAnakaH -kA -kaM, apamAnopetaH -tA -taM, avajYAnayuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
AFFUSE (v. t.): siYcati, ni-, (sic, c. 6): v. To pour.
Affusion, s. AsekaH.
AFFUSION: (1) sekaH;(2) nizekaH;(3) aBizekaH.
AFFUSION , s. AsekaH, AsecanaM, aBizekaH.
To AFFY , v. a. (Betroth) vAgdAnaM kf, pratijYApatreRa vivAhasambanDaM kf, niyamapatreRa vivAhapratijYAM kf.
Afire, Aflame, a. dahyamAna.
Afloat, a. plavamAna; ‘a rumour is a(float)’ vArtA prasutA.

AFLOAT: plavamAnaH (nA, naM), or by the verb; I was a. for the day and the whole night tAvadaplozi yAvadapAsaradvAsaraH SarvarI ca sarvA, D. vi. Fig.: the rumour is a. bahulIBUto'yamarTaH, Sa. vi.: v. To get abroad.
AFLOAT , adv. (Floating) plavamAnaH -nA -naM, plavaH -vA -vaM.
Afoot, adv. padByAm; ‘set a(foot)’ prAraB 1 A, See Begin; ‘the army is a(foot)’ pracalitaM sEnyaM; ‘going a(foot)’ pAdaga, pAdacArin.

AFOOT (adv.): I Lit.: padBayAm, did she go a. on in a carriage kimasO padBayAM gatA uta pravahaRena ? Mr. ix.II FIG., in action: prArabDaH (bDA, bDaM), good men do not abandon what is set a. prArabGamu- ttamaguRA na parityajanti, P: v. To begin, under- -take.

AFOOT , adv. (On foot) pAdena, padena. — (Going on foot) pAdagaH -gA -gaM — (In action, or use) pracalaH -lA -laM, pracalitaH -tA -taM, pracaritaH -tA -taM. — (Set on foot) ArabDaH -bDA -bDaM, udyataH -tA -taM.
Afore, adv. agre, puraH, saMmuKaM. 2 pUrvaM, purA, gatakAle; ‘a(fore) said’, pUrvokta, prAgukta. ‘a(fore) thought’, s. pUrva-prAk-saMkalpitaM; ‘a(fore) times’, adv. purA.
AFORE , prep. (In front) pratimuKaM, aBimuKaM, sammuKaM, agre, puras, puratas, sAkzAt. — (In former time) pUrvvakAle, gatakAle, pUrvvaM, pUrvvasamaye, purA.
AFOREMENTIONED, AFORENAMED, AFORESAID: (1) pUrvoktaH (ktA, ktaM);(2) prAguktaH (ktA, ktaM).
AFORESAID , p. p. pUrvvoktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvoditaH -tA -taM, prAguktaH -ktA -ktaM.
AFORETIME: (1) purA;(2) pUrvakAle v. Formerly.
AFORETIME , adv. pUrvvakAle, gatakAle, purA, pUrvvaM.
Afraid, a. BIta, BayAnvita, SaMkAnvita; ‘to be a(fraid)’ tras 1, 4 P, BI 3 P, (with abl.). 2 A-SaMk 1 A, man 4 A.
AFRAID: (1) BItaH (tA, taM);(2) SaNkitaH (tA, taM): v. Fearful.
AFRAID, BE: (1) biBeti (BI, c. 3) (with abl.): I am a. to allow girls to live publicly biBemi kanyakAnAM prakASAvasTAnAt, D. iv.: v. To fear;(2) SaNkate (with acc.): v. To appre- -hend.

AFRAID , a. BItaH -tA -taM, BayAnvitaH -tA -taM, SaNkAnvitaH -tA -taM; ‘to be afraid of,’ BI (c. 3. biBeti BetuM), with abl. or gen.; as, ‘he is afraid of the dog,’ kukkurAt or kukkurasya biBeti. So also tras (c. 4. trasyati trasituM), udvij (c. 6. -vijate -vijituM).
Afresh, adv. punarapi, aBinavaM.
AFRESH: (1) punar;(2) punarapi: v. Again.
AFRESH , adv. punar, punarapi, nUtanaM, aBinavaM, pratinavaM.
AFT: I subs: *(nAvaH) paScAdBAgaHII Adv.: v. Abaft.
AFT , s. (The part of a ship towards the stern) nAvaH paScimaBAgaH.
AFT , adv. (Towards the stern of a ship) nAvaH paScimaBAgaM prati, nAvaH paScAdBAgaM prati.

After, prep. anu pr. to roots, paScAt; ‘to go a(fter)’ anugam, anusf, 1 P. 2 (of time) paraM, anaMtaraM, UrDvaM, (with abl.); ‘a(fter) that’ tasmAtparaM, tataUrDvaM; ‘a(fter) one another’ AnupUrvyeRa, anupUrvaSaH. ‘a(fter) 10 years’ daSavarze vyatIte; ‘a(fter) eating’ BojanAnaMtaraM; paScAt (gen.), anu in comp.; ‘a(fter) a few days’ dinezu gacCatsu; by gerund, or pUrvakaM in comp.; anAmayapraSnapUrvakaM (S. 5); ‘he waters tree a(fter) tree’ vfkzaM vfkzaM siMcati; ‘in a(fter) time’ AgAmikAle, uttarakAle. 3 anusAreRa-sArataH, anurUpaM; ‘you write a(fter) his hand’ leKane tasyAnukarozi; ‘he is called a(fter) his grandfather’ sa pitAmahanAmnA'BiDIyate-AhUyate; See Name. In comp. e. g. ‘a(fter) ages’, ex. by uttara; ‘a(fter)-ages’ uttarakAlaH; putrapOtrAH; ‘a(fter) all’ aMte, Seze; ‘a(fter) birth’, s. jarAyu n. ‘a(fter)-crop’ Sasyasya dvitIyasaMgrahaH; ‘a(fter) glow’, s. sAyaM-saMDyA-prakASaH. ‘a(fter)-inquiry’, uttarajijYAsA; ‘a(fter)-life’ AyuHSezaH, uttaravayas n.; ‘a(fter) noon’, s. aparAhRaH, parAhRaH, vikAlaH; (a.) aparAhRatana (nI f.), vEkAlika (kI f.); ‘a(fter) pains’, prasavottaravedanA. ‘a(fter) thought’, uttaraciMtA, anuboDaH. ‘a(fter) wards’ paScAt, anaMtaraM, tataH paraM, para.

AFTER (prep.): I Behind: q. v.: anu (with acc.): to go a. anugacCati; to run a. anu- dravati.II At a later time:(1) By abl.: seen a. a long time bahordfzwaM kAlAt, U. ii. N. B. This const. is very rare;(2) anantaraM (with abl. or crude base): a. his father pituranantaraM, R. ix. 1.; a. 16 years zoqaSavarzAnantaraM, D.; just a. his order vacanAntarameva, K.;(3) paraM (with abl.): a. childhood bAlyAt paraM Ku. i. 31.;(4) UrdDam (with abl.) a. childbirth UrdDaM prasUteH, R. xiv. 66; (5) arvAk (with abl.) (rare);(6) When time is specified, by loc. or loc. absolute of words signifying motion: a. the rainy season atIte varzuke kAle, B. vii. 18.; a. a few days katipayadivasAvagame, K.; tato gatezu katipayadinezu, D. (N. B. note that itaH (=from this time) and tataH (=from that time) are sometimes prefixed in such cases for the sake of precision);(7) Sometimes by part. s: a. bathing with the water of the cascade nirBarajala- nivartitasnAnaviDiH, [Page017] K.III. In an inferior degree to: anu (with acc.): a. the acquisi- tion of friends mitralABamanu, Ki. xiii. 53.IV In imitation of:(1) anu (with acc.), every thing yours is a. me, but you do not feel the pain of separation from your beloved (wife) sarvaM mAmanu te priyAvirahajAM tvaM tu vyaTAM mAnuBUH, V. iv.; (2) anurUpaH (pA, paM).
AFTER (adj.): I Subsequent, succeeding, later: q. v.II More aft.: Ph. the a. sails *paScAdBAgasTAni vAyuvasanAni.
AFTER (adv.): of time: paScAt: soon a. kiYci- tpaScAt, Me. i. 10.; long a. cirAt, Ra. iv.; how long a. kiyaccireRa, Sa. vi. For phrases like many years a. (=a. many years): v. After (prep.) (II).

AFTER , prep. anu or paScAt prefixed; as, ‘to go after,’ anugantuM; ‘to run after,’ paScAd DAvituM. — (Of time) paScAt, paraM, anantaraM, UrdDvaM, arvAk with abl. — (According to) anu, anurUpaM, anusAratas, anurUpeRa, anusAreRa; ‘after that,’ tadanantare, or tadanantaraM, or tasmAt paraM, or ata UrdDvaM; ‘after one another,’ anupUrvvaSas; ‘a century after,’ varzaSate gate; ‘after eating,’ BojanAnantaraM or BojanAt paraM; ‘after the rising of the sun,’ sUryyodayAd UrdDvaM; ‘after a few days,’ dinezu gacCatsu. Sometimes ‘after’ is expressed by the indec. part.; as, ‘after ascending the tree the nests were destroyed,’ vfkzam Aruhma nIqA BagnAH, or even by pUrvvakaM; as, ‘after laying down a stake,’ paRasTApanapUrvvakaM; or by repeating the word in such phrases as, ‘he waters tree after tree,’ vfkzaM vfkzaM siYcati.
AFTER , adv. (In after time) paraM, parakAle, AgAmikAle, uttarakAle, — (Following after another) paScAt. — (Subsequently) parastAt, uttaratra, uttaratas ind.
AFTER ALL , antatas ind., ante, paraM, Seze, avaSeze.
AFTER-AGES: AyatiH (?) v. Posterity.
AFTER-AGES , s. uttarakAlaH, parakAlaH, AgAmikAlaH, BAvikAlaH. — (Descendants) putrapOtrAH m. pl.
AFTER-BIRTH , s. garBaparisravaH.
AFTER-COMER , s. uttarAgAmI m. (n), param upatizWati yaH, uttarakAle jIvati yaH.
AFTER-CROP , s. Sasyasya dvitIyasaNgahaH or dvitIyotpattiH f., Palasya dvitIyasaNgrahaH.
AFTER-DINNER , s. BojanAnantaraM, BojanAt paraM, BojanottaraM.
AFTER-ENDEAVOUR , s. uttarodyogaH, dvitIyayatnaH.
AFTER-GAME , s. uttaropAyaH
AFTER-GRASS or AFTER-MATH s. dvitIyatfRaM, dvitIyatfRotpattiH f.
AFTER-INQUIRY , s. uttarAnusanDAnaM, uttarajijYAsA.
AFTER-LIFE , s. jIvanAvaSezaH.
AFTER-NOON (subs): (1) parAhRaH;(2) uparAhRaH; (3) vEkAlaH.
AFTER-NOON (adj.): (1) aparAhvatanaH (nI, naM); (2) AparAhvikaH (kI, kaM);(3) vEkAlikaH (kI, kaM).
AFTER-PAINS: prasavavedanA.
AFTER-PAINS , s. anutApaH, uttaravyaTA. — (Atchildbirth) prasavAnantaraM vedanA.
AFTER-PIECE: *uparUpakam, *anunAwakam.
AFTER-STATE , s. parAvasTA, uttarAvasTA, BAvyavasTA.
AFTER-TASTE , s. uttarasvAdaH, anusvAdaH.
AFTER-THOUGHT: (1) anuboGaH:(2) uttaracintA (?)
AFTER-THOUGHT , s. anuboDaH, uttaracintA, kAryyAnantaraM vicAraRaM.
AFTER-TIMES , s. uttarakAlaH, parakAlaH, AgAmikAlaH. — (Descen- dants) putrapOtrAH m. pl.
AFTERNOON , s. apaKahlaH, parAhlaM, vEkAlaH, vikAlaH. — (Relating to the afternoon) AparAhlikaH -kI -kaM, vEkAlikaH -kI -kaM.
AFTERTHOUGHT , s. paScAdbudDiH f., paScAtkalpanA, paScimabudDiH f.
AFTERWARDS: (1) paScAt;(2) pareRa (rare): v. After (adv.), then, thereupon.
AFTERWARDS , s. paScAt ind., tatpaScAt, tadanantaraM, anantaraM, tataH paraM, paraM ind., aparaM, parastAt, uttaratas, tatas.
Again, adv. punaH, BUyaH; ‘a(gain) and a(gain)’ BUyo BUyaH, vAraMvAraM; ‘as much a(gain)’ dviguRa a. 2 aparaM ca, anyacca, api ca. 3 (With verbs) by prati pr.

AGAIN (adv.): I Once more;(1) punar;(2) BUyas;(3) punarapi. a. and a.:(1) punaHpunaH;(2) BUyoBUyaH;(3) vAraMvAraM;(4) asakft.II Moreover: q. v. anyacca Ph.: sleeping never to wake a. apratiboGaSAyin (f. nI), R. viii. 58.

AGAIN , adv. punar, punarapi, BUyas ind. — (Moreover) anyacca, kiYca, itaram indec. — (On the other hand) anyapakze, punar. — (Repeat- edly) muhus, punaHpunar, asakft, BUyo BUyas, vAraMvAraM. — (Further, in argument) aNgaM. — (As much again) dviguRaH -RA -RaM. — (Back again, as re in English or Latin) prati. — (In return for) prati.

sanskrit.slp1: pratikUlaM na ca te mayA kftam
sanskrit.word: प्रतिकूलं न च ते मया कृतम्
sanskrit.iast: pratikūlaṃ na ca te mayā kṛtam

details.body: Against, prep. prati-ABi pr. to nouns; prativAtaM ‘a(gainst) the wind’ &c. 2 aBimuKaM, pratimuKaM, saMmuKaM, in comp. or with gen. 3 virudDaM, pratikUlaM, or by atikramya; ‘a(gainst) my order’ mama SAsanasya virudDaM, SAsanamatikramya-ullaMGya; ‘assist him a(gainst) his brother’ BrAtari badDavErasya tasya sAhAyyaM kuru. 4 arTe, arTaM; ApadarTe DanaM rakzet ‘should lay by wealth a(gainst) (as a provision for) calamities’.

AGAINST: I Abreast of, facing:(1) prati-, a. the hostile army pratyarisEnyaM, R. vii. 55.; a. the wind pratyanilaM, Ku. iii. 31.;(2) Comp. with aBi (rare), a. the enemy aByamitraM, Ki. xvi. 5.;(3) aBimuKaM (in comp. or with gen.) should advance a. the enemy dvizatoBimuKaM vrajet Ka. xviii. 2.II In opposition to: Ph. (subjects) should not act a. their king rAjanyavirudDABirvfttiBirva- tiMtavyam Mu. i.; I have never acted a. yours wishes pratikUlaM na ca te mayA kftam; Ku. ii. 7.; if she, a. her caste..... yadiyamatikramya svakulaGarmam, D. ii.III In provision for: Ph. a. misfortune ApadarTe, H.IV. Upon: q. v.; v. also the verbs to which it is joined.

AGAINST , prep. prati, aBi. — (Opposed to) virudDaH -dDA -dDaM, pratikUlaH -lA -laM, vipakzaH -kzA -kzaM. — (Over against) aBimuKaM, pratimuKaM, sammuKaM; ‘against the wind,’ prativAtaM, vAtABimuKaM; ‘against the stream,’ pratisotas ind. ‘Against’ may be expressed by arTe or arTaM, in such phrases as ‘one should store up money against misfortune,’ ApadarTe DanaM rakzet.
Agape, a. jfMBamARa; ‘with eyes a(gape) with astonishment’ vismayotPullalocana.
AGAPE: jfmBamAnaH (nA, naM): v. Gaping.
AGAPE , adv. jfmBamARaH -RA -RaM, vismayotPullanayanaH -nA -naM, PullalocanaH -nA -naM.
AGARIC , s. vfkzaruhaH CatrAkaviSezaH, tarurohI, OzaDIyaCatrAkaviSezaH.
Agastric, a. jaWaraSUnya.
AGASTYA , s. (A celebrated Saint, son of Mitra and Varuna, and regent of the star Canopus) agastyaH, mEtrAvAruRiH.
AGATE: SavalamaRiviSezaH Perh. gomedaH.
AGATE , s. ratnaviSezaH, nAnAvarRaH prastaraviSezaH, nAnACAyAnvitaH prastaraviSezaH.

Age, s. yugaM, kAlaH, samayaH. 2 vayas n.; ‘a(ge) of the world’ kalpaH; ‘old a(ge)’ vfdDatvaM, vArDakyaM, vfdDaBAvaH, pariRataM vayas n. ‘come of a(ge)’ prAptavyavahAra; ‘of the same a(ge)’ samakAlIna, samAnavayaska; ‘of age’ ex. by varzIya a. varzAtmaka a.; ‘5 years of a(ge)’ paMcavarzIya-varzAtmaka; ‘about 8 years of a(ge)’ azwavarzadeSIya; ‘a(ge) of majority’ yOvanadaSA, yOvanAvasTA; vyavahArajYatAdarSakavayas n. ‘he reached the 16th year of his a(ge)’ zoqaSavarzavayovasTAmaspfSat. [Ag]ed, a. vfdDa, jIrRa, purARa.

AGE: I Time of life:(1) vayas, and what is his a. kiyadvA vayaH, K. ; of the same a. savayas, (mfn.), R. v. 65.; of advanced a. galitavayas (mfn.) (poet.) R. iii. 70.; your majesty is still of a. vayaHsTa eva praBuH, Sa. vi.;(2) Ayus (=the whole term of one's life): when the king passed the 61st year of his a. ekazazwimatikramya varzAn BUpatirAyuzaH, Raj.II An epoch: q. v. yugam the golden a. (1) kftayugam;(2) satyayugam.

AGE, OF: (1) comp. with varza, vatsara, etc.: thir- teen years of a. trayodaSavarzaH (rzA, rzaM) D. iii.; one who has completed twenty years pUrRaviMSativarzaH (rzA, rzaM,) M. ii. 212.;(2) comp. with varzIyaH (yA, yaM) etc.: twenty years of a. viMSativarzIMyaH (yA, yaM), H. iv.;(3) comp. with vayaskaH (skA, skaM): v. Aged (II): Ph. about 18 years of a. azwAdaSavarzadeSIyaH (yA, yaM), D. vi.; below two years UnadvivArzikaH (kI, kaM), M. v. 68.: above 90 years of a. navatyaDikavayas (mfn.), K. b.; who has not reached 25th. year of his a. aprApta- paYcaviMSatim Sr.

AGE , s. (Period) yugaM, kAlaH, samayaH. — (Life) AyuH n. (s), jIvitakAlaH vayaH n. (s). — (Age of the world) kalpaH. — (Old age) vfdDatvaM, vArdDakaM, vfdDaBAvaH; ‘a youth who has come of age,’ vyavahAraprAptaH, vyavahArajYaH; ‘a son twenty years of age,’ viMSativarzIyaH putraH; ‘of the same age,’ samAnavayaskaH -skA -skaM.

AGE , s. (Of the world) yugaM; ‘beginning of an age,’ yugAdiH m.; ‘end of one,’ yugAntaH. The four ages of the Hindūs, cor- responding in some degree with the golden age, silver age, brazen age, and iron age, are, 1. kftaM or satyaM, 2. tretA, 3. dvAparaH, 4. kaliH m.
AGED: I OLD: q. v.:(1) vfdDaH (dDA, dDaM) (as animals);(2) purARaH (RA, RaM); (as trees etc.). II Of a certain age: vayaskaH (skA, skaM), a. ten years daSavarzavayaskaH (skA, skaM): v. Age, of.
AGED , a. vfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, jIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, prAcInaH -nA -naM, vayogataH -tA -taM, AyuzaH -zI -zaM.

AGENCY: I Action: q. v.II Instrumenta- -lity: kartftvam, the a. of God is visible every- where *sarvatreSvarasya kartftvaM drazwavyam, Ph. through my a. matkartfkaH (kA, kaM); the burning power of iron is through the a. of applied fire ayaso dagDftvaM svasaMyuktAgnidvArakam, S. p. b.III The business of an agent: SAKA (=branch): v. Agent.
AGENCY , s. (State of an agent) karttftvaM, karttfkatvaM. — (Operation) kAraRatvaM, hetutA, kAraRaM; ‘human agency,’ pOruzeyatvaM. — (Office of a deputy) niyogipadaM, niyogitvaM.
Agenda, s. kAryakramapatraM.

Agent, s. pratihastaH, pratiniDiH. 2 (in grammar) kartf m.; kArakaH, kAraH in comp. 3 hetuH, kAraRaM, sADanaM; Sakti f. Agency, s. kartftvaM, nirmAtftvaM; ‘the action was done through his a(gency)’ tatkartfkA kriyA, tasya sAhAyyena saMpAditA kriyA. 2 kAraRaM. 3 niyogipadaM, niyojyatvaM.
AGENT: I One who acts for another:(1) pratiniDiH;(2) pratihastaH.II An actor: q. v. kartA;III An active power: SaktiH (with gen.); fire is a powerful a. *agnerUrjasvalA SaktiH.

AGENT , s. (Doer) karttA m. (rttf), karttfkaH, kAraH, kArakaH, karaH in comp. — (A deputy) niyogI m. (n), pratipuruzaH, kAryyADISaH, pratiniDiH m. — (That which has the power of operating) hetukaH, hetuH m., kAraRaM, sADanaM.
AGGESSOR: (1) pUrvApakAro, B. ix. 102.;(2) yaH praTamaM hinasti (hiMs, c. 7.), AkrAmati, etc.
Agglomerate, v. t. saMci 5 U, ekatra-rASI-kf 8 U.
AGGLOMERATE: piRqIkaroti (kf, c. 8.): v. To collect.
To AGGLOMERATE , v. a. saYci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM), samAci, upaci; samAkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM); rASIkf; puYjaM kf, ekatra kf.
AGGLOMERATED , p. p. saYcitaH -tA -taM, upacitaH -tA -taM, rASIkftaH -tA -taM.
Agglutinate, v. t. saMyuj 10, saMSliz c. saMlagna a. kf 8 U, saMsaMj c.
To AGGLUTINATE , v. n. saMSliz in caus. (-Slezayati -yituM), saMyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yoktuM, c. 10. -yojayati -yituM), saMhan (c. 2. -hanti -hantuM), saMlagnaM -gnAM -gnaM kf.

To AGGRANDISE , v. a. vfD in caus. (varDayati -yituM), saMvfD, eD in caus. (eDayati -yituM), ApyE (caus. -pyAyayati -yituM), sPAy in caus. sPAvayati -yituM), pracurIkf, sPItIkf, tan (c. 8. tanoti tanituM).
AGGRANDISEMENT , s. vfdDiH f., vardDanaM, vivfdDiH f., unnatiH f., samunnatiH f. upacayaH, sPAtiH f., aByudayaH; ‘for one's own aggrandisement,’ AtmavivfdDaye dat. c. or AtmodayAy dat. c.

Alight, v. i. avatF 1 P, upaviS 6 P, avanipat 1 P.
Alight, a. pradIpta.
ALIGHT: I To get down; q. v.: ava-tarati (tF, c. 1).II To settle on (as bees): patati, ni-, (pat, c. 1), the swan a. ed on the ground papAta BUmO haMsaH N. iii. 1.
To ALIGHT , v. n. avatF (c. 1. -tarati -tarituM -tarItuM), upaviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), nipat (c. 1. -patati -patituM).
To ALIGHT , v. n. avaruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM), avarohaM kf.
ALIGHTED , p. p. avatIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, upavizwaH -zwA -zwaM, nipatitaH -tA -taM.
ALIGHTED , p. p. avarUQaH -QA -QaM, kftAvarohaH -hA -haM.
Alike, a. sadfSa (SI f.), tulya, samAna, sama.
ALIKE (adj.): (1) sadfSaH (SA, SaM);(2) tulyaH (lyA, lyaM): v. Like, similar.
ALIKE (adv.): samaM: v. Equally, similarly.
ALIKE , a. sadfSaH -SI -SaM, tulyaH -lyA -lyaM, samAnaH -nA -naM, ekaprakAraH -rA -raM, tulyarUpaH -pI -paM, tulyAkftiH -tiH ti.
Aliment, s. AhAraH, BojanaM. [Aliment]al, [Aliment]ary, a. pozaka, puzwiprada, SaktivarDaka. [Aliment]ation, s. pozaRaM, BaraRaM
ALIMENT: AhAraH v. Food, nourishment.
ALIMENT , s. AhAraH, BojanaM, BakzyaM, BojyaM, annaM, KAdyaM, pOzwikaM.
ALIMENTAL or ALIMENTARY, a. pOzwikaH -kI -kaM, pozakaH -kA -kaM, puzwidaH -dA -daM, pratipAlakaH -kA -kaM, BaraRaSIlaH -lA -laM.
ALIMENTARINESS , s. pozakatvaM, pratipAlakatvaM, BarimA m. (n), BaraRaSIlatA.
ALIMENTARY (adj.): v. Nourishing. The a. canal *AhAravAhinI.
ALIMENTATION , s. pozaRaM, BaraRaM, pratipAlanaM, puzwiH f.

sanskrit.iast: strīpuruṣabibhedasamaye yo dhanasya nyāyāṃśo bhāryyāyai dīyate

details.body: ALIMONY: grAsAcCAdanam. K. b.
ALIMONY , s. strIpuruzabiBedasamaye yo Danasya nyAyAMSo BAryyAyE dIyate.
Alive, a. jIvat (ntI f.), sajIva, sacetana; ‘I caught him a(live)’ jIvagrAhamagrahIzaM (D. K. ii. 4). 2 aBijYa (with gen.), or vid 2 P; See Know.
ALIVE: I Living: q. v.: jIvat (f. ntI).II Active, lively: q. v.
ALIVE, BE: jIvati, tell me, is my darling a. kaTaya jIvati me priyA, Ma. ix.

ALIVE , a. jIvan -vantI -vat (t), varttamAnaH -nA -naM, sajIvaH -vA -vaM, sacetanaH -nA -naM, AyuzmAn -zmatI -zmat (t). — (Cheerful, sprightly) tvaritaH -tA -taM, atandraH -ndrA -ndraM, caYcalaH -lA -laM.
Alkali, s. kzAraH, sarjikA; See Natron. [Alkali]fy, v. t. kzArIkf 8 U. [Alkali]ne, a. kzArasvaBAva, kzAraviSizwa.
ALKALI: (1) kzAraH;(2) sarjjiH (?)
ALKALI , s. sarjjikA, sarjjiH f., kzAraH, sarjjikAkzAraH, yavakzAraH, goga- vAhI m. (n).
ALKALINE , a. kzArasvaBAvaH -vA -vaM, kzAraviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, sarjjiyuktaH -ktA -ktaM.

All, s. sarvaM, aKilaM, sAkalyaM. a. sarva-viSva- pron. a., aKila, sakala, kftsna, niKila, samasta; ‘not at a(ll)’ na kimapi, na manAgapi ‘at a(ll) times’ sarvadA; ‘a(ll) but’ prAya, kalpa, in comp.; ‘a(ll) but dead’ mftaprAya; CinnaprAya ‘a(ll) but cut’; ‘a(ll) of a sudden’ akasmAt, sahasA, sapadi, ekapade; ‘this is not a(ll)’ etAvatApi dozo &c. na samApyate; ‘a(ll) I can’ yaTASakti, yaTAsAmarTyaM; ‘this is a(ll) I can do to serve you’ etAvAnme viBavo BavaMtaM sevituM (M. 2); ‘by a(ll) means’ sarvaTA; ‘a(ll)-in-a(ll) of oneʼs life’ jIvitasarvasvaM; ‘a(ll) at once’ yugapat; ‘a(ll) round’, sarvataH, sarvadikzu, samaMtataH; ‘in a(ll)’ sAkalyena, piMqIkftya, militvA; ‘give me 20 rupees in a(ll)’ evaM piMqIkftya mahyaM viMSatiM rUpakAndehi, sarve militvA sapta vayaM ‘we are 7 in a(ll)’; ‘a(ll)- bearing’ sarvaMsaha; ‘a(ll)-conquering’ sarvadamana, sarvaMjaya, sarvaMdama; ‘a(ll)-destroying’ sarvaMkaza; ‘a(ll)-knowing’ sarvajYa, sarvavid; ‘a(ll)-pervading’ sarvavyApin, viSvAtman, sarvagata; ‘a(ll) powerful’ sarvaSaktimat.

ALL (adj.) (1) sarvaH: (rvA, rvaM); all of them, en- joying a. pleasures at a. times, reached the pin- nacle of happiness sarvaeva sarvakAlaM sarvasuKAnyaBanuvantaH parAM kowimAnandasyADyagacCan, K. ;(2) sakalaH (lA, laM);(3) samastaH (stA, staM);(4) niKilaH (lA, laM), knowledge of a. characters, erudition in the languages of a. countries, attainments in a. the Shastras sakalalipiYJAnaM niKiladeSIyamAzApARqityaM samastaSAstracAturyam, D. ;(5) aKilaH (lA, laM);(6) kftsnaH (snA, snaM);(7) samagraH (grA, graM);(8) samudAyaH affd., or the abode of a. essence of beauty sOndaryasArasamudAryAnaketanaM vA, Ma. ii. Ph. the Supreme Spirit is a. joy AnandamayaH paramAtmA, S. i. 13.: v. Full of; by a. means, one ought not to do anything without consideration sarvaTA avicAritaM karma na kartavyam H. i.; at a. events antataH; a. along pUrvAvaDi; a. around sarvataH.

ALL (subs): sarva; I want to hear a. about it sarva SrotumicCAmi. Ph.: a. I can yaTASakti; a. of a sudden sapadi; in a. sAkalyena; does not breathe at. a. na manAgapyucCvasiti; K.; you are not kind at a. tvayi dayAleSo'pi na vidyate; a. you have to say is this *idameva or kevalamidameva tvayA vAcyam...
ALL , a. sarvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, viSvaH -SvA -SvaM, kftsnaH -tsnA -tsnaM, niKilaH -lA -laM, aKilaH -lA -laM, samastaH -stA -staM, sakalaH -lA -laM.

ALL , s. (The whole) sarvvaM, kArtsnaM, kArtsnyaM, sAkalyaM; ‘In all, alto- gether,’ sarvvaSas, sAkalyena, kftsnaSas; ‘not at all,’ na kaTaYcana, na manAk; ‘at all times,’ sarvvadA; ‘all but,’ prAyas ind., prAyaSas, IzadUnaH -nA -naM; ‘all of a sudden,’ akasmAt; ‘all I can,’ yaTA- Sakti ind., yaTAbalaM, yaTAsAmarTyaM; ‘all around,’ sarvvatas, samantatas, paritas, caturdikzu; ‘by all means,’ sarvvaTA; ‘all at once,’ yugapat ind., ‘most of all,’ BUyizWaM, viSezatas; ‘all hail,’ namas ind.
ALL-ATONING , a. sarvvapApanASakaH -kA -kaM, sarvvapApaSoDakaH -kA -kaM.
ALL-BEARING , a. sarvvasahaH -hA -haM. — (Omniparous) sarvvaprasavI -vinI -vi (n).
ALL-CONQUERING: (1) sarvajayin (f. nI);(2) sarvadamanaH (nA, naM).
ALL-CONQUERING , a. sarvvajayI -yinI -yi (n), sarvvadamanaH -nA -naM, sarvva- ndamaH -mA -maM.
ALL-DESTROYING: (1) sarvaDvaMsin (f. nI);(2) sarvaNkazaH (zA zaM).
ALL-FORGIVING: (1) sarvaMsahaH or sarvasahaH (hA, haM); (2) sarvasahizRu (mfn.)
ALL-GLORIOUS: (1) sarvatejomayaH (yA, yaM);(2) sarvapratApavat (f. tI).
ALL-GLORIOUS , a. sarvvatejomayaH -yI -yaM, sarvvapratApavAn -vatI -vat (t).
ALL-KNOWING: sarvajYaH (jYA, jYaM); (2) sarvavid (mfn.).
ALL-KNOWING , a. sarvvajYaH -jYA -jYaM, sarvvavedI -dinI -di (n).
ALL-LOVING , a. sarvvapriyaH -yA -yaM, sarvvahitEzI -ziRI -zi (n).
ALL-MATURING , a. sarvvapAcakaH -kA -kaM, sarvvapAcanaSIlaH -lA -laM.
ALL-PENETRATING , a. sarvvaBedakaH -kA -kaM, sarvvapraveSakaH -kA -kaM.
ALL-PERVADING: (1) sarvavyApin (f. nI);(2) sarvagataH (tA, taM).
ALL-PERVADING , sarvvagataH -tA -taM, sarvvavyApI -pinI -pi (n), sarvvatragaH -gA -gaM.
ALL-POWERFUL: (1) sarvaSaktimat (f. tI);(2) sarva- SaktisamanvitaH (tA, taM).
ALL-SEEING: (1) sarvadarSin (f. nI);(2) sarvadrazwwa (f. zwrI).
ALL-SEEING , a. sarvvadarSI -rSinI -rSi (n), sarvvadrazwA -zwrI -zwf (zwf).
ALL-SUFFICIENCY , n. sarvvaSaktitA, sarvvasAmarTyaM.
ALL-SUFFICIENT , sarvvasamarTaH -rTA -rTaM, sarvvaSaktimAn -matI -mat (t).
ALL-WISE: (1) sarvaYjaH (YjA, YjaM);(2) sarvaYjAnamayaH (yI, yaM).
ALL-WISE , a. sarvvajYaH -jYA -jYaM, sarvvavid m. f. n., sarvvavedI -dinI -di (n) sarvvajYAnamayaH -yI -yaM.

Allay, v. t. pra-upa-Sam c. (Samayati). niyam c., nirvA c. (vApayati); ‘a(llay)ing of heat’ nirvApaRaM. 2 sAMtv 10, tuz c. [Allay]er, s. SamakaH, SAMtidaH-karaH. [Allay]ment, s. praSamanaM, sAMtvanaM; ‘a(llayment) of hunger’ kzutpratIkAraH.
ALLAY (v. t.); Samayati, pra-, (c. of Sam), a. s the heat Samayati paritApaM Sa. iv.: v. To app- -ease, mitigate.

To ALLAY , v. a. (To mitigate) Sam in caus. (Samayati -yituM), praSam upaSam; SAntv or sAntv (c. 10. SAntvayati -yituM) aBiSAntv pari- SAntv; tuz in caus. (tozayati -yituM). — (To mix one metal with another) DAtuM DAtunA miSr (c. 10. miSrayati -yituM); suvarRaM rUpyaM vA kupyena miSr.
ALLAY or ALLAYMENT, s. (Mitigation) SAntiH f., praSamanaM, praSAntiH f., sAntvanaM; ‘allayment of fear,’ BayopaSamaH; ‘allayment of hunger,’ kzutpratIkAraH. — (Mixture of base metal) kupyasamparkaH.
ALLAYED , p. p. praSAntaH -ntA -ntaM, upaSAntaH -ntA -ntaM, praSamitaH -tA -taM.
ALLAYER , s. SamakaH, SAntikaraH, SAntikarttA m. (rttf), SAntidaH.
ALLEGATION: (1) vacanam;(2) uktiH v. Asser- -tion, plea.
ALLEGATION , s. (Affirmation) vacanaM, aBiyogaH, vAkyaM, aBiDAnaM. — (False allegation) miTyABiSaMsanaM. — (Excuse, plea) Cadma n. (n), upadeSaH, vyapadeSaH.

Allege, v. t. pratijYA 9 A, vad 1 P, dfQaM brU 2 U; ‘the charges a(lleg)ed against me’ mayi samAropitA dozAH. 2 Cadma kf 8 U, vyapadiS 6 P, miTyA vad. 3 udAhf 1 P. [Alleg]ation, s. pratijYA, ukti f., vacanopanyAsaH. 2 dozAropaH, miTyABiyogaH. 3 vyapadeSaH, Cadman n., vyAjaH.
ALLEGE (v. t.): I To affirm, to assert: q. v.: prati-jAnIte (jYA, c. 9).II To cite, quote.: q. v.: udA-harati (hf, c. 1).
To ALLEGE , v. a. (To affirm, declare) vad (c. 1. vadati, vadituM), taTeti brU (c. 2. bravIti brUte vaktuM). — (To plead as an excuse) Cadma kf, vyapadiS. (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), miTyA vad.
ALLEGEABLE , a. vacanIyaH -yA -yaM, vadanIyaH -yA -yaM, kaTanIyaH -yA -yaM.
Allegiance, s. nizWA, Bakti f. anurAgaH; ‘a(llegiance) to the king’ rAjanizWA.
ALLEGIANCE: BaktiH, they took an oath of a. to Caesar *vayaM sijAraTaktA iti SapaTaM cakruH.
ALLEGIANCE , s. BaktiH f., anurAgaH, vaSIBUtatvaM, aDInatvaM.
ALLEGIANT , a. BaktimAn -matI -mat (t), anurAgI -giRI -gi (n).
ALLEGORICAL: rUpakamayaH (yI, yaM) (?): v. Figu- -rative.
ALLEGORICAL , a. rUpakamayaH -yI -yaM, dfzwAntarUpaH -pI -paM, lAkzaRikaH -kI -kaM.
ALLEGORICALLY , adv. dfzwAntatas ind., lAkzaRikaprakAreRa, rUpakakrameRa.
To ALLEGORISE , v. a. dfzwAntIkf, dfzwAntay (nom. dfzwAntayati -yituM) lAkzaRikaprakAreRa vad (c. 1. vadati, vadituM).
ALLEGORIZE: I To turn into allegory: *rUpaka- krameRa varRayati (varRa, c. 10)II To interpret allegorically: *rUpakArTaM saM-yojayati (c. of. yuj).
Allegory, s. rUpakaM, dfzwAMtaH. [Allegor]ical, a. lAkzaRika (kI f.), rUpakamaya (yI f.). [Allegor]ically, adv. dfzwAMtataH, dfzwAMtena. [Allegor]ize, v. t. dfzwAMtayati (D.), rUpakeRa dfS c.
ALLEGRO , adv. tvaritaM, kzipraM, SIGraM.

Alleviate, v. t. upa-pra-Sam c., niyam c., sAMtv 10; nirvA c. (vApayati), laGayati (D.), laGUkf 8 U. [Alleviat]ion, s. upa-pra-SamaH, nirvApaRaM; ‘a(lleviation) of sorrow’ duHKanirvApaRaM. [Alleviat]ive, a. SAMtida, Samaka.
ALLEVIATE (v. t.): (1) Samayati, pra-, (c. of Sam): (2) laGayati (nomi.): v. To mitigate.

To ALLEVIATE , v. a. Sam in caus. (Samayati -yituM), praSam, upaSam; SAntv or sAntv (c. 10. sAntvayati -yituM), aBiSAntv, upasAntv, pariSAntva; laG (nom. laGayati -yituM), udDf (c. 1. -harati -te -harttuM), laGUkf.
ALLEVIATED , p. p. praSamitaH -tA -taM, praSAntaH -ntA -ntaM, upaSAntaH -ntA -ntaM, laGUkftaH -tA -taM.
ALLEVIATION: I Mitigation: q. v.: upaSamaH II Extenuation: q. v.
ALLEVIATION , s. SAntiH f., praSamanaM, praSAntiH, upaSamaH, laGUkaraRaM, lAGavaM.
ALLEVIATIVE , a. (Giving alleviation) SAntidaH -dA -daM, SAntikaraH -rA -raM, SamakaH -kA -kaM.
Alley, s. udyAnapaTaH, vITi-TI f. 2 durgamamArgaH, saMbADapaTaH.
ALLEY (subs): A walk in a garden: (1) udvAnapaTaH;(2) udyAnavartman (n);(3) vITiH v. Avenue.II A narrow passage: saNkIrRapaTaH.
ALLEY , s. (A narrow passage) saNkawapaTaH, sambADapaTaH, saNkucitavITiH f. — (A walk in a garden) udyAnapaTaH.
ALLIANCE: A union between states: sanDiH; offensive and defensive a. parasparopakArasanDiH, H. iv.: v. Treaty, league. II Union arising from marriage: sambanDaH matrimonial a. vEvAhikaH sambanDaH.
ALLIANCE , s. (League) sanDiH m., sAhityaM, saMyogaH, sAhyaM, sahAyatA, EkyaM. — (Relation by marriage, &c.) sambanDaH, jYAtisamparkaH; ‘offensive and defensive alliance,’ parasparopakAraH.
ALLIED , p. p. sanDitaH -tA -taM, sahitaH -tA -taM, sambadDaH -dDA -dDaM, saMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
Alligate, v. t. saM-anu-baMD 9 P. [Alligat]ion, s. saMbaMDaH, saMyojanaM.
To ALLIGATE , v. a. sambanD (c. 9. -baDnAti -bandDuM or caus. -banDayati -yituM), anubanD, AbanD.
ALLIGATION , s. (Tying together) sanDAnaM, sambanDanaM, saMyojanaM. — (Rule in arithmetic) sammiSradravyARAM mUlyaM nirUpayati yo gaRanAviDiH, arDasaMKyApanaM.
Alligator, s. nakraH, grAhaH.
ALLIGATOR: (1) nakraH;(2) kumBIraH.
ALLIGATOR , s. nakraH, grAhaH, kumBIraH.
Alliteration, s. anuprAsaH.
ALLITERATION: anuprAsaH.
ALLITERATION , s. anuprAsaH.
Allocate, v. t. sTAnaM dA 3 U. [Allocat]ion, s. sTAnadAnaM.
ALLODIAL: Ph. a. land nizkaraBUmiH (?). a. land belonging to a Brahmin brahmottaraH (?).
ALLODIAL , a. anaDInaH -nA -naM, anAyattaH -ttA -ttaM, svADInaH -nA -naM.
To ALLOO , v. a. (Set on by crying alloo) he hE ityAdiSabdEH kukku- rAn pracud (caus. -codayati -yituM).
Allot, v. t. parikxp c., dA 3 U, viBaj 1 U. [Allot]ment, s. viBAgaH, viBajanaM. 2 aMSaH, BAgaH.
ALLOT (v. t.): I Distribute: q. v. vi-Bajati (Baj, c. 1)II To grant, assign: q. v.: dadAti (dA, c. 3).

To ALLOT , v. a. (Distribute by lot) viBaj (c. 1. -Bajati -te -BaktuM), praviBaj; vyaMs (c. 10. -aMsayati -yituM), aMS (c. 10. aMSayati -yituM), vinyas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), vyas; kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), parikxp. — (To grant) pradA (c. 8. -dadAti -dAtuM).
ALLOTMENT: I The act of allotting:(1) vimAgaH;(2) vimajanam.II That which is allotted: aMSaH v. Share.
ALLOTMENT , s. (Distributing by lot) viBAgaH, aMSanaM, viBAgakalpanA. — (The portion granted) aMSaH, BAgaH, viBAgaH.

Allow, v. t. anujYA 9 U, anuman 4 A, anumud 1 A. 2 Give, q. v. 3 grah 9 P; See Admit. 4 upa-Ikz 1 A, vizah 1 A; sa kasmAdAryeRApakrAmamupekzitaH (Mu. 3); ‘I a(llow) my feet to be burnt’ dahyamAnAvapi caraRAvupekze. 5 (for) nyUnIkf 8 U, na gaR 10. [Allow]able, a. anujYeya, anumodya; ‘a(llowable) mistake’, kzamArhoparADaH; ‘not a(llowable)’ prati-ni-zidDa. [Allow]ance, s. anujYA, anumati f., anumodanaM. 2 vetanaM, nirUpitamUlyaM, vftti f. 3 svIkAraH; nyUnIkaraRaM.

ALLOW (v. t.): I To concede, permit:(1) anu-manyate (man, c. 4), if you a. me space in (your) flower-bed yadi kusumAstaraRe'vakASamanumanyase, Sa. iii.;(2) anu-medate (mud, c. 1), now none is a. ed egress or ingress without a pass idAnIM na kopyamudrAlAYCito nizkramituM pravezwuMvAnumodyate, M. v.; (3) anu-jAnAmi (jYA, c. 9) v. To permit.II To grant, bestow: q. v. dadAti (dA, c. 3). III To acknowledge: q. v. svIkaroti (kf, c. 8).

To ALLOW , v. a. anujYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM), aByanujYA; anuman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM), sah (c. 1. sahate soQuM), vizah, anumud (c. 1. -modate -modituM). — (To admit an argument) grah (c. 9. gfhlAti grahItuM). — (To allow wages) varttanaM dA or anudA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM). — (To abate) udDAraM kf, nyUnIkf.

ALLOWABLE , a. DarmyaH -rmyA -rmyaM, anujYeyaH -yA -yaM, anujYAtavyaH -vyA -vyaM, svIkaraRIyaH -yA -yaM, anujYAyogyaH -gyA -gyaM, dAtavyaH -vyA -vyaM. — (Ad- missible) grAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, gfhyaH -hyA -hyaM, pragfhyaH -hyA -hyaM.
ALLOWANCE: I Acknowledgment: q. v.: svIkAraH.II Permission: q. v.: anujYA.III That which is allowed: no equiv.: vfttiH, of the Pandits enjoying my a. s. maddattAM vfttiM BuYjAnAnAM paRqitAnAM, P.
ALLOWANCE, make: vigaRayati (gaR, c. 10), making a. for the temptations of youth *yOvanasya praloBanAni vigaRayya: v. To consider.
ALLOWANCE , s. anujYA, anumatiH f. — (Stipulated pay) varttanaM, vetanaM, nirUpitamUlyaM, parimitamUlyaM. — (Abatement) udDAraH, nyUnIkaraRaM.
ALLOWED , p. p. anujYAtaH -tA -taM, aByanujYAtaH -tA -taM, anumataH -tA -taM.
Alloy, s. miSraRaM, dozaH, nyUnatA. 2 apadravyaM, kupyaM, miSraDAtuH. [Alloy]ed, a. miSrita, dUzita; ‘un-a(lloyed) pleasure’ kevalaM-duHKAsaMBinnaM-suKaM.
ALLOY (v. t.): miSrayati (miSr, c. 10): v. To mix: Ph., a. ed with pain duHKopasfzwaH (zwA, zwaM), D. s.; being a. ed with pain duHKasaMBinnatayA, D. s.
ALLOY (subs.): I Any compound of two or more metals: miSraDAtuH.II Evil mixed with good: Ph. enjoyed pleasures without a. *avi- miSritAni suKAnyanubaBfva.
ALLOY , s. apadravyaM, kupyaM, kUwasvarRaM, alpamUlyako DAtuH, dUzaRaM, dozaH, malaM. — (Abatement, impairment) nyUnatA, kzayaH, viGnaH.
ALLOYED , p. p. dUzitaH -tA -taM, duzwaH -zwA -zwaM.

Allude, v. t. uddiSya-aDikftya vad 1 P or vac 2 P or aBiDA 3 U; uddiS 6 P, sUc 10, lakzIkf; anusaMDA; ‘this story a(llude)s to myself’ iyaM kaTA mAmeva lakzIkaroti (S. 7). Allusion, s. uddeSaH, udAharaRaM, kIrtanaM; iMgitaM, sUcanaM; ‘in a(llusion) to’ aDikftya, samuddiSya.

ALLUDE: (1) uddiSya or lakzIkftya vadati, aBiDatte, etc. (in speaking);(2) lakzIkaroti (=to point, refer); what ! this alludes to me kaTamiyaM kaTA mAmeva lakzIkaroti, Sa. vii. Ph. this mythological story is here a. d to (?) — iti pOrARikI kaTAtrAnusanDeyA, M. n.

To ALLUDE , v. n. (Hint at) uddiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), samuddiS, sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), iNgaM or iNgitaM or saNketaM kf, smf in caus. (smArayati -yituM), prabuD in caus. (-boDayati -yituM).
ALLUDED , p. p. uddizwaH -zwA -zwaM, sUcitaH -tA -taM, smftaH -tA -taM.
Allure, v. t. hf 1 P, Akfz 1 P, vi-pra-luB c. [Allur]ing, a. praloBaka, hArin, Akarzaka; ‘a(lluring) things’ praloBanavastUni. [Allure]ment, s. pra-vi-loBanaM; vaMcanaM, vikArahetuH, AkarzaRaM.

ALLURE (v. t.): (1) Akarzati (kfz, c. 1.), men are a. d by these sweet (but) false words ABistAvanmaDurABiranftavAgmirAkfzyante vizayiRaH, Sa. v.;(2) harati (hf, c. 1.): even an old man like myself is, as a rule, a. d by pleasures hriyate vizayEH prAyo varzIyAnapi mAdfSaH, Ki. xi. 10.;(3) praloBayati, (c. of luB) v. To tempt.
To ALLURE , v. a. Akfz (c. 1. -karzati or c. 6. -kfzati -krazwuM), samAkfz; praluB in caus. (-loBayati -yituM).
ALLURED , p. p. AkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM or AkartpitaH -tA -taM, praloBitaH -tA -taM.
ALLUREMENT: praloBanam: v. Temptation, entice- -ment.
ALLUREMENT , s. praloBanaM, AkarzaRaM, viloBanaM, vaYcanaM, BogaH.
ALLURING (adj.): (1) hArin (f. RI);(2) praloBakaH (kA, kaM);(3) AkarzakaH (kI kaM) (rare).
ALLURING , a. AkarzakaH -kA -kaM, AkarzI -rziRI -rzi (n), praloBakaH -kA -kaM, vaYcakaH -kA -kaM.
ALLURINGLY , adv. praloBanapUrvvakaM, praloBanena, AkarzakaprakAreRa.
ALLUSION: Ph. his a. to my poverty *mama dAridrpaM lakzIkftya sa yaduvAca; there is not the least a. of Kṛṣṇa in the Rig Veda *fgvede kfzRasyABAso'pi na lakzyate v. To allude.
ALLUSION , s. (Hint) iNgaM, iNgitaM, saNketaH, AkAraH. — (Allusion to) uddeSaH, sUcanaM. — (In allusion to) uddiSya, samuddiSya.
ALLUSIVE , a. uddeSakaH -kA -kaM, sUcakaH -kA -kaM.
ALLUVIAL: Ph. a. accretion *payovastaBUmiH.
ALLUVION , s. pulinaM, nadIrayeRa or jalapravAheRa samAnItA mfttikA.
ALLUVIOUS , a. nadIrayeRa samAnItaH -tA -taM, pulinamayaH -yI -yaM.
Alluvium, s. pulinaM, nadIrayasamAhftA mfttikA. Alluvial, a. pulinamaya (yI f.).

Ally, s. mitraM, sahAyaH, pakzyaH, sahakArin m. v. t. saMbaMD 9 P. 2 saMDA 3 U; saMyuj 10, saMSliz c. Alliance, s. saMDiH; ‘friendly a(lliance)’ saKya, mEtrI. 2 saMbaMDaH, saMparkaH; ‘matrimonial a(lliance)’ vivAhasaMbaMDaH.
ALLY (subs): mitram, M.
ALLY (v. t.) I To unite or connect: sambanDaM karoti, saMbaDnAti (banD, c. 9.)II To form an alliance with (between states).: sanDiM karoti or saMdaDAti (DA, c. 3.).
ALLY , s. sahAyaH, sahakArI m. (n), mitraM, sfhfd m., parasparopakArI m. (n), sambanDI m. (n).
To ALLY , v. a. sanDA (c. 3. -daDAti -Datte -DAtuM), sambanD (caus. -banDayati -yituM), saMyuj (c. 10. -yojayati -yituM), saMSliz in caus. (-Slezayati -yituM).
Almanac, s. paMjikA, paMcAMgaM.
ALMANAC: paYjikA; a. maker paYjikAkAraH (?)
ALMANAC , s. paYjikA, paYjiH f.
ALMANAC , s. paYcANgaM; ‘maker of one,’ paYcANgakarttA m. (rttf).
ALMANAC-MAKER , s. paYjIkaraH, paYjikAracakaH.
ALMIGHTINESS: (1) sarvaSaktimattvam;(2) sarvaSaktitvam.
ALMIGHTINESS , s. sarvvaSaktimattvaM, sarvvasAmarTyaM.
Almighty, a. sarvaSaktimat, amitOjas; sarvaSak, sarvasamarTa.
ALMIGHTY: (1) sarvaSaktimat (f. tI);(2) sarvaSakti (mfn.);(3) sarvaSaktisamanvitaH (tA, taM).
ALMIGHTY , a. sarvvaSaktimAn -matI -mat (t), sarvvasamarTaH -rTA -rTaM, sarvvaSak m. f. n., amitOjAH -jAH -jaH (s).
Almond, s. vAtAmaPalaM.
ALMOND: vAdAmam. Bitter a. tiktavAdAmam. A. tree vAdAmavfkzaH.
ALMOND , s. pArasIkajanEr bAdAmity aBiDIyate yat PalaM.
ALMONER: *BikzAvitaraRakArI.
ALMONER , s. dAnaDarmme niyuktaH, BikzAvitaraRe aDikftaH, daridrezu yad DanaM dAtavyaM tadvitaraRe aDikftaH.
ALMONER , s. dAnADyakzaH, dAnADikArI m. (n), dAnADikftaH.
Almonry, s. BikzAdAnagfhaM, BEkzyaSAlA. Almoner, s. BikzAdAne aDikftaH.
ALMONRY , s. dAnaDarmme niyuktasya gfhaM, BikzAvitaraRaSAlA.

Almost, adv. prAya, BUyizWa, kalpa, affixed to adj.; ‘a(lmost) dead’ mftakalpa, mftaprAya; ‘when the night had a(lmost) worn away’ kzIRaBUyizWAyAM kzapAyAM; ‘it is a(lmost) dawn now’ aDunA praBAta-prAyA-kalpA SarvarI. 2 prAyaH, prAyaSaH, ‘a(lmost) all’ prAyaH sarve. 3 (With num.) ex. by Asanna, upa, in comp.; upa-Asanna-daSAH &c.

ALMOST: (1) prAyaH (yA, yaM), it is a. morning now praBAtaprAyA rajanI, Sa. iv;(2) kalpaH (lpA, lpaM), [Page023] a. well prasannakalpaH, D. ii.; a. undertaken pratipannakalpam. Ku. iii. 14;(3) BUyizWaH (zWA, zWaM), a. extinguished nirvARaBUyizWam, Ku. iii. 52. N. B. Note that these words are placed after adjectives or part. adj. s and that, there- -fore, when in Englsh a. qualifies verbs, it should be expressed in Sanskrit by corresp. part. adj. s: when I had a. finished *avasitaprAye mama vAkye.

ALMOST , adv. prAyas, prAyaSas, BUyizWaM, IzadUnaH -nA -naM, kalpaH affixed. — (Somewhat less) IzadUnaM, yat kiYcina nyUnaM; ‘almost four,’ upacaturAH m. pl.; ‘almost every person,’ prAyaH sarvvajanaH; ‘almost dead,’ mumUrzuH or mftaprAyaH or mftakalpaH; ‘almost finished,’ samAptaBU- yizWaH; ‘seven days being almost ended,’ saptasu dinezu samAptakalpezu.
Alms, s. Bakzya, BikzA, BikzAdAnaM; ‘beg a(lms)’ BikzAwanaM kf 8 U, Bikz-yAc 1 A; ‘a(lms)-giving’ BikzAdAnaM, tyAgaH; ‘a(lms) house’ anATagfhaM, BikzAgehaM; ‘a(lms) man’ BikzukaH, BikzASin m.
ALMS: (1) BikzA;(2) BEkzam. To beg a. Bikzate (Bikz, c. 1).
ALMS , s. BEkzaM, BEkzyaM, BikzA, BikzAnnaM, dAnaM; ‘to beg alms,’ Bikz (c. 1. Bikzate BikzituM), BEkzyaM car (c. 1. carati, carituM), BikzAwanaM kf.
ALMS-BOX , s. BikzApAtraM, dAnADAraH.
ALMS-GIVER , s. BikzAdAtA m. (tf), daridrapozakaH.
ALMS-GIVING: (1) dAnaDarmaH;(2) BikzAdAnam.
ALMS-GIVING , s. dAnaDarmmaH, dAnakAryyaM, BikzAdAnaM, daridrapozaRaM.
ALMS-HOUSE: (1) daridraSAlA (?);(2) anATASramaH. (?).
ALMS-HOUSE , s. daridrapozaRaSAlA, BikzAvitaraRaSAlA.
ALMS-MAN , s. BikzAcaraH, BikzukaH, BikzASI m. (n), BikzopajIvI m. (n).
Aloe, s. sahA; kumArIrasodBavo bolaH.
ALOE: GftakumArI. a. wood. aguruH.
ALOE , s. (The plant) kumArI, sahA, sTUladalA. — (A precious wood) aguruH, agurukAzWaM.
ALOE , s. (The plant) GftakumArI -rikA, ajarA.
Aloft, adv. UrDvaM, upari; ‘a(loft) in the air’ vihAyasA, vyomavartmanA.
ALOFT: I On high: UrDvam.II In the air: (1) vihAyasA;(2) AkASapaTena.
ALOFT , adv. urdDvaM, upari, uparizwAt, uccaM. — (In-air) vihAyasA.
ALOFT , for urdDvaM, read UrdDvaM.

sanskrit.iast: nimiṣamapi tena vinā sthātumekākī na śaśāka

details.body: Alone, a. eka, advitIya, ekAkin. 2 eva, kevalaM, mAtra in comp.

ALONE (adj.) I Without anybody else: ekAkin (f. nI), he could not remain a. even for a moment without him nimizamapi tena vinA sTAtumekAkI na SaSAka, K. v. Solitary.II One out of many: ekaH (kA, kaM) (with eva or kevalam), let Bhāgu- rāyana a. accompany me BAgurAyaRa eka eva mAmanugacCatu, Mu. iv.; let my intellect a. remain with me ekA kevalam.....budDistu mA gAnmama, Mu. i.III By itself: kevalaH (lA, laM), policy a. is cowardice kAtaryaM kevalA nItiH R. xvii. 47. Ph. let imperiality be a. AstAYcakravartitA, D. viii.: v. To let alone.
ALONE , a. ekAntaH -ntA -ntaM, ekaH -kA -kaM, ekAkI -kinI -ki (n), niBftaH -tA -taM, kevalaH -lA -laM, kevalI -linI -li (n), advitIyaH -yA -yaM. — (Only) kevalaM, mAtraM.

Along, prep. anu in comp. or with acc.; or by instr.; ‘a(long) the way’ anumArgaM, ‘a(long) the city of Ayodhyā’ ayoDyAnagarImanu, ‘a(long) a road’ mArgeRa. 2 puraH, agne, purastAt; ‘a(long) with’ saha, sArDaM; See With; ‘all a(long)’ ApraTamaM, praTamAvaDi; ‘a(long) side’ pArSvataH; samIpaM-pe.

ALONG (prep.): anu, (in comp. or with acc.), a. the bank anukacCam; flows a. the city of Oudh vahatyayoDyAmanu rAjaDAnIm, R. A. with: saha (with ins.): v. With. A. side pArSvataH. All a. praTamAvaDi. A. of: v. On account of.

ALONG , prep. (At length, all along the side of) anu prefixed to the acc. c. neuter; as, ‘along the Ganges,’ anugaNgaM; ‘along the bank,’ anukacCaM. — (Forward) agre, puras ind., purastAt. — (Along with) saha, sArdDaM, sahitaH -tA -taM. — (All along, from first to last) praTamAvaDeH praBfti SezaparyyantaM, sarvvatra. — (Along-side) pArSvatas ind.
Aloof, adv. dUre, aMtare, pfTak; ‘standing a(loof)’ dUrasTa; ‘keep a(loof)’ pfTak niDA 3 U, na gaR 10.
ALOOF , adv. dUre, kiyaddUre, IzaddUre, antare, niBftaM, pfTak. — (Standing aloof) dUrasTaH.
Alopecia, s. akeSatA, keSahInatvaM.
Aloud, adv. uccEH, ucca-tAra-svareRa. 2 prakASaM, pra-ut-muktakaMWaM (‘weep a(loud)’), ‘call a(loud)’ SabdAyate (D.).
ALOUD: (1) uccEH or uccEHsvareRa (with a loud voice);(2) muktakaRWam (with loosened throat);(3) prakASam (openly). To call a.: SabdAyate (nomi.).
ALOUD , adv. prakASaM, uccEs ind., uccakEs, proccEs, uccEHsvareRa, mahAnAdena, uccEstamAm ind., muktakaRWaM.
Alphabet, s. varRamAlA. [Alphabet]ical, a. varRakramAnusArin. [Alphabet]ically, adv. varRakrameRa, varRAnusAreRa.
ALPHABET: varRamAlA. a. ically: (1) varRakrameRa; (2) varRAnusAreRa.
ALPHABET , s. varRamAlA, varRakramaH, akzaravinyAsaH, varRasaNGAwaH.
ALPHABET , s. akzaramAlA, akzarasamAhAraH, varRamAtfkA, varRAnukramaH.
ALPHABETICAL , a. varRakramAnusArI -riRI -ri (n), varRamAlASreRyanurUpaH -pA -paM.
ALPHABETICALLY , adv. varRakramAnusAratas ind., varRamAlASreRyanurUpaM.
Already, adv. pUrvaM, purA, prAk, with eva; sometimes by eva alone; ‘the moon has a(lready) risen’ udita eva himaraSmiH.
ALREADY: (1) prAgeva;(2) pUrvameva. Sometimes by sim. eva: he is a. come sa Agata eva; the sun is already up udita eva BAskaraH.
ALREADY , adv. (Some time ago) tatpUrvvaM, pUrvvaM, purA, pUrvvakAle, prAg varttamAnakAlAt. — (At the present time) tatkzaRe, samprati, tatkAle.

sanskrit.iast: kevalaṃ yo mahato'pabhāṣane śṛṇoti tasmādapi yaḥ sa

details.body: Also, adv. api, ca. 2 aparaMca, punaSca, apica. 3 tadvat.

ALSO: api; Chandrāpida a. entered into thoughts candrApIqo'pi cintAM viveSa, K.; not only he who speaks ill of the great but a. he who hears na kevalaM yo mahato'paBAzane SfRoti tasmAdapi yaH sa Ku. v. 53.
ALSO , adv. ca, cEva, apica, evaM, aparaYva, punarapi, punaSca. — (In like manner) tadvat ind., tadviGe, tatprakAre.
Altar, s. vedi-dI f., cEtyaM, sTaMqilaM.

Altar, v. t. anyaTA kf 8 U, viparyas 4 P, viparyAsaM nI 1 P, parivft c. 2 vikf, virUp 10, ‘a(ltar)ed in appearance’ BinnAMkAra iva lakzyamARa. v. i. parivft 1 A, anyaTA-anyarUpa a. BU; viparyAsaM yA 2 P. [Altar]ation, s. pari(rI)vartaH, vikAraH, vikfti f., viparyAsaH.
ALTAR (subs.): (1) vediH;(2) cEtyam.
ALTAR , s. cEtyaM, AyatanaM, vediH m. or -dI f., cayanaM, yajYavediH, sTaRqilaM.

ALTER (v. t.): (1) karoti (kf, c. 8.) (when the sense is clear): he concluded that the merchant had a. ed the R into S. rePe sakAraM vaRijA kAritaM niScikAya saH, Raj.;(2) By means of anyaH (nyA, nyat), BinnaH (nnA, nnaM) etc.: as if you are a. ed in appearance tvamanyamAkAramivABipannaH, Ki., iii. 46.;(3) parivartayati (c. of vft). c. l.)v. To change.
ALTER (v. i.): parivartate (vft, c. 1.) v. To change, vary.

To ALTER , v. a. anyaTA kf, anyarUpaM -pAM -paM kf, anyaprakAraM -rAM -raM kf, viparyas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), parivft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM). — (To alter for the worse) vikf (c. 8. -kurute -karttuM), virUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM).
To ALTER , v. n. anyaTA or anyarUpaH -pA -paM or anyaprakAraH -rA -raM BU. — (For the worse) vikf (c. 8. -kurute). — (To alter in mind and feelings) vimanIBU.
ALTERABLE (adj.): parivartanIyaH (yA, yaM) v. Changeable.
ALTERABLE , a. vikAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, anyaTA karaRIyaH -yA -yaM, vikAraSIlaH -lA -laM, parIvarttanIyaH -yA -yaM, pariRAmayogyaH -gyA -gyaM.
ALTERAGE , s. (The fostering of a child) bAlakapozaRaM, putrapratipAlanaM.
ALTERATION: (1) parivfttiH;(2) pariRAmaH;(3) vipAkaH;(4) vikAraH. N. B. The last three words refer to change in form etc. v. Change.
ALTERATION , s. vikAraH, vikriyA, vikftiH f., pariRAmaH, parIvarttanaM, anyaTABAvaH, vEkftyaM.
ALTERATIVE , a. vikArI -riRI -ri (n), parivarttakaH -kA -kaM, pariRAmakaraH -rA -raM.
Altercate, v. i. vivad 1 A, kalahAyate (D.) [Altercat]ion, s. vivAdaH, kalahaH, vAgyudDaM.
ALTERCATE (v. i.): (1) kalahAyate (nomi);(2) vi-vadate (vad, c. 1.) v. To wrangle.
To ALTERCATE , v. n. vivad (c. 1. -vadate -vadituM), vyavakruS (c. 1. kroSati -krozwuM).
ALTERCATION: (1) kalahaH;(2) vivAdaH. v. Quarrel, wrangling.
ALTERCATION , s. vipralApaH, vyavakroSanaM, vyAvaBAzI f., vAdAnuvAdaH, vivAdaH, uttarapratyuttaraM, vAkyaviroDaH, vAgyudDaM, vAkyaM.
ALTERED , p. p. vikftaH -tA -taM, vEkftaH -tA -taM, anyarUpaH -pA -paM, anyaTA kftaH -tA -taM, kftavikriyaH -yA -yaM. — (In mind) vimanIkftaH -tA -taM.
Alter-ego, s. liMgadehaH, sUkzmaSarIraM.

Alternate, a. Ex. by paryAya in comp.; ‘a(lternate) service’ paryAyasevA. v. t. parivft c.; ex. by a verb with paryAyeRa. [Alternat]ion, s. viparyayaH, parivftti f., paryAyaH. [Alternat]ive, s. vikalpaH, pakzaH, pakzAMtaraM; gen. ex. by words like gatiH, SaraRaM &c.; ‘there is no other a(lternative)’ anyA gatirnAsti, anyacCaraRaM nAlokyate (Ka. 152). 2 vikalpaH, viBAzA (in grammar). [Alternate]ly, adv. paryAyeRa, yaTAkramaM.
ALTERNATE (adj.): Comp. with paryAya-; with a. victory and defeat paryAyajayAvasAdAM, Ki. xvii. 18.; a. angles *paryAyakoRO (m. dual); a. leaves *paryAyadalAni (n. pl.).
ALTERNATE (v. i.): Ph. the flood and ebb tides a. with each other *paryAyeRa velAnAM vfdDikzayO BavataH or velAnAM paryAyavfdDikzayO.
ALTERNATE (v. t.): Ph. to a. labour with repose *paryAyeRa SramaviSrAmO karoti.
ALTERNATE , ALTERNATELY, adv. viparyyayeRa, vAraM vAraM, anyonyaM, parampa- ratas, parasparAm, parivftya; ‘alternate sleeping and waking,’ paryyAyaSayanaM.
To ALTERNATE , v. a. parivft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM), vihf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM).
To ALTERNATE , v. n. parivft (c. 1. -varttate -varttituM).
ALTERNATE , a. parasparAnuvarttI -rttinI &c., anyonyAnugAmI -minI &c.
ALTERNATELY: paryAyeRa, anukrameRa (=in regular order).
ALTERNATION: (1) paryAyakramaH;(2) paryAyavfttiH; (3) parivfttiH. (=change: q. v.)
ALTERNATION , s. viparyyayaH, paryyAyaH, parivarttanaM, parivfttiH f. — (Alterna- tion of employment or duty) karmmaviparyyayaH.
ALTERNATION , s. parasparAnuvarttanaM, anyonyAnuvarttanaM, anyonyAnugamanaM.
ALTERNATIVE: (1) vikalpaH;(2) pAkzikaH Ph.: which a. shall I choose ‘be a deserter of my wife’ or ‘be polluted with the touch of another's wife’ dAratyAgI BavAmyAho parastrIsparSapAMSulaH, Sa. v.
ALTERNATIVE , vikalpaH, anukalpaH, pAkzikaH, pakzaH, vAgyaH. — (In grammar) viBAzA f.
Although, conj. yadyapi, api.

ALTHOUGH: (1) api: we remember that Vidura and others a. born Sudras were possessed of [Page024] superior knowledge vidurapraBftayaH SUdrayonipraBavA api- viSizwavijYAnasampannAH smaryante, S. iii. 34. She will surely move a. she may be in a painting, will practise jugglery a. she may consist of a doll, will deceive a. she may be engraved niyatamiyamAle- KyagatApi calati, pustamayyapIndrajAlamAcarati, utkIrRApi vipralaBate, K.;(2) yadyapi, a. we cannot extirpate pain, still we can put it down, yadyapi na sannirUDyate duHKaM taTApi tadaBiBavaH SakyaH kartum, T.
ALTHOUGH , conj. yadyapi. ‘Although’ is sometimes expressed by the potential mood of the verb; as, ‘although it be not,’ na Bavet. — (Notwithstanding) taTApi, kintu.
ALTILOQUENCE , s. garvvitavAkyaM, sAwopoktiH f.
Altimeter, s. uccatvamApakaM yaMtraM.
ALTISONANT , a. uccEHsvaKkArI -riRI -ri (n), mahAsvanaH -nA -naM.
Altitude, s. uccatvaM, ucCrAyaH, utseDaH.
ALTITUDE: ucCrAyaH v. Height.
ALTITUDE , s. uccatvaM, ucCritiH f., ucCAyaH, uttuNgatA, utseDaH. — (Superi- ority) praDAnatvaM.
ALTIVOLANT , a. uccEr uqqIyamAnaH -nA -naM, uccEr uqqInaH -nA -naM.
Altogether, adv. sarvaTA, sarvataH, aSezataH, sAkalyena. 2 sahita-saMhata-ekIkfta a.; samaM, ekIkftya.
ALTOGETHER: I Wholly, completely,: q. v.: (1) sarvaTA;(2) aSezataHII Conjointly: q. v.: samam.

ALTOGETHER , adv. sarvaTA, sarvvatas ind., samyak, aSezatas ind., aSezeRa, kftsnaSas ind., aKilena, sAkalyena, kArtsnyena. — (Con- junctly) samaM, ekacittIBUya ind., sahitaH -tA -taM, saMhataH -tA -taM.
Alum, s. sPawI, tuvarI, sOrAzwrI, sPAwikI.
ALUM: (1) sPawI (f.);(2) sPawikAriH.
ALUM , s. sPawI, lavaRaviSezaH.
ALUMINOUS , a. sPawImayaH -yI -yaM, sPawIsambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).
Alveary, s. maDukozaH. 2 karRaSazkuli f.
ALVINE , a. OdarikaH -kI -kaM, udarasambanDI &c., kozWa in comp.
Always, adv. sadA, sarvadA, aniSaM, satataM, sarvakAlaM, niraMtaraM, anavarataM.
ALWAYS: I Perpetually, constantly: q. v.: (1) sadA;(2) sarvadA;(3) satatam;(4) sarvakAlam; (5) aniSam.II Invariably: q. v.: niyatam.
ALWAYS , adv. sarvvadA, sadA, satatam, nitpadA, aniSaM, anavarataM, nirantaraM, sarvvakzaRe.
Amain, adv. prasaBaM, prasahya, balAt, savegaM, javena.
AMAIN: (1) prasaBam;(2) prasahya;(3) balAt.
AMAIN , adv. (Violently) prasaBaM, prasahma, balAt, balavat ind. — (With impetuosity) savegaM, vegatas ind., javena.
Amalgam, s. kAMsyaM, miSraDAtuH, pAradasaMsfzwaDAtuH. [Amalgam]ate, v. t. saMmiSr 10. 2 saMyuj 10, ekIkf 8 U, saMSliz c. [Amalgam]ation, s. DAtusaMmiSraRaM. 2 saMyojanaM, saMyogaH, saMmelanaM.
AMALGAM: miSraDAtuH (?)
AMALGAM , s. kAMsyaM.
AMALGAM , s. pAradamiSritaDAtuH m., pAradasaMsfzwaDAtuH m.
AMALGAMATE: miSrayati (miSr, c. 10.): v. To mix, combine.

To AMALGAMATE , v. n. pAreRa DAtUn miSr (c. 10. miSrayati -yituM). — [Page015-b+ 51] — (To unite together) saMyuj (c. 10. -yAjayati -yituM), saMSliz in caus. (-Slezayati -yituM), saMhan (c. 2. -hanti -hantuM), ekIkf.
AMALGAMATION: miSraRam v. Mixture, combi- -nation.
AMALGAMATION , s. (Of metals) DAtumiSraRaM, yogaH. — (Junction) saMSlezaH, saMyojanaM.
Amanuensis, s. leKakaH, lipikAraH.
AMANUENSIS: leKakaH; yo'nyasya BAzitAnusAreRa liKati.
AMANUENSIS , s. leKakaH, lipikAraH, yad anyena kaTitaM talleKakaH.
Amaranth, s. amlAnapuzpaM. 2 amlAnaH, mahAsahA.
AMARANTH: I The plant: amlAnaH.II The flower: amlAnapuzpam etc.
AMARANTH , s. amlAnaH, amlAnapuzpaM.
AMARANTINE , a. amlAnI -ninI -ni (n), amlAnavAn -vatI -vat (t), amlAnapuzpayuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
AMARITUDE , s. tiktatA, -tvaM, kawutA.
Amass, v. t. saMci 5 U, saMgrah 9 P, saMBf 3 U, rASI-ekI-kf 8 U. [Amass]ment, s. saMcayaH, saMgrahaH, &c.
AMASS (v. t.): (1) saM-cinoti (ci, c. 5.);(2) saM-marati (Bf, c. 1): v. To accumulate.
To AMASS , v. a. saYci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM), upaci, samBf (c. 1. -Barati -te -BarttuM), samAkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), ekatra kf, rASIkf.
AMASSED , p. p. saYcitaH -tA -taM, upacitaH -tA -taM, samBftaH -tA -taM rASIkftaH -tA -taM.
AMASSMENT , s. saYcayaH, puYjaH, samuccayaH, saMhatiH f., oGaH, samudAyaH, rASIkaraRaM.
AMATEUR: yaH (yA, yaM) AtmavinodanArTaM saNgItAdikalAM sevate.
AMATEUR , s. kAYcid vidyAM svecCAtaH or AtmavinodArTaM sevate yaH. — (In music) ganDarvvavidyApriyaH, ganDarvvavidyAkAmaH.
Amatory, a. kAmin, premaSIla, SfMgArapriya.
AMATORY (adj.): (1) rasikaH (kA, kaM);(2) SfNgArarasapraDAnaH (nA, naM) (such as a. verses);(3) premakaraH (rI, raM) (=producing love, such as a. potions);(4) kAmin (f. nI). v. Amorous.
AMATORY , a. kAmI -minI -mi (n), snehI -hinI -hi (n), prItimAn -matI -mat (t), anurAgI -giRI -gi (n), premaSIlaH -lA -laM, SfNgArI -riRI -ri (n), rasikaH -kA -kaM.

Amaze, v. t. vismi c. (vismAyayati, vismApayate), vismayAkula-sAScarya a. kf 8 U. [Amaz]ed, a. vismApita, vismita, vismayAkula, sAScarya. [Amaze]ment, s. vismayaH, AScaryaM, vismayAkulatvaM. [Amaz]edly, adv. savismayaM; sAScaryaM. [Amaz]ing, a. vismayakArin, vicitra, adButa. 2 atirikta; ati pr.
AMAZE (v. t.): vismAyayati (c. of smi): v. To astonish.
To AMAZE , v. a. vismi in caus. (-smAyayati, -te -yituM), AkulIkf. vyAkulIkf, vismayAkulaM -lAM -laM or sAScaryyaM -ryyAM -ryyaM or vyastaM -stAM -staM kf.
AMAZE , s. vismayaH, AScaryyaH, camatkAraH. — (Confusion) AkulatvaM, vyAkulatA.
AMAZED (adj.): vismayAkulaH (lA, laM): v. Asto- -nished.
AMAZED , p. p. vismitaH -tA -taM, camatkftaH -tA -taM, mohitaH -tA -taM, vyAkulitaH -tA -taM, AkulIkftaH -tA -taM, vyAkulamanAH -nAH -naH (s).
AMAZEDLY (adv.): (1) savismayam:(2) vismayena; (3) By the adj.
AMAZEDLY , adv. savismayaM, sAScaryyaM, vismayena, camatkAreRa.
AMAZEMENT: vismayaH: v. Astonishment.
AMAZEMENT , s. vismayaH, AScaryyatvaM, adButaM, vyAkulatA, kAtaratA.
AMAZING (adj.): vismayakaraH (rI, raM): v. Asto- -nishing.
AMAZING , part. a. (Astonishing) vismayakArI -riRI -ri (n), vicitraH -trA -traM, adButaH -tA -taM, camatkArI -riRI -ri (n). — (Excessive) atiriktaH -ktA -ktaM; ‘amazing power,’ atiSaktiH f.
AMAZINGLY , adv. adButaM, vicitraM, vicitraprakAreRa. — (Excessively) nirBaraM, atIva, atiriktaM, atiSayaM; ‘amazingly covetous,’ atilubDaH.

sanskrit.slp1: svastanaCedanapUrvvakaM raRe vikramaM darSayitvA yA strIjAtiH
sanskrit.word: स्वस्तनछेदनपूर्व्वकं रणे विक्रमं दर्शयित्वा या स्त्रीजातिः
sanskrit.iast: svastanachedanapūrvvakaṃ raṇe vikramaṃ darśayitvā yā strījātiḥ

details.body: AMAZON: *pahminI; raRapriyA.
AMAZON , s. svastanaCedanapUrvvakaM raRe vikramaM darSayitvA yA strIjAtiH prAkkAlInapustakezu praSasyate.
Ambages, s. vakrokti f.
AMBAGES , s. vakroktiH f., vakraBaRitaM.
Ambassador, s. dUtaH, rAjadUtaH, praRiDiH, saMdeSaharaH. [Ambassador]ship, Ambassage, s. dOtyaM, praRiDikAryaM.
AMBASSADOR: (1) dUtaH,(2) rAjadUtaH. Ph. the English a. at Berlin *vArlinasya iMlaRqIyarAjadUtaH or iMlaRqIyarAjamantrI.
AMBASSADOR , s. dUtaH, sandeSaharaH, rAjadUtaH, rAjacAraH, sattrI m. (n).
AMBASSAGE: (1) dOtyam;(2) rAjadOtyam;(3) dUtyaM: v. Ambassador.
AMBASSAGE , s. dUtyaM, dOtyaM, dUtapreraRaM.
Amber, s. tfRamaRiH.
AMBER (subs): (1) tElasPawikaH;(2) tfRamaRiH.
AMBER , s. tfRamaRiH m., tfRagrAhI m. (n), SUkApuwwaH.
AMBER , a. tfRamaRimayaH -yI -yaM, SUkApuwwarUpaH -pI -paM.
AMBER , s. tElasPawikaH. AMBERGRIS, s. BOmaH, ambaraM.
AMBER-TREE , s. suganDivfkzaviSezaH.
AMBERGIES: ambaram (?)
AMBERGRIS , s. OzaDaviSezaH.
AMBIDEXTER or AMBIDEXTROUS, a. (Having equally the use of both hands) savyasAcI -cinI -ci (n), uBayahastakuSalaH -lA -laM. — (Equally ready to act on both sides) dvipakzapAtI m. (n).
Ambidextrous, a. uBayahastakuSala. 2 asarala, uBayapakzapAtin.
Ambient, a. vyApaka; nipAtin, gAmin in comp. 2 vezwaka, parivezwaka.
AMBIENT: (adj.): (1) vyApakaH (kA, kaM);(2) parivezwakaH (kA, kaM): v. To encompass.
AMBIENT , a. vezwakaH -kA -kaM, parivezwakaH -kA -kaM, vyApakaH -kA -kaM.
AMBIGUITY: (1) sandehaH;(2) sandigDatA;(3) sandigDAryatA.
AMBIGUITY , AMBIGUOUSNESS, s. dvyarTaH, sandigDArTaH, sandehArTaH, aspazwArTaH, aspazwatA, vakroktiH f., vakratA.
Ambiguous, a. dvyarTa, saMdigDArTa, avyakta, aspazwa, saMdigDa. [Ambiguous]ly, adv. aspazwaM, vakroktyA, dvyarTataH. [Ambiguous]ness, Ambiguity, s. vakrokti f., saMdigDArTatA, saMdehArTaH.

AMBIGUOUS (1) sandigDaH (gDA, gDaM);(2) sandigGArTaH (rTA, rTaM). Ph. it is a. here whether the word vandyAM means ‘captive’ or ‘adorable’ atravandyAmiti kiM vandIBUtAyAmuta vandanIyamiti sandehaH Sah.
AMBIGUOUS , a. dvyarTaH -rTA -rTaM, sandigDArTaH -rTA -rTaM, aspazwArTaH -rTA -rTaM, aspazwaH -zwA -zwaM, avyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, vakraH -krA -kraM.
AMBIGUOUSLY: expr. by the adj.: Ph. you have spoken a. *sandigDaM tava BAzitam.
AMBIGUOUSLY , adv. dvyarTatas ind., aspazwaM, avyaktaM, vakroktyA, sandigDaprakAreRa.
Ambit, s. maMqalaM, cakravAlaM, vartulaM.
AMBIT: (1) maRqalam;(2) cakram: v. Circuit, compass.
AMBIT , s. maRqalaM, vezwanaM, cakravAlaM.

Ambition, s. spfhA, AkAMkzA. 2 kIrtispfhA, ESvaryAkAMkzA, uccapadavAMCA; ‘a(mbition) to get a throne’, rAjyaloBaH-tfzRA. Ambitious, a. saspfha, sAkAMkza, ESvaryaprepsu, yaSaskAma; ‘who, a(mbitous) of your throne, has roused your envy’ kenAByasUyA padakAMkziRA te janitA (K. iii. 4). 2 (Of hopes) dUrADirohin, utsarpin. [Ambitious]ly, adv. ESvaryAkAMkza-yA &c.
AMBITION: (1) spfhA;(2) AkANkzA;(3) yaSolipsA (for fame);(4) rAjyaloBaH (for royalty);(5) gOravalAlasA (for esteem);(6) and sim. com. s.
AMBITION , s. kIrttispfhA, aBiruciH f., ESvaryyAkANkzA, utkfzwapadavAYCA, rAjyaloBaH.
AMBITION , s. yaSolipsA, pratizWAlipsA, yaSoloBaH, praButvalipsA.
AMBITIOUS: (1) yaSaskAmaH (mA, maM) (for fame); (2) uccapadABilAzin (f. RI) (for high post) etc. v. Desirous of, eager. Ph. a. for your post padakAMkziRA te Ku. iii. 4.

AMBITIOUS , s. kIrttiprepsuH -psuH -psu, yaSaskAmaH -mA -maM, yaSaskAmyan -myatI -myat (t), AjigIzuH -zuH -zu, utkfzwapadaprepsuH -psuH -psu, aBirucimAn -matI -mat (t), ESvaryyaprepsuH -psuH -psu, aBipretaH -tA -taM.
AMBITIOUSLY , adv. kIrttispfhAtas ind., ESvaryyAkANkzayA, utkfzwapadavAYCayA, aBirucyA.
Amble, v. i. lalitaM valg 1 P, plU 1 A; Dor 1 P. s. DoritaM. [Ambl]er, s. DoritagAmin m.
AMBLE (subs) (1) DOritakam;(2) Doritam.
AMBLE (v.): (1) Perh. Dorati (Dor, c. 1); (2) DoritagatyA calati.
To AMBLE , v. n. sundaragatyA cal (c. 1. calati calituM), sundaraprakAreRa plu (c. 1. plavate plotuM) or Dor (c. 1. Dorati DorituM).
AMBLE , s. aSvasya gativiSezaH, plutaH, DoritaM, sundaragatiH f.
AMBLER: DOritaSIlaH (lA, laM) (?)
AMBLER , s. DoritaSIlaH, sundaragatiyAyI m. (n).
Ambrosia, s. amftaM, suDA, pIyUzaM. [Ambrosi]al, a. amftamaya (yI f.), amftatulya, (s.) in comp.
AMBROSIA: amftam: v. Nectar.
AMBROSIA , s. amftaM, tridaSAhAraH, pIyUzaM, devAnnaM, paramAnnaM.
Ambulate, v. i. vicar 1 P, parikam 1 U, 4 P, itastataScar. [Ambulat]ion, s. parikramaH, paryawanaM.
To AMBULATE , v. a. vicar (c. 1. -carati -carituM). kram in freq. (caMkramyate), parikram (c. 4. -krAmyati kramituM), itastataS car.
AMBULATION , s. parikramaH, itastato BramaRaM.
AMBULATORY: carizRu (Mfn.): v. Movable.
AMBUSCADE, AMBUSH: I The place: parABiyo- gAya niBftAvasTAnam.II The men: parABiyogAya niBftasTApitasEnyam. to lie in a.: niBftaM tizWati (sTA, c. 1)
AMBUSCADE , AMBUSH, s. (A place where persons lie in wait) parAkramaRArTe niBftasTAnaM. — (The liers in wait) sEnyaM niBfte sTApitaM.
AMBUSCADE , s. saMkziptiH f. AMENABLE, a. aBiyoktavyaH -vyA -vyaM.
Ambush, Ambuscade, s. (parAvaskaMdanArTaM) niBfte sTAnaM; niBftAvasTiti f.; ‘they all lay in a(mbush)’ sarva eva te niBftaM tasTuH.
Ameliorate, v. t. vfD c., Sreyas-sADIyas kf 8 U, samunnatiM nI 1 P; See Improve. [Ameliorat]ion, s. varDanaM, samunnati f., SreyastvaM.
To AMELIORATE , v. a. BadrataraM -rAM -raM, or SreyAMsaM -yasIM -yaH or arhattaraM -rAM -raM, or sADIyAMsaM -yasIM -yaH kf.
AMELIORATION , s. SreyastvaM, BadrataratA, SrezWatA, SrOzWyaM, vfdDiH f.
Amen, adv. om, Bavatu, evamastu, taTAstu.
AMEN: o or AB. In non-ecclesiastical sense: taTAstu; evamastu.
AMEN , adv. taTAstu, evamastu.
Amenable, a. parAnuyogADIna, anuviDAyin, AjYAkara (rI f.), Ayata, vaSaM yAta; ‘a(menable) to anotherʼs power’ parADikAravaSaH.
AMENABLE: I Submissive, compliant: q. v.: anuviDAyin (f. nI).II Accountable to: Ph. a. to our government *asmAkaM SAsanAyattAH.
AMENABLE , a. aBiyokturAhvAnADInaH -nA -naM, parAnuyogADInaH -nA -naM, anusanDeyaH -yA -yaM.

Amend, v. t. saM-vi-pari-SuD c., samA-prati-samA-DA 3 U; ‘a(mend) oneʼs life’ pApAnnivft 1 A, pApaM tyaktvA DarmamAcar 1 P. v. i. SuD 4 P; samADA pass., Badratara a. BU. [Amend]ment, s. saMSoDanaM; pratisamADAnaM. 2 dozaSoDanaM &c. Amends, s. pramArjanaM, nistAraH, nizkfti f., SoDanaM; ‘to make a(mends) for’ pramfj 2 P, SuD c.; See Atone.
AMEND (v. i.): SuDyati (SuD c. 4): v. To mend, improve.
AMEND (v. t.): SoDayati (c. of SuD): v. To correct, improve.

To AMEND , v. a. (To correct) SuD in caus. (SoDayati -yituM), pariSuD viSuD, saMSuD; samADA (c. 3. -daDAti -Datte -DAtuM). — (To amend one's life, leave wickedness) pApAt nivft (c. 1. -varttate -varttituM), pApaM tyaktvA Darmmam Acar (c. 1. -carati -carituM), or sADUn AcArAn AsTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), vipratIsAraM kf.

To AMEND , v. n. (As the life or manners) SuD (c. 4. SuDyati SodDuM), viSuD, saMSuD, samADA in pass. (-DIyate), BadrataraH -rA -raM BU, sADuH -DuH or -DvI -Du BU. — (As a disease) Sam (c. 4. SAmyati SamituM) upaSam.
AMENDED , p. p. SoDitaH -tA -taM, saMSudDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Ceased from evil) nivfttapApaH -pA -paM.
AMENDMENT: I Correction, improvement: q. v.: SoDanam.II A secondary resolution in a bill or motion: *SoDanam.
AMENDMENT , s. SoDanaM, saMSudDiH f., pratisamADAnaM, samADAnaM, vipratIsAraH, SreyastvaM, SrezWatA, SrEzWyaM. — (Of life) AcAraSoDanaM, dozaSoDanaM. — (Of a disease) upaSamaH, svAsTyaM.
AMENDS , s. nistAraH, nizkftiH f., pAritozikaM, SoDanaM, saMSudDiH f.
Amenity, s. ramyatA, manojYatA.
AMENITY: (1) ramyatA;(2) manoYjatA: v. Agree- -ableness.
AMENITY , s. ramyatA, priyatA, aBirAmatvaM, sunandatA.
AMERCE: daRqayati (daRq, c. 10) (with double acc.): v. To fine.
To AMERCE , v. a. daRq (c. 10. daRqayati -yituM) with two accusatives.
AMERCED , p. p. daRqitaH -tA -taM, sADitaH -tA -taM.
AMERCEMENT: (1) daRqaH;(2) arTadaRqaH (=fine, q. v.).
AMERCEMENT , s. daRqaH, DanadaRqaH. — (Loss) hAniH f., kzayaH, apacayaH.
AMETHYST: AnIlaH maRiviSezaH.
AMETHYST , s. maRiviSezaH, nIlavarRaH prastarapraBedaH, marwIzmaRiH.
AMIABILITY: manoYjatA; (2) ramaRIyatA;(3) suSI- latA, (good behaviour);(4) priyamBAvukatA (rare).
Amiable, a. suSIla, supriya, sujana. 2 priyadarSana, ramaRIya. [Amiable]ness, s. sOjanyaM, sadBAvaH, suSIlatvaM. Amiably, adv. suSIlatayA, prItyA, snehaBAvena.
AMIABLE: (1) suSIlaH (lA, laM) (=of good behaviour);(2) premArhvaH (rhA, rhaM) (=deserving of affection);(3) ramyaH (myA, myaM) (=pleasant, agreeable)

AMIABLE , a. suSIlaH -lA -laM, supriyaH -yA -yaM, suSIlavAn -vatI -vat (t), prItimAn -matI -mat (t), priyadarSanaH -nA -naM, snehArhaH -rhA -rhaM, priyaNkaraH -rA -raM. — (Pleasant) ramaRIyaH -yA -yaM.
AMIABLENESS , s. suSIlatvaM, sadBAvaH, priyatA, priyamBavizRutA, priyamBAvukatA.
AMIABLY: prItyA: v. lovingly, affectionately.
AMIABLY , adv. suSIlajanavat, supriyaM, prItipUrvvakaM, prItyA.

Amicable, a. mEtra (trI f.), hita, snehaSIla; mitraBAvena; ‘a(micable) setilement’ mitraBAvena nirRayaH. [Amicable]ness, s. mitratvaM, saKyaM, sOhArdaM. Amicably, adv. mitravat, mitraBAvena sOhArdena.
AMICABLE: mEtraH (trI, traM): v. Friendly, kind.
AMICABLE , a. mEtraH -trI -traM, hitaH -tA -taM, sAKeyaH -yA -yaM, snehaSIlaH -lA -laM.
AMICABLENESS , s. mitratvaM, sAKyaM, sOrhAddaM, sahAyatA, anukUlatA.
Amid, [Amid]st, prep. maDye, aMtare, aByaMtare, (with gen.); maDyagata-sTita a. ‘a(midst) these thoughts he was pierced by an arrow’ evaM vicArayan-evaM vicAranimagnaH san-bARena hataH.
AMID, AMIDST: (1) maDye (with gen.), a. four fires havirBujAM caturRAM maDye, K. xiii. 41.;(2) by adj. s maDyagataH (tA, taM), etc. Ku. v. 20.
AMID , AMIDST, prep. maDye, antaraRa, antare, antarA, aByantare.
Amiss, a. dozin, aparADin. 2 anucita, ayogya. adv. anucitaM, ayuktaM; ‘take a(miss)’ See Misunderstand.
AMISS (adv.): expr. by the adj. s: (1) ayuktaH (ktA, ktaM);(2) sAparADaH (DA, DaM) etc.: v. Wrong.
AMISS , adj. dozI -ziRI -zi (n), aparADI -DinI Di (n), anucitaH -tA -taM, ayuktaH -ktA -ktaM. adv. duzwu, dozeRa, aparADatas, anucitaM, ayuktaM.
Amity, s. mEtrI, snehaBAvaH, saKyaM, saMDiH.
AMITY: mEtrI: v. Peace, friendship.
AMITY , s. mEtryaM, sAKyaM, vanDutA, EkyaM. — (Between nations) sanDiH m.
AMMONIA: niSAdalaH.
AMMONIAC: niryAsapraBedaH.
AMMONIAC , s. (Gum ammoniac) niryAsaprakAraH. — (Sal ammoniac) lavaRaprakAraH.
Ammunition, s. yudDasAmagrI, yudDopakaraRAni.
AMMUNITION: yudDopakaraRam: (now=gunpowder, shot) q. v.
AMMUNITION , s. yudDopakaraRaM, yudDasajjA.
Amnesia, s. smfti-BraMSaH-nASaH.
Amnesty, s. (rAjakftA) dozakzamA, dozAdvimocanaM.
AMNESTY: kzamA (=pardon, the meaning determined by the context).
AMNESTY , s. rAjakzamA, dozakzamA, dozavismaraRavyavasTA.
AMNESTY , s. sarvvadaRqyamuktiH f. -mocanaM, sakalAparADamuktiH f.
Among, [Among]st, prep. maDye, aByaMtare, (with gen.); ex. by loc. or gen. of noun; ‘a(mongst) cows the black one gives much milk’ gavAM gozu vA kfzRA bahukzIrA (S. K.) kAvyezu nAwakaM ramyaM &c.

AMONG: I Amidst: q. v.: maDye (with gen.). II Making part of a number of:(1) maDye (with gen.), a. his very many sons atipraBUtAnAM sutAnAM maDye, K. ;(2) by loc., Rambhā a. women and Rāma a. kings nArIzu ramBA nfpatizu rAmaH.
AMONG , AMONGST, prep. maDye, aByantare, antare, antareRa, antarA, antar.
Amorous, a. kAmuka, premaSIla, rasika, SfMgArapriya. 2 savilAsa, saviBrama, lalita; ‘a(morous) sport’ savilAsakrIqA. [Amorous]ly, adv. sakAmaM, sAnurAgaM; savilAsaM, saviBramaM, lalitaM.
AMOROUS: I Prone to love:(1) kAmin (f. rnA);(2) kAmukaH (kA, kaM);(3) premaSIlaH (lA, laM).II In love: v. Enamoured.III Per- -taining to love: kAma- (in comp.): v. Ama- -tory.
AMOROUS , a. kAmI -minI -mi (n), prakAmaH -mA -maM, kAmukaH -kA -kaM, manmaTI -TinI -Ti (n), SfNgArI -riRI -ri (n), rasikaH -kA -kaM, premaSIlaH -lA -laM, kAmAkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
AMOROUSLY: (1) sAnurAgam: v. Affectiona- -tely;(2) sakAmam.
AMOROUSLY , adv. kAmena, kAmatas ind., rasikaBAvena, prItipUrvvakaM.

details.body: Amount, v. i. upaci-saMKyA pass.; saMpad 4 A; ‘a(mount)ing to’ saMKyAka in comp.; ‘a(mount) to 100’ SatasaMKya-saMKyAka; ‘they a(mount) in all to 24 men’ evaM piMqIkftya caturviMSatirnarAH saMpadyaMte; ‘thus the families a(mount) to 14’ evametAnyekatra caturdaSa kulAni (Ka. 136); ‘your whole speech a(mount)s to this’ etAvatA-evaMca; eza tava vacaso nizkarzaH-piMqitorTaH; ‘your exertions do not a(mount) to even a hundredth part of mine’ tava vyavasAyo mamodyogasya SatatamImapi kalAM na spfSati. s. rASiH, parimARaM, samudAyaH, saMKyA, samuccayaH; ‘by any a(mount) of labour’ mahatA SrameRApi; ‘to the a(mount) of 100’ SatasaMKyaM.

AMOUNT (v. i.) Ph. a. ing to a lac lakzyasaMKyakaH (kA, kaM); these races together a. to fourteen etAnyekatra caturdaSakulAni, K.; ascertain what the balance a. s to *kiyadavaSizwamiti parijYAyatAm; your argument a. s to this *etadaBiprAyakaste tarkaH.
To AMOUNT , v. n. upaci in pass. (-cIyate), saYci, samudi in pass. (-Iyate), saNKyA in pass. (-KyAyate); ‘amounting to,’ saMKyakaH -kA -kaM.
AMOUNT , s. parimARaM, saNKyA, samudAyaH, upacAyaH, sAraH, arTaH; ‘money to the amount of a lac,’ lakzasaMKyAni DanAni. — (Value, price) mUlyaM.
AMOUR: praRayaH (=love), secret a. guptapraRayaH (?).
Amphibiology, s. saMdigDavacanaM, SlezaH.
Amphibious, a. sTalajalacara. 2 dviDAgati.
AMPHIBIOUS: BUjalacaraH (rA, raM) (?); pAdin (f. nI). Sr.
AMPHIBIOUS , a. BUjalacaraH -rA -raM, sTalajalacaraH -rA -raM, jalavAyugaH -gA -gaM, dviDAgatiH -tiH -ti, sTaleSayaH.
Amphitheatre, s. raMgaH, raMgaBUmi f., raMgAMgaRaM.
AMPHITHEATRE: (1) raNgaH;(2) raNgaBUmiH.
AMPHITHEATRE , s. ardDacandrAkAro raNgaH, ardDamaRqalAkAro raNgaH, raNgaBUmiH f., raNgANgaRaM.

Ample, a. viSAla, vipula, bfhat, vistIrRa, vistfta. 2 pracura, praBUta, bahula, yaTezwa. [Ample]ness, s. viSAlatA. 2 prAcuryaM. Amply, adv. savistaraM, pracuraM, yaTezwaM; ‘he was a(mply) rewarded’ tasmE praBUtaM pAritozikaM dattaM. Amplify, v. t. savistaraM-vistareRa-varR 10. 2 tan 8 U, vfD c., vistF 9 U. Amplification, Amplitude, s. vistAraH, vfdDi f. 2 mahattvaM, prAcuryaM.
AMPLE: I Specious: q. v.: viSAlaH (lA, laM) II Abundant, copious: q. v. pracuraH (rA, raM). III Not brief: vistftaH (tA, taM).
AMPLE , a. viSAlaH -lA -laM, vipulaH -lA -laM, vistftaH -tA -taM, vfhan -hatI -hat (t), pracuraH -rA -raM, bahulaH -lA -laM, yaTezwaH -zwA -zwaM.
AMPLENESS: I Spaciousness: q. v.: viSAlatA. II Abundance: q. v.: prAcuryam.
AMPLENESS , s. viSAlatA, vipulatA, vistIrRatA, vfhattvaM, prAcuryyaM.
AMPLIFICATION: I Enlargement: q. v.II Of speech: vistaraH or vistAraH.
AMPLIFICATION , s. vistAratvaM, vistaraH, vfdDiH f., vardDanaM. — (In rhetoric) atyuktiH f.
AMPLIFY: vistarataH or vistAreRa varRayati, upa-, (varR, c. 1): v. To enlarge.

To AMPLIFY , AMPLIFICATE, v. a. vfD in caus. (varDayati -yituM), saMvfD; vistf (c. 5. -stfRoti, c. 9. -stfRAti -starituM, -starItuM, caus. -stArayati), ApyE in caus. (-pyAyayati -yituM), samApyE; tan (c. 8. tanoti tanituM).
AMPLITUDE , s. (Extent) vistIrRatA, vistAraH, vipulatA. — (Great- ness) vfhattvaM, mahattvaM, mahimA m. (n). — (Capacity) ADAraSaktiH, sAmarTyaM. — (Abundance) pracuratvaM, sampUrRatvaM, bahutvaM.
AMPLITUDE I. Extent: q. v.: vistAraH. II Greatness: q. v.: mahattvam.
AMPLY: pracuram: v. Abundantly, sufficiently, fully.
AMPLY , adv. vistareRa, vistaraSas ind., vipulaM, yaTezwaM.
Amputate, v. t. aMgaM Cid 7 P or nikft 6 P. [Amputat]ion, s. CedaH, kartanaM.
AMPUTATE: Cinatti (Cid, c. 7): v. To cut off.
To AMPUTATE , v. a. aNgaM Cid (c. 7. Cinatti CettuM), lU (c. 9. lunAti -nIte lavituM), nikft (c. 6. -kfntati -kartituM), aNgacCedanaM kf.
AMPUTATED , p. p. CinnaH -nnA -nnaM, lUnaH -nA -naM, kfttaH -ttA -ttaM.
AMPUTATION: aNgacCedaH or sim. CedaH (when the meaning is clear).
AMPUTATION , s. CedaH, aNgacCedanaM, karttanaM, aNgakarttanaM.
Amulet, s. rakzAkaraMqaH.
AMULET: (1) rakzAkARqaH; Sa. vii.;(2) kavaca (mn.).
AMULET , s. kavacaH, rakzA, roganivAraRArTaM kiYcid dravyaM or OzaDaM.
AMULET , s. saMvadanaM. ANACHRONISM, s. kAlagaRanAvyatyayaH.

Amuse, v. t. vinud c., ram c., naMd c.; ‘a(muse) oneself’ vihf 1 P, vilas 1 P, kIq 1 P. [Amuse]ment, s. vinodaH, vinodanaM, krIqA, keli f., vilAsaH, kOtukaM. [Amus]ing, a. vinodin, vinodanaSIla, hfdayaMgama, ramya.

AMUSE: I To entertain the mind agreeably: (1) vi-nodayati (c. of nud), how shall I a. myself kenedAnImAtmAnaM vinodayAmi, V. ii.;(2) raYjayati (c. of raYj), the prince was very much a. ed by [Page026] his long description of his past valour, beauty and fortune atItasvaSOryarUpaviBavavarRanAvAcAlena tena suta- rAmarajyata rAjaputraH, K.II. To delude: q. v.: Calayati (nomi.).
To AMUSE , v. a. nand in caus. (nandayati -yituM), aBinand, pratinand; ram in caus. (ramayati -yituM), vinud in caus. (nodayati -yituM). — (To amuse one's self) vilas (c. 1. -lasati -lasituM).
AMUSED, BE: (1) rajyate;(2) vinudyate (pass).
AMUSED , p. p. vinoditaH -tA -taM, aBinanditaH -tA -taM.
AMUSEMENT: (1) vinodaH;(2) vinodanam: v. Diversion, entertainment.
AMUSEMENT , s. vinodaH, parIhAsaH, krIqA, keliH f., KelA, vilAsaH, AhlAdaH, narmma n. (n), kOtukaM, kutUhalaM.
AMUSER: vinodayitf (m.): v. To amuse.
AMUSER , s. vinodayitA m. (tf), nandakaH.
AMUSING (part. adj.): vinodin (f. nI): v. Pleasing.
ANABAPTISM: *yOvanamajjanavAditvam: v. Ana- -baptist.
ANABAPTISM , s. punarjalasaMskAraH, punarmajjanaM.
ANABAPTIST: *yOvanamajjanavAdin (m.) kfzwaDarmAnu yAyiMnAM maDye ye yOvane jalamajjanotsavamanuSAsati.
ANABAPTIST , s. punarjalasaMskAramatAvalambI, punarjalasaskAramataM DArayan.
Anachronism, s. kAlagaRanAyAM pramAdaH or BramaH. 2 kAlanirdeSapramAdaH.
ANACHRONISM: kAlagaRanABramaH (?).
ANACHRONISM , s. kAlagaRanABramaH.
Anæsthetic, a. saMvedanAnASaka.
Anagogy, s. gUQArTaH.
ANAGRAM: *akzaraviparyAsaH; SabdasyAkzarARAM BinnasamA- veSenAnyaSabdakalpanam.
ANAGRAM , nAmAkzaraparivarttanAt sArTavAkyaracanaM yaTA devarAjaH, veda jAraH.
ANAGRAM , s. SabdAkzaraviparyyAsakalpitanAma n. (n).
Anagraph, s. varRanaM. 2 parigaRanApatraM.
ANALOGICAL: Ph. a. argument upamAnam.

ANALOGICAL or ANALOGOUS, sambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), sambanDakaH -kA -kaM, sadfSaH -SI -SaM, upamaH -mA -maM, anurUpaH -pA -paM, samAnaH -nA -naM, [Page017-a+ 51] anuguRaH -RA -RaM, tulyaH -lyA -lyaM, samparkI -rkiRI -rki (n), AnuzaNgikaH -kI -kaM, tulyarUpaH -pA -pI -paM.
ANALOGICALLY: sAdfSyAt; sAdfSyatas; tulyarUpa- tayA.
ANALOGICALLY , adv. sAdfSyena, Opamyena, sAmAnyatas ind., sAdfSyatas ind.
ANALOGOUS: (1) sadfSaH (SA, SaM);(2) tulyaH (lyA, lyaM);(3) tulyarUpaH (pA, paM).
Analogy, s. sAdfSyaM, samAnatA, saMbaMDaH. [Analog]ical, [Analog]ous, a. sadfSa (SI f.), tulyarUpa, samAna, anurUpa, saMbaMDin, AnuzaMgika (kI f.). [Analogical]ly, adv. sAdfSyena, Opamyena.
ANALOGY: sAdfSyam: v. Resemblance, simila- -rity.
ANALOGY , s. sambanDaH, sAdfSyaM, OpamyaM, samparkaH, sAmAnyaM, samAnaBAvaH, upamitiH.
ANALOGY , s. upamAnaM, aByupagamaH. ANALYSIS, s. mUlatattvaSoDanaM.
Analphabete, s. nirakzara, anakzara.
ANALYSIS: I Philo. t. t.: no equiv.: *viSlezaH. II Synopsis: q. v.
ANALYSIS , s. upodGAtaH, pfTakkaraRaM, viCedaH, vyavaCedaH, pariCedaH, viBedaH, viBAgaH, vivecanaM, vivekaH, drAvaRaM, vyAkAraH. — (The essence of any thing) sAraH, vastu n.
ANALYTIC, ANALYTICAL: *viSlezakaH (f. zikA, n. pakaM).
Analyze, v. t. vyAkf 8 U, viBaj 1 U, vicCid 7 P, viBinna a. -KaMqaSaH-pfTak-kf, viSliz c. Analysis, s. viBAgaH, vyavacCedaH, viBedaH, vyAkaraRaM. 2 sAraH.
ANALYZE (v. t.): *vi-Slezayati (c. of Silaz); viSlezya parIkzate (Ikz, c. 1).

To ANALYZE , v. a. upodGAtaM kf, kiYcit samastadravyaM pfTakkf, or KaRqaSas kf, or BAgaSas kf, viviktaM -ktAM -ktaM or viBinnaM -nnAM -nnaM kf, vyAkf, viBaj (c. 1. -Bajati -te -BaktuM), viCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), dru in caus. (drAvayati -yituM), dravIkf.
To ANALYZE , v. a. mUlatattvaSoDanaM kf. ANAPEST, s. hastaH.
Anaphrodisiac, a. kAmaSAmaka.
ANARCHICAL (adj.): (1) arAjakaH (kA, kaM) (without a king);(2) viplutaH (tA, taM) ( =turbulent);(3) *viplavakArin (f. RI) (=anar- -chist).
ANARCHICAL , a. arAjakaH -kA -kaM, anISvaraH -rA -raM, aSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, rAjanItirahitaH -tA -taM, aSAsitaH -tA -taM, asTiraH -rA -raM, avyavasTitaH -tA -taM.
ANARCHIST: *rAjyaviplavakArin (f. RI).
Anarchy, s. aSAsanaM, anISvaratA, rAjaviplavaH, arAjakatA; ‘when the country is in a(narchy)’ arAjake janapade. Anarch, Anarchist, a. arAjakatApratipAdaka
ANARCHY: (1) rAjyaviplavaH;(2) prajAviplavaH, Vi. iii.
ANARCHY , s. arAjyaM, aSAsanaM, praButvarAhityaM, SAsanahInatvaM, anaDInatA, anISvaratA.
Anathema, s. aBiSApaH, SApaH, AkroSaH. [Anathema]tize, v. t. Sap 1 U, AkruS 1 P.
ANATHEMA: (1) SApaH (?);(2) aBiSApaH (?) v. Curse, excommunication.
ANATHEMA , s. SApaH, aBiSApaH, pariSApaH, AkroSanaM, avakroSaH.
ANATHEMATIZE: Sapati, aBi-, (Sap, c. 1): v. To curse, excommunicate.
To ANATHEMATIZE , v. a. Sap (c. 1. Sapati, c. 4. Sapyati, SaptuM), aBiSap; AkruS (c. 1. -kroSati -krozwuM).
ANATOMICAL: (1) vyavacCedavidyAvizayakaH (kA, kaM); (2) by tat. comp.
ANATOMICAL , a. vyavaCedavidyAskambanDakaH -kA -kaM, vyavaCedavidyAnurUpaH -pA -paM.
ANATOMICALLY , adv. vyavaCedavidyAnurUpaM, viSasanavidyAkrameRa, vyavaCe- davidyavit.

To ANATOMISE , v. a. SarIraM vyavaCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), viCid, saYCid; viSas (c. 1. -Sasati -SasituM), KaRqaSas kf, pfTakkf. — (To lay open distinctly) vivf (c. 5. -vfRoti, -varituM or -varItuM), apavf; prakawIkf, vyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -KyAtuM).
ANATOMISED , p. p. vyavaCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, viSasitaH -tA -taM, pfTakkftaH -tA -taM.
ANATOMIST: *vyavacCedavidyAviSAradaH or. -kuSalaH.
ANATOMIST , s. vyavaCedavidyAjYaH, vyavaCedakaH, viSasitA m. (tf).
ANATOMIZE: vyavacCinatti (Cid, c. 7): v. To dissect.
Anatomy, s. pfTakkaraRaM, vicCedaH. 2 SarIravyavacCeda-vidyA-SAstraM. [Anatom]ize, v. t. (SarIraM) vyavacCid 7 P, pfTak kf. 2 vivf 5 U, vyAKyA 2 P. [Anatom]ist, s. vyavacCedakaH.
ANATOMY: *vyavacCedavidyA.
ANATOMY , s. SarIravyavaCedavidyA, viSasanavidyA, viSasanaM. — (Division of any thing) viCedaH, viBedaH, pfTakkaraRaM.
Ancestor, s. pUrvapuruzaH; ‘a(ncestor)s’ pUrvajAH (pl.), pitaMraH (pl.), pitfloka. Ancestral, a. pitfka, pEtfka (kI f.); ‘a(ncestral) property’ pitryaM rikTaM. Ancestry, s. pitaraH, pitf.
ANCESTOR: pUrvapuruzaH, In. pl.: (1) pUrvapuruzaH;(2) pUrvajAH;(3) pitaraH;(4) pUrve, I have excelled my c. s pUrve tiraskAritAH, Vi. v.
ANCESTOR , s. pUrvvapuruzaH. — (Ancestors) pUrvvajAH m. pl., pitaraH m. pl., pitflokaH.
ANCESTORS , s. pl. kulaparamparA, vfdDaparamparA, pitrAvaliH -lI f.
ANCESTRAL: pitfpEtAmahaH (hI, haM) P. v. Paternal.
ANCESTRAL , a. pitryaH -tryA -tryaM, pitfkaH -kA -kaM, kOlikaH -kI -kaM, pEtraH -trI -traM, pEtrikaH -kI -kaM.
ANCESTRAL , a. pEtAmahaH -hI -haM, pitrAyAtaH -tA -taM, pitrAgataH &c.
ANCESTRY: I Ancestors: q. v.II Birth, or honourable descent:(1) anvayaH;(2) vaMSaH. Ph.: of good or noble a.:(1) aBijAtaH (tA, taM); (2) aBijanavat (f. tI) Sa. iv.
ANCESTRY , s. pitaraH m. pl., pUrvvajAH m. pl., pitfsAmAnyaM, pitfSreRI f., pitfpitAmahAdi n. — (Birth, the honour of descent) vaMSaH, anvayaH, kulamaryyAdA.
Anchor, s. nObaMDanakIlaH-laM, lAMgalaM. v. t. kIlena baMD 9 P, sTirIkf, gatiM niruD 7 U or pratihan 2 P.

ANCHOR (subs): nObanDanalOhayantraBedaH; *laNagaram. Ph. the arms of an a., *laNgaradantAH (m. pl.): the eye of an a. *laNgaracCidrama; to cast a. *laNgaraM prakzipati; to weigh a. laNgaram uttolayati (tul, c. 10.)
ANCHOR (v.): laNgaraM prakzipati (kzip, c. 6.) (with gen.) a. ed off Benares *upavArARasi laNgaraM pracikzepa, or laNgareRa nAvaM babanDa.
ANCHOR , s. nObanDanakIlaH, lohamayayantraM yena nOkA baDyate or sTi- rIkriyate. — (A post for mooring vessels) kUpakaH.
To ANCHOR , v. a. lOhayantreRa nAvaM vanD (c. 9. baDnAti bandDuM) or sTirIkf.
ANCHOR , s. aNkuSAkAradantadvayayuktaM nObanDanaM. There is no Sanskrit equivalent; laNgaraH from the Persian is often used.
ANCHORAGE: I The place: *laNgarasTAnam. II The duty: *laNgaraSulkam.
ANCHORAGE , s. sTAnaM nObanDanayogyaM. — (The duty paid for an- choring) nOkAbanDanAnantaraM yat SulkaM nOkArUQEr dIyate.
Anchorite, s. yatiH, AraRyakaH, saMnyAsin m., vanavAsin m., vAnaprasTaH.
ANCHORITE: (1) yatiH;(2) sannpAsin (m). v. Hermit.
ANCHORITE , s. vanavAsI m. (n), yatI m. (n), yatiH m., tapasvI m. (n), sannyAsI m. (n), vanI m. (n). — (Brahman of the 3d order) vAnaprasTaH, gfhasTASramatyAgI m. (n).
ANCHOVY: *heriMjAtIyaH kzudramatsyaviSezaH.
ANCHOVY , s. kzudramatsyaviSezaH.

Ancient, a. purARa, purAtana (nI f.), pUrva, prAkkAlIna, prAktana, prAcIna. s. (‘A(ncient)s’) vfdDAH-prAcInapuruzAH (pl.). 2 DvajaH, patAkA. 3 patAkin m. [Ancient]ly, adv. purA, pUrvaM, pUrvakAle. [Ancient]ness, s. prAcInatA, purAtanatvaM, &c.
ANCIENT (adj.): (1) purARaH (RA, RaM);(2) purAtanaH (nI, naM);(3) prAcInaH (nA, naM);(4) cirantanaH (nI, naM); (5) prAkkAlInaH (nI, naM);(6) pUrvakAlInaH (nA, naM): (7) prAkkAlInaH (nA, naM): v. Old.
ANCIENT (subs): I Flag: q. v.: patAkA. II An ensign: q. v.: patAkin (f. nI)
ANCIENT, THE: (1) vfdDA (m. pl.), U. v.;(2) cirantanAH (m. pl.), S. : v. Antiquity.

ANCIENT , a. purARaH -RA or -RI -RaM, purAtanaH -nI -naM, prAkkAlInaH -nA -naM, pOrARaH -RI -RaM, prAktanaH -nI -naM, vfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, prAcInaH -nA -naM, pUrvvakAlInaH -nA -naM, cirantanaH -nI -naM.
ANCIENT , s. vfdDaH, prAcInapuruzaH, pUrvvakAlInalokaH. — (The flag of a ship) nAvo DvajaH or patAkA. — (Flag-bearer) patAkI m. (n).
ANCIENTLY: (1) pUrvakAle;(2) purA. v. Formerly.
ANCIENTLY , adv. pUrvvakAle, gatakAle, purA, pUrvvaM.
ANCIENTNESS , s. prAcInatA, purAtanatvaM, prAkkAlInatA, vfdDatvaM.
ANCIENTS , s. pUrvvajAH m. pl., prAcInapuruzAH m. pl., pUrvvakAlInamanuzpAH m. pl.
Ancipital, a. dviSIrzaka. 2 saMdigDa.
